ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ADAMANTINE_ARMO.name: Armadura de adamantina

type.addition: Any Medium or Heavy, Except Hide Armor

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ADAMANTINE_ARMO.description: This suit of armor is reinforced with adamantine, one of the hardest substances in existence. While you're wearing it, any golpe crítico against you becomes a normal hit.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ANIMATED_SHIELD.name: Escudo animado
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ANIMATED_SHIELD.description: Mientras empuñas Shield, you can take a Bonus Action to cause it to animate. The Shield leaps into the air and hovers in your space to protect you as if you were wielding it, leaving your hands free. The Shield remains animate for 1 minute, until you take a Bonus Action to end this effect, or until you die or have the Incapacitado condition, at which point the Shield falls to the ground or into your hand if you have one free.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ARMOR_OF_VULNER.description:
Mientras llevas puesta esta armadura, tienes resistencia al daño de contundente daño.

Curse. This armor is cursed, a fact that is revealed only when the Identify spell is cast on the armor or you attune to it. ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ARROW_CATCHING_.name: Escudo atrapaflechas
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ARROW_CATCHING_.description:
You gain a +2 bonus to Clase de Armadura against ranged tiradas de ataque while you wield this Shield. This bonus is in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.

Whenever an attacker makes a ranged tirada de ataque against a target within 5 pies of you, you can take a Reaction to become the target of the attack instead.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DEMON_ARMOR.name: Armadura demoníaca

setters.keywords: enhancement, abyssal, slashing, damage, unarmed strikes, cursed

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DEMON_ARMOR.description:
Mientras llevas armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Clase de Armadura, and you know Abyssal. In addition, the armor's clawed gauntlets allow your golpes sin armas to deal 1d8 cortante daño instead of the usual contundente daño, and you gain a +1 bonus to the attack and tiradas de daño of your golpes sin armas.

Curse. Once you don this cursed armor, you can't doff it unless you are targeted by a Remove Curse spell or similar magic. While wearing the armor, you have desventaja on tiradas de ataque against demons and on tiradas de salvación against their spells and special abilities.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DRAGON_SCALE_MA.name: Cota de escamas de dragón (Negro)

setters.keywords: armor class, ac, advantage, saving throws, saves, resistance, acid, magic action, action, enhancement

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DRAGON_SCALE_MA.description:
Dragon Scale Mail is made of the scales of one kind of dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them. Other times, hunters carefully preserve the hide of a dead dragon. In either case, Dragon Scale Mail is highly valued.

Mientras llevas armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Clase de Armadura, you have ventaja on tiradas de salvación against the breath weapons of Dragons, and you have resistencia to ácido daño.

Additionally, you can focus your senses como acción de Magia to discern the distance and direction to the closest black dragon within 30 miles of yourself. This action can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ENSPELLED_ARMOR.name: Armadura hechizada (Truco)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ENSPELLED_ARMOR.description:
Bound into this armor is a cantrip. The cantrip is determined when the armor is created and must belong to the Abjuration or Illusion school of magic. The armor has 6 cargas and recupera 1d6 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While wearing the armor, you can expend 1 carga to cast its spell.

The cantrip's tirada de salvación CD is 13, and its attack bonus is +5.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GLAMOURED_STUDD.name: Cuero tachonado glamuroso
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GLAMOURED_STUDD.description: Mientras llevas armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Clase de Armadura. You can also take a Bonus Action to cause the armor to assume the appearance of a normal set of clothing or some other kind of armor. You decide what it looks like—including color, style, and accessories—but the armor retains its normal bulk and weight. The illusory appearance lasts until you use this property again or doff the armor.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MARINERS_ARMOR.name: Armadura de marinero
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MARINERS_ARMOR.description:
Mientras llevas armor, you have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed. In addition, if you start your turn underwater with 0 puntos de golpe, you immediately regain 1d4 puntos de golpe. The armor can't heal anyone again hasta el próximo amanecer.

The armor is decorated with fish and shell motifs.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MITHRAL_ARMOR.name: Armadura de mithral

type.addition: Any Medium or Heavy, Except Hide Armor

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MITHRAL_ARMOR.description:
Mithral is a light, flexible metal. A mithral chain shirt or breastplate can be worn under normal clothes.

If the armor normally imposes disadvantage on Destreza (Stealth) checks or has a Fuerza requirement, the mithral version of the armor doesn't.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HALF_PLATE_ARMO.name: Semiplacas de eterealidad
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HALF_PLATE_ARMO.description: While you're wearing this armor, you can take a Magic action and use a command word to gain the effect of the Etherealness spell. The spell ends immediately if you remove the armor or take a Magic action to repeat the command word. This property of the armor can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

setters.keywords: advantage, initiative, wisdom, perception, ability checks, skill checks, checks

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SENTINEL_SHIELD.description: Mientras empuñas Shield, you have ventaja on Initiative rolls and Sabiduría (Perception) checks. The Shield is emblazoned with a symbol of an eye.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SHIELD_1.name: Escudo +1
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SHIELD_1.description: Mientras empuñas Shield, you have a +1 bonus to Clase de Armadura, in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SHIELD_3.name: Escudo +3
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SHIELD_3.description: Mientras empuñas Shield, you have a +3 bonus to Clase de Armadura, in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SHIELD_OF_EXPRE.name: Escudo de expresión
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SHIELD_OF_EXPRE.description: The front of this Shield is shaped in the likeness of a face. While bearing the Shield, you can take a Bonus Action to alter the face's expression.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SHIELD_OF_MISSI.name: Escudo atraeproyectiles
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SHIELD_OF_MISSI.description:
Mientras empuñas Shield, you have resistencia to daño from attacks made with Ranged weapons.

Curse. This Shield is cursed. Attuning to it curses you until you are targeted by a Remove Curse spell or similar magic. Removing the Shield fails to end the curse on you. Whenever an attack with a Ranged weapon targets a creature within 10 pies of you, the curse causes you to become the target instead.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SHIELD_OF_THE_C.name: Escudo del caballero

setters.keywords: ac, armor class, attack action, force, damage, push, forceful movement, prone, condition, reaction, emanation

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SHIELD_OF_THE_C.description:
Mientras empuñas Shield, you have a +2 bonus to Clase de Armadura. This bonus is in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.

The Shield has the following additional properties that you can use while holding it.

fuerzaful Bash. When you take the Attack action, you can make one of the tiradas de ataque using the Shield against a target within 5 pies of yourself. Apply your bonificador por competencia and Fuerza modifier to the tirada de ataque. On a hit, the Shield deals fuerza daño to the target equal to 2d6 + 2 plus your Fuerza modifier, and if the target is a creature, you can push it up to 10 pies directly away from yourself. If the creature is your size or smaller, you can also knock it down, giving it the Derribado condition.

Protective Field. Como reacción, when you or an ally you can see within 5 pies of you is targeted by an attack or makes a tirada de salvación against an area of effect, you can use the Shield to create an immobile 5-foot Emanation originating from you. When the Emanation appears, any creatures or objects not fully contained within it are pushed into the nearest unoccupied spaces outside it. The attack or area of effect that triggered the Reaction has no effect on creatures and objects inside the Emanation, which lasts as long as you maintain Concentración, up to 1 minute. Nothing can pass into or out of the Emanation. A creature or object inside the Emanation can't be dañod by attacks or effects originating from outside, nor can a creature inside the Emanation daño anything outside it. Once this property is used, it can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SMOLDERING_ARMO.name: Armadura humeante
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SMOLDERING_ARMO.description: Wisps of harmless, odorless smoke rise from this armor while it is worn.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SPELLGUARD_SHIE.name: Escudo guardaconjuros
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SPELLGUARD_SHIE.description: Mientras empuñas Shield, you have ventaja on tiradas de salvación against spells and other magical effects, and spell tiradas de ataque have desventaja against you.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_BOMB.name: Bomba

setters.keywords: action, sphere, dexterity, saving throw, save, fire, damage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_BOMB.description: Como acción, puedes encender esta bomba y lanzarla a un punto hasta a 60 pies. Cada criatura en una esfera de 5 pies de radio centrada en ese punto debe superar una tirada de salvación de Destreza CD 12 o recibir 3d6 de daño de fuego.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_DYNAMITE_STICK.name: Cartucho de dinamita

setters.keywords: action, sphere, dexterity, saving throw, save, force, damage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_DYNAMITE_STICK.description: Como acción, puedes encender un cartucho de dinamita y lanzarlo a un punto hasta a 60 pies. Cada criatura en una esfera de 5 pies de radio debe hacer una tirada de salvación de Destreza CD 12, recibiendo 3d6 de daño contundente si falla, o la mitad si tiene éxito.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_FRAGMENTATION_GRENADE.name: Granada de fragmentación

setters.keywords: action, sphere, dexterity, saving throw, save, piercing, damage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_FRAGMENTATION_GRENADE.description: Como acción, puedes lanzar una granada a un punto hasta a 60 pies. Cada criatura en una esfera de 20 pies de radio debe hacer una tirada de salvación de Destreza CD 15, recibiendo 5d6 de daño perforante si falla, o la mitad si tiene éxito.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_GRENADE_LAUNCHER.name: Lanzagranadas
ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_GRENADE_LAUNCHER.description: Arma diseñada para lanzar granadas hasta a 120 pies de distancia.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_SMOKE_GRENADE.name: Granada de humo
ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_SMOKE_GRENADE.description: Como acción, puedes lanzar esta granada a un punto hasta a 60 pies. Un asalto después de aterrizar, emite una nube de humo que crea un área muy oscura de 20 pies de radio durante 1 minuto.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_GUNPOWDER_KEG.name: Barril de pólvora

setters.keywords: sphere, dexterity, saving throw, save, fire, damage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_GUNPOWDER_KEG.description: Prender fuego a un barril de pólvora lo hace explotar. Cada criatura en una esfera de 10 pies de radio debe hacer una tirada de salvación de Destreza CD 12, recibiendo 7d6 de daño de fuego si falla, o la mitad si tiene éxito.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_GUNPOWDER_POWDER_HORN.name: Cuerno de pólvora

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_ENERGY_CELL.description: Fuente de alimentación utilizada por armas de fuego futuristas.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_WEAPON_PROPERTY_FIREARM_AM.name: Munición (Armas de fuego)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_WEAPON_PROPERTY_FIREARM_AM.description: Las balas de armas de fuego se destruyen al usarse en un arma de fuego moderna. Las armas de fuego futuristas usan células de energía que no pueden recargarse de forma convencional.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_WEAPON_PROPERTY_FIREARM_BU.name: Fuego en ráfaga
ID_WOTC_DMG24_WEAPON_PROPERTY_FIREARM_BU.description: Como acción, puedes gastar 10 piezas de munición de un arma con Fuego en ráfaga para rociar disparos en un cubo de 10 pies dentro del alcance normal del arma. Cada criatura en el área debe superar una tirada de salvación de Destreza CD 15 o recibir el daño normal del arma.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_WEAPON_PROPERTY_FIREARM_RE.name: Recarga (2 disparos)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_WEAPON_PROPERTY_FIREARM_RE.description: Se puede realizar un número limitado de disparos (2) con un arma que tenga la propiedad Recarga. Un personaje debe entonces recargarla usando una acción o una acción adicional (a elección del personaje).

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BLESSING_OF_HEA.name: Bendición de salud
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BLESSING_OF_HEA.description: Your Constitución score increases by 2, up to a maximum of 22.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BLESSING_OF_MAG.name: Bendición de resistencia mágica
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BLESSING_OF_MAG.description: You have ventaja on tiradas de salvación against spells and other magical effects.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BLESSING_OF_PRO.name: Bendición de protección
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BLESSING_OF_PRO.description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and tiradas de salvación.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BLESSING_OF_UND.name: Bendición de entendimiento
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BLESSING_OF_UND.description: Your Sabiduría score increases by 2, up to a maximum of 22.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BLESSING_OF_VAL.name: Bendición del Valhalla

setters.keywords: magic action, action, summoning, companions, berserker, cooldown

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BLESSING_OF_VAL.description: This Blessing grants you the power to summon spirit warriors, as if you are blowing a silver Horn of Valhalla . Once you use this Blessing, you can't use it again until 7 days have passed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BLESSING_OF_WEA.name: Bendición de mejora de arma
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BLESSING_OF_WEA.description: One nonmagical weapon in your possession becomes a +1 Weapon while you wield it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BLESSING_OF_WOU.name: Bendición de cierre de heridas

setters.keywords: death saving throws, death saves, automatic success, auto-success, hit point die, hit die, hit dice, healing

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BLESSING_OF_WOU.description: This Blessing grants you the benefits of a Periapt of Wound Closure .

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHARM_OF_ANIMAL.name: Talismán de conjuración animal
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHARM_OF_ANIMAL.description: This Charm allows you to cast Conjure Animals . Once used three times, the Charm vanishes from you.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHARM_OF_DARKVI.name: Talismán de visión en la oscuridad
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHARM_OF_DARKVI.description: This Charm allows you to cast Visión en la oscuridad . Once used three times, the Charm vanishes from you.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHARM_OF_FEATHE.name: Talismán de caída de pluma
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHARM_OF_FEATHE.description: This Charm grants you the benefits of a Ring of Feather Falling . These benefits last for 10 days, after which the Charm vanishes from you.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHARM_OF_HEROIS.name: Talismán de heroísmo

setters.keywords: magic action, action, temporary hit points, thp, bless

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHARM_OF_HEROIS.description: This Charm allows you to give yourself the benefit of a Potion of Heroism como acción de Magia. Once you do so, the Charm vanishes from you.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHARM_OF_RESTOR.name: Talismán de restauración
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHARM_OF_RESTOR.description: This Charm has 3 cargas. You can expend some of its cargas to cast one of the following spells: Greater Restoration (2 cargas) or Lesser Restoration (1 carga). Once all its cargas have been expended, the Charm vanishes from you.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHARM_OF_THE_SL.name: Talismán del matador
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHARM_OF_THE_SL.description: One weapon in your possession becomes a Dragon Slayer or Giant Slayer (DM's choice) for the next 9 days. The Charm then vanishes from you, and the weapon returns to normal.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHARM_OF_VITALI.name: Talismán de vitalidad

setters.keywords: magic action, action, exhaustion, poison, healing, hit points, hit point die, hit die

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHARM_OF_VITALI.description: This Charm allows you to give yourself the benefit of a Potion of Vitality como acción de Magia. Once you do so, the Charm vanishes from you.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ARCANE_STUDY_CH.name: Talismán de estudio arcano
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ARCANE_STUDY_CH.description: After spending a descanso largo in your Bastion, you gain a magical Charm that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. The Charm allows you to cast Identify without expending a spell slot or using Material components. You can't gain this Charm again while you still have it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_OBSERVATORY_CHA.name: Talismán de observatorio
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_OBSERVATORY_CHA.description: You can use your Observatory to peer into the far corners of Wildspace and the Astral Plane. After spending a descanso largo in your Observatory, you gain a magical Charm that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. The Charm allows you to cast Contact Other Plane without expending a spell slot. You can't gain this Charm again while you still have it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RELIQUARY_CHARM.name: Talismán de relicario
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RELIQUARY_CHARM.description: After spending a descanso largo in your Bastion, you gain a magical Charm that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. The Charm allows you to cast Greater Restoration once without expending a spell slot or using Material components. You can't gain this Charm again while you still have it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SANCTUARY_CHARM.name: Talismán de santuario
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SANCTUARY_CHARM.description: After spending a descanso largo in your Bastion, you gain a magical Charm that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. The Charm allows you to cast Healing Word once without expending a spell slot. You can't gain this Charm again while you still have it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SANCTUM_CHARM.name: Talismán de sagrario
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SANCTUM_CHARM.description: After spending a descanso largo in your Bastion, you gain a magical Charm that lasts for 7 days or until you use it. The Charm allows you to cast Heal once without expending a spell slot. You can't gain this Charm again while you still have it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_ASSASSINS_BLOO.name: Sangre de asesino

setters.keywords: constitution, saving throw, save, damage, poisoned, condition

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_ASSASSINS_BLOO.description: A creature subjected to Assassin's Blood makes a CD 10 tirada de salvación de Constitución. On a failed save, the creature takes 6 (1d12) de daño de veneno and has the Venenoed condition for 24 hours. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_BURNT_OTHUR_FU.name: Vapores de othur quemado

setters.keywords: constitution, saving throw, save, damage, poisoned, condition

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_BURNT_OTHUR_FU.description: A creature subjected to Burnt Othur Fumes must succeed on a CD 13 tirada de salvación de Constitución or take 10 (3d6) de daño de veneno, and it must repeat the save at the start of each of its turns. On each successive failed save, the creature takes 3 (1d6) de daño de veneno. After three successful saves, the poison ends.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_CARRION_CRAWLE.name: Mucosidad de reptador carroñero

setters.keywords: constitution, saving throw, save, poisoned, condition, paralyzed

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_CARRION_CRAWLE.description: A creature subjected to Carrion Crawler Mucus must succeed on a CD 13 tirada de salvación de Constitución or have the Venenoed condition for 1 minute. The creature also has the Paralizado condition while Venenoed in this way. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_ESSENCE_OF_ETH.name: Esencia de éter

setters.keywords: constitution, saving throw, save, poisoned, condition, unconscious

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_ESSENCE_OF_ETH.description: A creature subjected to Essence of Ether must succeed on a CD 15 tirada de salvación de Constitución or have the Venenoed condition for 8 hours. The creature also has the Inconsciente condition while Venenoed in this way. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_LOLTHS_STING.name: Picadura de Lolth

setters.keywords: constitution, saving throw, save, poisoned, condition, unconscious

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_LOLTHS_STING.description: A creature subjected to Lolth’s Sting must succeed on a CD 13 tirada de salvación de Constitución or have the Venenoed condition for 1 hour. If the creature fails the save by 5 or more, the creature also has the Inconsciente condition while Venenoed in this way. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_MALICE.name: Malicia

setters.keywords: constitution, saving throw, save, poisoned, condition, blinded

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_MALICE.description: A creature subjected to Malice must succeed on a CD 15 tirada de salvación de Constitución or have the Venenoed condition for 1 hour. The creature also has the Cegado condition while Venenoed in this way.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_MIDNIGHT_TEARS.name: Lágrimas de medianoche

setters.keywords: constitution, saving throw, save, poisoned, condition, damage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_MIDNIGHT_TEARS.description: A creature that ingests Midnight Tears suffers no effect until the stroke of midnight. Any effect that ends the Venenoed condition neutralizes this poison. If the poison hasn't been neutralized before midnight, the creature makes a CD 17 tirada de salvación de Constitución, taking 31 (9d6) de daño de veneno on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_OIL_OF_TAGGIT.name: Aceite de taggit

setters.keywords: constitution, saving throw, save, poisoned, condition, unconscious

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_OIL_OF_TAGGIT.description: A creature subjected to Oil of Taggit must succeed on a CD 13 tirada de salvación de Constitución or have the Venenoed condition for 24 hours. The creature also has the Inconsciente condition while Venenoed in this way. It wakes up if it takes damage.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_PALE_TINCTURE.name: Tintura pálida

setters.keywords: constitution, saving throw, save, poisoned, condition, damage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_PALE_TINCTURE.description: A creature subjected to Pale Tincture must succeed on a CD 16 tirada de salvación de Constitución or take 3 (1d6) de daño de veneno and have the Venenoed condition. The Venenoed creature repeats the save every 24 hours, taking 3 (1d6) de daño de veneno on a failed save. The damage the poison deals can't be healed by any means while the creature remains Venenoed. After seven successful saves against the poison, the creature is no longer Venenoed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_PURPLE_WORM_PO.name: Veneno de gusano púrpura
ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_PURPLE_WORM_PO.description: A creature subjected to Purple Worm Veneno makes a CD 21 tirada de salvación de Constitución, taking 35 (10d6) de daño de veneno on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_SERPENT_VENOM.name: Veneno de serpiente
ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_SERPENT_VENOM.description: A creature subjected to Serpent Venom must succeed on a CD 11 tirada de salvación de Constitución, taking 10 (3d6) de daño de veneno on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_TORPOR.name: Letargo

setters.keywords: constitution, saving throw, save, poisoned, condition, slowed

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_TORPOR.description: A creature subjected to Torpor poison must succeed on a CD 15 tirada de salvación de Constitución or have the Venenoed condition for 4d6 hours. The creature's Speed is halved while the creature is Venenoed in this way.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_TRUTH_SERUM.name: Suero de la verdad

setters.keywords: constitution, saving throw, save, poisoned, condition

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_TRUTH_SERUM.description: A creature subjected to Truth Serum must succeed on a CD 11 tirada de salvación de Constitución or have the Venenoed condition for 1 hour. The Venenoed creature can't knowingly communicate a lie.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_WYVERN_POISON.name: Veneno de guiverno
ID_WOTC_DMG24_ITEM_POISON_WYVERN_POISON.description: A creature subjected to Wyvern Veneno makes a CD 14 tirada de salvación de Constitución, taking 24 (7d6) de daño de veneno on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ELIXIR_OF_HEALT.name: Elixir de salud

setters.keywords: healing, cure, blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned, lesser restoration

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ELIXIR_OF_HEALT.description:
When you drink this potion, you are cured of all magical contagions. In addition, the following conditions end on you: Cegado, Ensordecido, Paralizado, and venenoed.

The clear, red liquid has tiny bubbles of light in it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_OIL_OF_ETHEREAL.name: Aceite de eterealidad
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_OIL_OF_ETHEREAL.description: One vial of this oil can cover one Medium or smaller creature, along with the equipment it's wearing and carrying (one additional vial is required for each size category above Medium). Applying the oil takes 10 minutes. The affected creature then gains the effect of the Etherealness spell durante 1 hora.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_OIL_OF_SHARPNES.name: Aceite de filo
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_OIL_OF_SHARPNES.description: One vial of this oil can coat one Melee weapon or twenty pieces of ammunition, but only ammunition and Melee weapons that are nonmagical and deal cortante or perforante daño are affected. Applying the oil takes 1 minute, after which the oil magically seeps into whatever it coats, turning the coated weapon into a +3 Weapon or the coated ammunition into +3 Ammunition.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_OIL_OF_SLIPPERI.name: Aceite resbaladizo

setters.keywords: freedom of movement, magic action, action, grease

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_OIL_OF_SLIPPERI.description:
One vial of this oil can cover one Medium or smaller creature, along with the equipment it's wearing and carrying (one additional vial is required for each size category above Medium). Applying the oil takes 10 minutes. The affected creature then gains the effect of the Freedom of Movement spell durante 8 horas.

Alternatively, the oil can be poured on the ground como acción de Magia, where it covers a 10-foot square, duplicating the effect of the Grease spell in that area durante 8 horas.

This sticky, black unguent is thick and heavy, but it flows quickly when poured.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PHILTER_OF_LOVE.name: Filtro de amor
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PHILTER_OF_LOVE.description:
The next time you see a creature within 10 minutes after drinking this philter, you are charmed by that creature and have the Hechizado condition durante 1 hora.

This rose-hued, effervescent liquid contains one easy-to-miss bubble shaped like a heart.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_ANIMA.name: Poción de amistad con los animales
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_ANIMA.description:
When you drink this potion, you can cast the level 3 version of the Animal Friendship spell (save CD 13).

Agitating this potion's muddy liquid brings little bits into view: a fish scale, a hummingbird feather, a cat claw, or a squirrel hair.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_CLAIR.name: Poción de clarividencia
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_CLAIR.description:
When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the Clairvoyance spell (no Concentración required).

An eyeball bobs in this potion's yellowish liquid but vanishes when the potion is opened.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_CLIMB.name: Poción de escalada

setters.keywords: climb speed, speed, advantage, strength, athletics

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_CLIMB.description:
When you drink this potion, you gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed durante 1 hora. During this time, you have ventaja on Fuerza (Athletics) checks to climb.

This potion is separated into brown, silver, and gray layers resembling bands of stone. Shaking the bottle fails to mix the colors.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_COMPR.name: Poción de comprensión
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_COMPR.description:
When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the Comprehend Languages spell durante 1 hora.

This potion's liquid is a clear concoction with bits of salt and soot swirling in it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_DIMIN.name: Poción de disminución
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_DIMIN.description:
When you drink this potion, you gain the "reduce" effect of the Enlarge/Reduce spell for 1d4 hours (no Concentración required).

The red in the potion's liquid continuously contracts to a tiny bead and then expands to color the clear liquid around it. Shaking the bottle fails to interrupt this process.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_FIRE_.name: Poción de aliento de fuego

setters.keywords: bonus action, dexterity, saving throw, save, fire, damage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_FIRE_.description:
After drinking this potion, you can take a Bonus Action to exhale fire at a target within 30 pies of yourself. The target makes a CD 13 Destreza tirada de salvación, taking 4d6 fuego daño on a failed save or half as much daño on a successful one. The effect ends after you exhale the fire three times or when 1 hour has passed.

This potion's orange liquid flickers, and smoke fills the top of the container and wafts out whenever it is opened.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_FLYIN.name: Poción de vuelo
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_FLYIN.description:
When you drink this potion, you gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 1 hour and can hover. If you're in the air when the potion wears off, you fall unless you have some other means of staying aloft.

This potion's clear liquid floats at the top of its container and has cloudy white impurities drifting in it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_GASEO.name: Poción de forma gaseosa
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_GASEO.description:
When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the Gaseous Form spell for 1 hour (no Concentración required) or until you end the effect como acción adicional.

This potion's container seems to hold fog that moves and pours like water.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_HILL_.name: Poción de fuerza de gigante de las colinas

setters.keywords: strength, ability score set, ability score change

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_HILL_.description:
When you drink this potion, your Fuerza score changes to 21 durante 1 hora. The potion has no effect on you if your Fuerza is equal to or greater than that score.

This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a hill giant.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_FROST.name: Poción de fuerza de gigante de escarcha

setters.keywords: strength, ability score set, ability score change

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_FROST.description:
When you drink this potion, your Fuerza score changes to 23 durante 1 hora. The potion has no effect on you if your Fuerza is equal to or greater than that score.

This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a frost giant.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_STONE.name: Poción de fuerza de gigante de piedra

setters.keywords: strength, ability score set, ability score change

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_STONE.description:
When you drink this potion, your Fuerza score changes to 23 durante 1 hora. The potion has no effect on you if your Fuerza is equal to or greater than that score.

This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a stone giant.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_FIRE_.name: Poción de fuerza de gigante de fuego

setters.keywords: strength, ability score set, ability score change

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_FIRE_.description:
When you drink this potion, your Fuerza score changes to 25 durante 1 hora. The potion has no effect on you if your Fuerza is equal to or greater than that score.

This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a fire giant.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_CLOUD.name: Poción de fuerza de gigante de las nubes

setters.keywords: strength, ability score set, ability score change

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_CLOUD.description:
When you drink this potion, your Fuerza score changes to 27 durante 1 hora. The potion has no effect on you if your Fuerza is equal to or greater than that score.

This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a cloud giant.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_STORM.name: Poción de fuerza de gigante de las tormentas

setters.keywords: strength, ability score set, ability score change

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_STORM.description:
When you drink this potion, your Fuerza score changes to 29 durante 1 hora. The potion has no effect on you if your Fuerza is equal to or greater than that score.

This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a storm giant.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_GREAT.name: Poción de invisibilidad mayor
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_GREAT.description: This potion's container looks empty but feels as though it holds liquid. When you drink the potion, you have the Invisible condition durante 1 hora.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_GROWT.name: Poción de crecimiento
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_GROWT.description:
When you drink this potion, you gain the "enlarge" effect of the Enlarge/Reduce spell for 10 minutes (no Concentración required).

The red in the potion's liquid continuously expands from a tiny bead to color the clear liquid around it and then contracts. Shaking the bottle fails to interrupt this process.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_HEALI.name: Poción de curación
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_HEALI.description:
The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 puntos de golpe.

The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_GREAT.name: Poción de curación mayor
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_GREAT.description:
The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 4d4 + 4 puntos de golpe.

The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_SUPER.name: Poción de curación superior
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_SUPER.description:
The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 8d4 + 8 puntos de golpe.

The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_SUPRE.name: Poción de curación suprema
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_SUPRE.description:
The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 10d4 + 20 puntos de golpe.

The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_HEROI.name: Poción de heroísmo
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_HEROI.description:
When you drink this potion, you gain 10 Temporary puntos de golpe that last durante 1 hora. For the same duration, you are under the effect of the Bless spell (no Concentración required).

This potion's blue liquid bubbles and steams as if boiling.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_INVIS.name: Poción de invisibilidad
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_INVIS.description: This potion's container looks empty but feels as though it holds liquid. When you drink the potion, you have the Invisible condition durante 1 hora. The effect ends early if you make an tirada de ataque, deal daño, or cast a spell.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_INVUL.name: Poción de invulnerabilidad
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_INVUL.description:
For 1 minute after you drink this potion, you have resistencia to all daño.

This potion's syrupy liquid looks like liquefied iron.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_LONGE.name: Poción de longevidad
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_LONGE.description:
When you drink this potion, your physical age is reduced by 1d6 + 6 years, to a minimum of 13 years. Each time you subsequently drink a Potion of Longevity , there is 10 percent cumulative chance that you instead age by 1d6 + 6 years.

Suspended in this amber liquid is a tiny heart that, against all reason, is still beating. These ingredients vanish when the potion is opened.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_MIND_.name: Poción de lectura de mentes
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_MIND_.description:
When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the Detect Thoughts spell (save CD 13) for 10 minutes (no Concentración required).

This potion's dense, purple liquid has an ovoid cloud of pink floating in it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_POISO.name: Poción de veneno

setters.keywords: damage, constitution, saving throw, save, poisoned, condition

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_POISO.description:
This concoction looks, smells, and tastes like a Potion of Healing or another beneficial potion. However, it is actually poison masked by illusion magic. The Identify spell reveals its true nature.

If you drink this potion, you take 4d6 veneno daño and must succeed on a CD 13 Constitución tirada de salvación or have the venenoed condition durante 1 hora.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_PUGIL.name: Poción de pugilismo
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_PUGIL.description:
After you drink this potion, each golpe sin armas you make deals an extra 1d6 fuerza daño on a hit. This effect lasts 10 minutes.

This potion is a thick green fluid that tastes like spinach.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.name: Poción de resistencia (Ácido)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.description: Cuando bebes esta poción, obtienes resistencia al daño de ácido daño durante 1 hora.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.name: Poción de resistencia (Frío)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.description: Cuando bebes esta poción, obtienes resistencia al daño de frío daño durante 1 hora.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.name: Poción de resistencia (Fuego)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.description: Cuando bebes esta poción, obtienes resistencia al daño de fuego daño durante 1 hora.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.name: Poción de resistencia (Fuerza)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.description: Cuando bebes esta poción, obtienes resistencia al daño de fuerza daño durante 1 hora.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.name: Poción de resistencia (Relámpago)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.description: Cuando bebes esta poción, obtienes resistencia al daño de relámpago daño durante 1 hora.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.name: Poción de resistencia (Necrótico)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.description: Cuando bebes esta poción, obtienes resistencia al daño de necrótico daño durante 1 hora.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.name: Poción de resistencia (Veneno)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.description: Cuando bebes esta poción, obtienes resistencia al daño de veneno daño durante 1 hora.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.name: Poción de resistencia (Psíquico)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.description: Cuando bebes esta poción, obtienes resistencia al daño de psíquico daño durante 1 hora.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.name: Poción de resistencia (Radiante)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.description: Cuando bebes esta poción, obtienes resistencia al daño de radiante daño durante 1 hora.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.name: Poción de resistencia (Trueno)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_RESIS.description: Cuando bebes esta poción, obtienes resistencia al daño de trueno daño durante 1 hora.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_SPEED.name: Poción de velocidad
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_SPEED.description:
When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the Haste spell for 1 minute (no Concentración required) without suffering the wave of lethargy that typically occurs when the effect ends.

This potion's yellow fluid is streaked with black and swirls on its own.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_VITAL.name: Poción de vitalidad

setters.keywords: exhaustion, poison, healing, hit points, hit point die, hit die

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_VITAL.description:
When you drink this potion, it removes any Agotamiento levels you have and ends the venenoed condition on you. For the next 24 hours, you regain the maximum number of puntos de golpe for any Hit Point Die you spend.

This potion's crimson liquid regularly pulses with dull light, calling to mind a heartbeat.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_WATER.name: Poción de respiración acuática
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POTION_OF_WATER.description:
You can breathe underwater for 24 hours after drinking this potion.

This potion's cloudy green fluid smells of the sea and has a jellyfish-like bubble floating in it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_ANIMAL_.name: Anillo de influencia animal

setters.keywords: charges, recharge, dawn, animal friendship, fear, speak with animals

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_ANIMAL_.description:
This ring has 3 cargas, and it recupera 1d3 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While wearing the ring, you can expend 1 carga to cast one of the following spells (save CD 13) from it:

- Animal Friendship

- Fear (affects Beasts only)

- Speak with Animals

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_DJINNI_.name: Anillo de invocación de djinni

setters.keywords: magic action, action, djinni, summoning, companion

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_DJINNI_.description:
Mientras llevas ring, you can take a Magic action to summon a particular Djinni from the Elemental Plane of Air. The djinni appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 120 pies of yourself. It remains as long as you maintain Concentración, to a maximum of 1 hour, or until it drops to 0 puntos de golpe.

While summoned, the djinni is Friendly to you and your allies, and it obeys your commands. If you fail to command it, the djinni defends itself against attackers but takes no other actions.

After the djinni departs, it can't be summoned again for 24 hours, and the ring becomes nonmagical if the djinni dies.

Rings of Djinni Summoning are often created by the djinn they summon and given to mortals as gifts of friendship or tokens of esteem.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_AIR_ELE.name: Anillo de dominio elemental (Aire)

setters.keywords: advantage, disadvantage, magic action, action, wisdom, saving throw, save, charmed, condition, language, auran, primordial, resistance, lightning, flying speed, fly speed, speed, hover, charges, recharge, dawn, chain lightning, feather fall, gust of wind, wind wall

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_AIR_ELE.description:
This Ring of Elemental Command is linked to the Elemental Plane of Air.

Every Ring of Elemental Command has the following two properties:

Elemental Bane. While wearing the ring, you have ventaja on tiradas de ataque against Elementals and they have desventaja on tiradas de ataque against you.

Elemental Compulsion. While wearing the ring, you can take a Magic action to try to compel an Elemental you see within 60 pies of yourself. The Elemental makes a CD 18 Sabiduría tirada de salvación. On a failed save, the Elemental has the Hechizado condition until the start your next turn, and you determine what it does with its move and action on its next turn.

Elemental Focus. While wearing the ring, you benefit from additional properties corresponding to the ring's linked Elemental Plane:

Air. You know Auran, you have resistencia to relámpago daño, and you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and can hover.

Spellcasting. The ring has 5 cargas and recupera 1d4 + 1 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While wearing the ring, you can cast a spell from it. A spell cast from the ring has a save CD of 18. Choose the spell from the following list: Chain relámpago (3 cargas), Feather Fall (0 cargas), Gust of Wind (2 cargas), Wind Wall (1 carga).

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_EARTH_E.name: Anillo de dominio elemental (Tierra)

setters.keywords: advantage, disadvantage, magic action, action, wisdom, saving throw, save, charmed, condition, language, terran, primordial, resistance, acid, ignore difficult terrain, charges, recharge, dawn, earthquake, stone shape, stoneskin, wall of stone

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_EARTH_E.description:
This Ring of Elemental Command is linked to the Elemental Plane of Earth.

Every Ring of Elemental Command has the following two properties:

Elemental Bane. While wearing the ring, you have ventaja on tiradas de ataque against Elementals and they have desventaja on tiradas de ataque against you.

Elemental Compulsion. While wearing the ring, you can take a Magic action to try to compel an Elemental you see within 60 pies of yourself. The Elemental makes a CD 18 Sabiduría tirada de salvación. On a failed save, the Elemental has the Hechizado condition until the start your next turn, and you determine what it does with its move and action on its next turn.

Elemental Focus. While wearing the ring, you benefit from additional properties corresponding to the ring's linked Elemental Plane:

Earth. You know Terran, and you have resistencia to ácido daño. Terrain composed of rubble, rocks, or dirt isn't Difficult Terrain for you. In addition, you can move through solid earth or rock as if those areas were Difficult Terrain without disturbing the matter through which you pass. If you end your turn in solid earth or rock, you are shunted out to the nearest unoccupied space you last occupied.

Spellcasting. The ring has 5 cargas and recupera 1d4 + 1 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While wearing the ring, you can cast a spell from it. A spell cast from the ring has a save CD of 18. Choose the spell from the following list: Earthquake (5 cargas), Stone Shape (2 cargas), Stoneskin (3 cargas), Wall of Stone (3 cargas)

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_FIRE_EL.name: Anillo de dominio elemental (Fuego)

setters.keywords: advantage, disadvantage, magic action, action, wisdom, saving throw, save, charmed, condition, language, ignan, primordial, resistance, fire, charges, recharge, dawn, burning hands, fireball, fire storm, wall of fire

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_FIRE_EL.description:
This Ring of Elemental Command is linked to the Elemental Plane of fuego.

Every Ring of Elemental Command has the following two properties:

Elemental Bane. While wearing the ring, you have ventaja on tiradas de ataque against Elementals and they have desventaja on tiradas de ataque against you.

Elemental Compulsion. While wearing the ring, you can take a Magic action to try to compel an Elemental you see within 60 pies of yourself. The Elemental makes a CD 18 Sabiduría tirada de salvación. On a failed save, the Elemental has the Hechizado condition until the start your next turn, and you determine what it does with its move and action on its next turn.

Elemental Focus. While wearing the ring, you benefit from additional properties corresponding to the ring's linked Elemental Plane:

fuego. You know Ignan, and you have inmunidad to fuego daño.

Spellcasting. The ring has 5 cargas and recupera 1d4 + 1 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While wearing the ring, you can cast a spell from it. A spell cast from the ring has a save CD of 18. Choose the spell from the following list: Burning Hands (1 carga), fuegoball (2 cargas), fuego Storm (4 cargas), Wall of fuego (3 cargas)

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_WATER_E.name: Anillo de dominio elemental (Agua)

setters.keywords: advantage, disadvantage, magic action, action, wisdom, saving throw, save, charmed, condition, language, aquan, primordial, swimming speed, swim speed, speed, breathe underwater, charges, recharge, dawn, create or destroy water, ice storm, tsunami, wall of ice, water walk

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_WATER_E.description:
This Ring of Elemental Command is linked to the Elemental Plane of Water.

Every Ring of Elemental Command has the following two properties:

Elemental Bane. While wearing the ring, you have ventaja on tiradas de ataque against Elementals and they have desventaja on tiradas de ataque against you.

Elemental Compulsion. While wearing the ring, you can take a Magic action to try to compel an Elemental you see within 60 pies of yourself. The Elemental makes a CD 18 Sabiduría tirada de salvación. On a failed save, the Elemental has the Hechizado condition until the start your next turn, and you determine what it does with its move and action on its next turn.

Elemental Focus. While wearing the ring, you benefit from additional properties corresponding to the ring's linked Elemental Plane:

Water. You know Aquan, you gain a Swim Speed of 60 pies, and you can breathe underwater.

Spellcasting. The ring has 5 cargas and recupera 1d4 + 1 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While wearing the ring, you can cast a spell from it. A spell cast from the ring has a save CD of 18. Choose the spell from the following list: Create or Destroy Water (1 carga), Ice Storm (2 cargas), Tsunami (5 cargas), Wall of Ice (3 cargas), Water Walk (2 cargas).

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_EVASION.name: Anillo de evasión

setters.keywords: charges, recharge, dawn, reaction, automatic success, auto success

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_EVASION.description: This ring has 3 cargas, and it recupera 1d3 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. When you fail a Destreza tirada de salvación while wearing the ring, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 carga to succeed on that save instead.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_FEATHER.name: Anillo de caída de pluma
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_FEATHER.description: When you fall while wearing this ring, you descend 60 pies per round and take no daño from falling.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_FREE_AC.name: Anillo de libre acción
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_FREE_AC.description: While you wear this ring, Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement. In addition, magic can neither reduce any of your Speeds nor cause you to have the Paralizado or Apresado condition.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_INVISIB.name: Anillo de invisibilidad

setters.keywords: magic action, action, invisible, condition, bonus action

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_INVISIB.description: Mientras llevas ring, you can take a Magic action to give yourself the Invisible condition. You remain Invisible until the ring is removed or until you take a Bonus Action to become visible again.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_JUMPING.name: Anillo de salto
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_JUMPING.description: Mientras llevas ring, you can cast the Jump spell from it, but can target only yourself when you do so.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_MIND_SH.name: Anillo de escudo mental

setters.keywords: anti-divination, anti-enchantment, magic action, action, telepathic communication, telepathy

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_MIND_SH.description:
Mientras llevas ring, you are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts, determine whether you are lying, know your alignment, or know your creature type. Creatures can telepathically communicate with you only if you allow it.

You can take a Magic action to cause the ring to become imperceptible until you take another Magic action to make it perceptible, until you remove the ring, or until you die.

If you die while wearing the ring, your soul enters it, unless it already houses a soul. You can remain in the ring or depart for the afterlife. As long as your soul is in the ring, you can telepathically communicate with any creature wearing it. A wearer can't prevent this telepathic communication.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_PROTECT.name: Anillo de protección

setters.keywords: armor class, ac, saving throws, saves, strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom, charisma

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_PROTECT.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Clase de Armadura and tiradas de salvación while wearing this ring.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_REGENER.name: Anillo de regeneración
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_REGENER.description: Mientras llevas ring, you regain 1d6 puntos de golpe every 10 minutes if you have at least 1 Hit Point. If you lose a body part, the ring causes the missing part to regrow and return to full functionality after 1d6 + 1 days if you have at least 1 Hit Point the whole time.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.name: Anillo de resistencia (Ácido)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.description: You have resistencia to ácido daño while wearing this ring. The ring is set with pearl.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.name: Anillo de resistencia (Frío)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.description: You have resistencia to frío daño while wearing this ring. The ring is set with tourmaline.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.name: Anillo de resistencia (Fuego)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.description: You have resistencia to fuego daño while wearing this ring. The ring is set with garnet.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.name: Anillo de resistencia (Fuerza)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.description: You have resistencia to fuerza daño while wearing this ring. The ring is set with sapphire.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.name: Anillo de resistencia (Relámpago)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.description: You have resistencia to relámpago daño while wearing this ring. The ring is set with citrine.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.name: Anillo de resistencia (Necrótico)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.description: You have resistencia to necrótico daño while wearing this ring. The ring is set with jet.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.name: Anillo de resistencia (Veneno)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.description: You have resistencia to veneno daño while wearing this ring. The ring is set with amethyst.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.name: Anillo de resistencia (Psíquico)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.description: You have resistencia to psíquico daño while wearing this ring. The ring is set with jade.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.name: Anillo de resistencia (Radiante)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.description: You have resistencia to radiante daño while wearing this ring. The ring is set with topaz.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.name: Anillo de resistencia (Trueno)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_RESISTA.description: You have resistencia to trueno daño while wearing this ring. The ring is set with spinel.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_SHOOTIN.name: Anillo de estrellas fugaces

setters.keywords: dancing lights, light, charges, recharge, dawn, faerie fire, dim light, bonus action, dexterity, saving throw, save, lightning, damage, magic action, action, cube, radiant

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_SHOOTIN.description:
You can cast Dancing Lights or Light from the ring.

The ring has 6 cargas and recupera 1d6 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. You can expend its cargas to use the properties below.

Faerie fuego. You can expend 1 carga to cast Faerie fuego from the ring.

relámpago Spheres. You can expend 2 cargas como acción de Magia to create up to four 3-foot-diameter spheres of lightning

Each sphere appears in an unoccupied space you can see within 120 pies of yourself. The spheres last as long as you maintain Concentración, up to 1 minute. Each sphere sheds Dim Light in a 30-foot radius.

Como acción adicional, you can move each sphere up to 30 pies, but no farther than 120 pies away from yourself. The first time the sphere comes within 5 pies of a creature other than you that isn't behind Total Cover, the sphere discargas lightning at that creature and disappears. That creature makes a CD 15 Destreza tirada de salvación. On a failed save, the creature takes relámpago daño based on the number of spheres you created, as shown in the following table. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much daño.

Spheres | relámpago Damage
1 | 4d12
2 | 5d4
3 | 2d6
4 | 2d4

Shooting Stars. You can expend 1 to 3 cargas como acción de Magia. For every carga you expend, you launch a glowing mote of light from the ring at a point you can see within 60 pies of yourself. Each creature in a 15-foot Cube originating from that point is showered in sparks and makes a CD 15 Destreza tirada de salvación, taking 5d4 radiante daño on a failed save or half as much daño on a successful one.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_SPELL_S.name: Anillo almacenador de conjuros
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_SPELL_S.description:
This ring stores spells cast into it, holding them until the attuned wearer uses them. The ring can store up to 5 levels worth of spells at a time. When found, it contains 1d6 - 1 levels of stored spells chosen by the DM.

Any creature can cast a spell of level 1 through 5 into the ring by touching the ring as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect other than to be stored in the ring. If the ring can't hold the spell, the spell is expended without effect. The level of the slot used to cast the spell determines how much space it uses.

Mientras llevas ring, you can cast any spell stored in it. The spell uses the slot level, CD de salvación de conjuros, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster but is otherwise treated as if you cast the spell. The spell cast from the ring is no longer stored in it, freeing up space.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_SPELL_T.name: Anillo de rebote de conjuros

setters.keywords: advantage, saving throws, saves, magic resistance, reaction

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_SPELL_T.description: Mientras llevas ring, you have ventaja on tiradas de salvación against spells. If you succeed on the save for a spell of level 7 or lower, the spell has no effect on you. If that spell targeted only you and didn't create an area of effect, you can take a Reaction to deflect the spell back at the spell's caster; the caster must make a tirada de salvación against the spell using their own CD de salvación de conjuros.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_SWIMMIN.name: Anillo de natación
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_SWIMMIN.description: You have a Swim Speed of 40 pies while wearing this ring.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_TELEKIN.name: Anillo de telequinesis
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_TELEKIN.description: Mientras llevas ring, you can cast Telekinesis from it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_THE_RAM.name: Anillo del carnero

setters.keywords: charges, recharge, dawn, force, damage, magic action, action, strength, ability check, check

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_THE_RAM.description:
This ring has 3 cargas and recupera 1d3 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While wearing the ring, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 to 3 cargas to make a ranged spell attack against one creature you can see within 60 pies of yourself. The ring produces a spectral ram's head and makes its tirada de ataque with a +7 bonus. On a hit, for each carga you spend, the target takes 2d10 fuerza daño and is pushed 5 pies away from you.

Alternatively, you can expend 1 to 3 of the ring's cargas como acción de Magia to try to break a nonmagical object you can see within 60 pies of yourself that isn't being worn or carried. The ring makes a Fuerza check with a +5 bonus for each carga you spend.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_THREE_W.name: Anillo de los tres deseos
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_THREE_W.description: Mientras llevas ring, you can expend 1 of its 3 cargas to cast Wish from it. The ring becomes nonmagical when you use the last carga.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_WARMTH.name: Anillo de calidez
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_WARMTH.description:
If you take frío daño while wearing this ring, the ring reduces the daño you take by 2d8.

In addition, while wearing this ring, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_WATER_W.name: Anillo de caminar sobre el agua
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_WATER_W.description: Mientras llevas ring, you cast Water Walk from it, targeting only yourself.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_XRAY_VI.name: Anillo de visión de rayos X
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RING_OF_XRAY_VI.description:
Mientras llevas ring, you can take a Magic action to gain X-ray vision with a range of 30 pies durante 1 minuto. To you, solid objects within that radius appear transparent and don't prevent light from passing through them. The vision can penetrate 1 pie of stone, 1 inch of common metal, or up to 3 pies of wood or dirt. Thicker substances or a thin sheet of lead block the vision.

Whenever you use the ring again before taking a descanso largo, you must succeed on a CD 15 Constitución tirada de salvación or gain 1 Agotamiento level.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_IMMOVABLE_ROD.name: Cetro inamovible
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_IMMOVABLE_ROD.description: This iron rod has a button on one end. You can take a Utilize action to press the button, which causes the rod to become magically fixed in place. Until you or another creature takes a Utilize action to push the button again, the rod doesn't move, even if it defies gravity. The rod can hold up to 8,000 pounds of weight. More weight causes the rod to deactivate and fall. A creature can take a Utilize action to make a CD 30 Fuerza (Athletics) check, moving the fixed rod up to 10 pies on a successful check.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_ABSORPTI.name: Cetro de absorción
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_ABSORPTI.description:
Mientras empuñas rod, you can take a Reaction to absorb a spell that is targeting only you and doesn't create an area of effect. The absorbed spell's effect is canceled, and the spell's energy—not the spell itself—is stored in the rod. The energy has the same level as the spell when it was cast. A canceled spell dissipates with no effect, and any resources used to cast it are wasted. The rod can absorb and store up to 50 levels of energy over the course of its existence. Once the rod absorbs 50 levels of energy, it can't absorb more. If you are targeted by a spell that the rod can't store, the rod has no effect on that spell.

When you become attuned to the rod, you know how many levels of energy the rod has absorbed over the course of its existence and how many levels of spell energy it currently has stored.

If you are a spellcaster holding the rod, you can convert energy stored in it into spell slots to cast spells you have prepared or know. You can create spell slots only of a level equal to or lower than your own spell slots, up to a maximum of level 5. You use the stored levels in place of your slots but otherwise cast the spell as normal. For example, you can use 3 levels stored in the rod as a level 3 spell slot.

A newly found rod typically has 1d10 levels of spell energy stored in it. A rod that can no longer absorb spell energy and has no energy remaining becomes nonmagical.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_ALERTNES.name: Cetro de alerta

setters.keywords: advantage, wisdom, perception, ability checks, skill checks, checks, initiative, detect evil and good, detect magic, detect poison and disease, see invisibility, magic action, action, bright light, dim light, ac, armor class

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_ALERTNES.description:
This rod has the following properties.

Alertness. While holding the rod, you have ventaja on Sabiduría (Perception) checks and on Initiative rolls.

Spells. While holding the rod, you can cast the following spells from it:

- Detect Evil and Good

- Detect Magic

- Detect veneno and Disease

- See Invisibility

Protective Aura. Como acción de Magia, you can plant the haft end of the rod in the ground, whereupon the rod's head sheds Bright Light in a 60-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 60 pies. While in that Bright Light, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to Clase de Armadura and tiradas de salvación and can sense the location of any Invisible creature that is also in the Bright Light.

The rod's head stops glowing and the effect ends after 10 minutes or when a creature takes a Magic action to pull the rod from the ground. Once used, this property can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_LORDLY_M.name: Cetro de poder señorial

setters.keywords: mace, enhancement, bonus action, bright light, dim light, longsword, shortsword, fire, damage, battleaxe, spear, pole, climbing pole, battering ram, strength, athletics, ability checks, skill checks, checks, constitution, saving throw, save, necrotic, drain life, paralized, condition, magic action, action, wisdom, frightened

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_LORDLY_M.description:
This rod has a flanged head, and it functions as a magic Mace that grants a +3 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with it. The rod has properties associated with six different buttons that are set in a row along the haft. It has three other properties as well, detailed below.

Buttons. You can press one of the following buttons como acción adicional; a button's effect lasts until you push a different button or until you push the same button again, which causes the rod to revert to its normal form:

Button 1. A fiery blade sprouts from the end opposite the rod's flanged head. The flames shed Bright Light in a 40-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 40 pies, and the blade functions as a magic Longsword or Shortsword (your choice) that deals an extra 2d6 fuego daño on a hit.

Button 2. The rod's flanged head folds down and two crescent-shaped blades spring out, transforming the rod into a magic Battleaxe that grants a +3 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with it.

Button 3. The rod's flanged head folds down, a spear point springs from the rod's tip, and the rod's handle lengthens into a 6-foot haft, transforming the rod into a magic Spear that grants a +3 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with it.

Button 4. The rod transforms into a climbing pole up to 50 pies long (you specify the length), though the rod's buttons remain within your reach. In surfaces as hard as granite, a spike at the bottom and three hooks at the top anchor the pole. Horizontal bars 3 inches long fold out from the sides, 1 pie apart, forming a ladder. The pole can bear up to 4,000 pounds. More weight or lack of solid anchoring causes the rod to revert to its normal form.

Button 5. The rod transforms into a handheld battering ram and grants its user a +10 bonus to Fuerza (Athletics) checks made to break through doors, barricades, and other barriers.

Button 6. The rod assumes or remains in its normal form and indicates magnetic north. (Nothing happens if this function of the rod is used in a location that has no magnetic north.) The rod also gives you knowledge of your approximate depth beneath the ground or your height above it.

Drain Life. When you hit a creature with a melee attack using the rod, you can force the target to make a CD 17 Constitución tirada de salvación. On a failed save, the target takes an extra 4d6 necrótico daño, and you regain a number of puntos de golpe equal to half that necrótico daño. Once used, this property can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

Paralyze. When you hit a creature with a melee attack using the rod, you can force the target to make a CD 17 Constitución tirada de salvación. On a failed save, the target has the Paralizado condition durante 1 minuto. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Once used, this property can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

Terrify. While holding the rod, you can take a Magic action to force each creature you can see within 30 pies of yourself to make a CD 17 Sabiduría tirada de salvación. On a failed save, a target has the Asustado condition durante 1 minuto. A Asustado target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once used, this property can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_RESURREC.name: Cetro de resurrección
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_RESURREC.description:
The rod has 5 cargas. While you hold it, you can cast one of the following spells from it: Heal (1 carga) or Resurrection (5 cargas).

The rod regains 1 expended carga diariamente al amanecer. If you expend the last carga, roll 1d20. On a 1, the rod disappears in a harmless burst of radiance.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_RULERSHI.name: Cetro de gobierno

setters.keywords: magic action, action, wisdom, saving throw, save, charmed, condition, cooldown, dawn

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_RULERSHI.description: You can take a Magic action to present the rod and command obedience from each creature of your choice that you can see within 120 pies of yourself. Each target must succeed on a CD 15 Sabiduría tirada de salvación or have the Hechizado condition durante 8 horas. While Hechizado in this way, the creature regards you as its trusted leader. If harmed by you or your allies or commanded to do something contrary to its nature, a target ceases to be Hechizado in this way. Once used, this property can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_SECURITY.name: Cetro de seguridad

setters.keywords: magic action, action, demiplane, hit points, hit point die, hp, hit die

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_SECURITY.description:
Mientras empuñas rod, you can take a Magic action to activate it. The rod then instantly transports you and up to 199 other willing creatures you can see to a demiplane. You choose the form the demiplane takes. It could be a tranquil garden, a cheery tavern, an immense palace, a tropical island, a fantastic carnival, or whatever else you can imagine. Regardless of its nature, the demiplane contains enough water and food to sustain its visitors, and the demiplane's environment can't harm its occupants. Everything else that can be interacted with there can exist only there. For example, a flower picked from a garden there disappears if it is taken outside the demiplane.

For each hour spent in the demiplane, a visitor regains puntos de golpe as if it had spent 1 Hit Point Die. Also, creatures don't age while there, although time passes normally. Visitors can remain there for up to 200 days divided by the number of creatures present (round down).

When the time runs out or you take a Magic action to end the effect, all visitors reappear in the location they occupied when you activated the rod or an unoccupied space nearest that location. Once used, this property can't be used again until 10 days have passed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_THE_PACT.name: Cetro del guardián del pacto +1

setters.keywords: warlock, spell attack rolls, spell save DC, spell slot, magic action, cooldown

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_THE_PACT.description:
Mientras empuñas rod, you gain a +1 bonus to spell tiradas de ataque and to the tirada de salvación DCs of your Warlock spells.

In addition, you can regain one spell slot como acción de Magia while holding the rod. You can't use this property again until you finish a descanso largo.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_THE_PACT.name: Cetro del guardián del pacto +2

setters.keywords: warlock, spell attack rolls, spell save DC, spell slot, magic action, cooldown

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_THE_PACT.description:
Mientras empuñas rod, you gain a +2 bonus to spell tiradas de ataque and to the tirada de salvación DCs of your Warlock spells.

In addition, you can regain one spell slot como acción de Magia while holding the rod. You can't use this property again until you finish a descanso largo.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_THE_PACT.name: Cetro del guardián del pacto +3

setters.keywords: warlock, spell attack rolls, spell save DC, spell slot, magic action, cooldown

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROD_OF_THE_PACT.description:
Mientras empuñas rod, you gain a +3 bonus to spell tiradas de ataque and to the tirada de salvación DCs of your Warlock spells.

In addition, you can regain one spell slot como acción de Magia while holding the rod. You can't use this property again until you finish a descanso largo.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TENTACLE_ROD.name: Cetro de tentáculos

setters.keywords: magic action, action, psychic, damage, dexterity, saving throw, saves, restrained, condition, bonus action

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TENTACLE_ROD.description: This rod ends in three rubbery tentacles. While holding the rod, you can take a Magic action to direct the tentacles to stretch outward, each one attacking a creature you can see within 15 pies of yourself. For each tentacle, make a melee tirada de ataque with a +9 bonus. A tentacle deals 1d6 psíquico daño on a hit. If you hit the same target with all three tentacles, the target must succeed on a CD 15 Destreza tirada de salvación or have the Apresado condition until you have the Incapacitado condition, until you take a Bonus Action to release the target, or until the target is no longer within 15 pies of you. While Apresado in this way, the target takes 3d6 psíquico daño at the start of each of its turns. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SCROLL_OF_PROTE.name: Pergamino de protección (Aberraciones)

setters.keywords: magic action, action, emanation, charisma, saving throw, save

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SCROLL_OF_PROTE.description:
Using a Magic action to read the scroll creates a 5-foot Emanation originating from you. For 5 minutes, Aberrations can't enter or affect anything in the area. However, if you move in such a way that an Aberration would be inside the area, the effect ends.

Como acción de Magia, a creature within 5 pies of the Emanation can attempt to overcome it, which forces the creature to make a CD 15 Carisma tirada de salvación. On a successful save, the creature ceases to be affected by the Emanation.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SCROLL_OF_PROTE.name: Pergamino de protección (Bestias)

setters.keywords: magic action, action, emanation, charisma, saving throw, save

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SCROLL_OF_PROTE.description:
Using a Magic action to read the scroll creates a 5-foot Emanation originating from you. For 5 minutes, Beasts can't enter or affect anything in the area. However, if you move in such a way that an Beast would be inside the area, the effect ends.

Como acción de Magia, a creature within 5 pies of the Emanation can attempt to overcome it, which forces the creature to make a CD 15 Carisma tirada de salvación. On a successful save, the creature ceases to be affected by the Emanation.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SCROLL_OF_TITAN.name: Pergamino de invocación de titán (Señor de los animales)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SCROLL_OF_TITAN.description:
When you take a Magic action to read this scroll, an Animal Lord appears in an unoccupied space on the ground or in water that you can see within 1 mile of yourself.

The Animal Lord is Hostile toward all other creatures and disappears when it drops to 0 puntos de golpe. If the Animal Lord is summoned into a space that isn't large enough to contain it, the summoning fails, and the scroll is wasted.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SPELL_SCROLL_CA.name: Pergamino de conjuro (Truco)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SPELL_SCROLL_CA.description:
A Spell Scroll bears the words of a single spell, written in a mystical cipher. If the spell is on your spell list, you can read the scroll and cast its spell without Material components. Otherwise, the scroll is unintelligible. Casting the spell by reading the scroll requires the spell's normal casting time. Once the spell is cast, the scroll crumbles to dust. If the casting is interrupted, the scroll isn't lost.

If the spell is on your spell list but of a higher level than you can normally cast, you make a CD 10 prueba de característica using your spellcasting ability to determine whether you cast the spell. On a failed check, the spell disappears from the scroll with no other effect.

If the spell requires a tirada de salvación or an tirada de ataque, the CD de salvación de conjuros is 13, and the attack bonus is +5.

Copying a Scroll into a Spellbook. A Wizard spell on a Spell Scroll can be copied into a spellbook. When a cantrip is copied in this way, the copier must succeed on a CD 10 Inteligencia (Arcana). On a successful check, the spell is copied. Whether the check succeeds or fails, the Spell Scroll is destroyed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ENSPELLED_STAFF.name: Bastón hechizado (Truco)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ENSPELLED_STAFF.description:
Bound into this staff is a cantrip. The cantrip is determined when the staff is created and can be of any school of magic. The staff has 6 cargas and recupera 1d6 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While holding the staff, you can expend 1 carga to cast its spell. If you expend the staff's last carga, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff loses its properties and becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff.

The cantrip's tirada de salvación CD is 13, and its attack bonus is +5.

The staff can have up to three such objects floating over its tip at any given time. While holding the staff, you can make one or more of the objects slowly spin or turn in place.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_BIRDCA.name: Bastón de cantos de aves
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_BIRDCA.description:
This wooden staff is decorated with bird carvings. It has 10 cargas. While holding it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 carga from the staff and cause it to create one of the following sounds, which can be heard out to 120 pies: a finch's chirp, a raven's caw, a duck's quack, a chicken's cluck, a goose's honk, a loon's call, a turkey's gobble, a seagull's cry, an owl's hoot, or an eagle's shriek.

Regaining Charges. The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended cargas diariamente al amanecer. If you expend the last carga, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff explodes in a harmless cloud of bird feathers and is lost forever.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_CHARMI.name: Bastón de hechizar
