attunement.addition: by a Bard, Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_CHARMI.description:
This staff has 10 cargas. While holding the staff, you can use any of its properties:

Cast Spell. You can expend 1 of the staff's cargas to cast Charm Person , Command , or Comprehend Languages from it using your CD de salvación de conjuros.

Reflect Enchantment. If you succeed on a tirada de salvación against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 carga from the staff and turn the spell back on its caster as if you had cast the spell.

Resist Enchantment. If you fail a tirada de salvación against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a successful one. You can't use this property of the staff again hasta el próximo amanecer.

Regaining Charges. The staff regains 1d8 + 2 expended cargas diariamente al amanecer. If you expend the last carga, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff crumbles to dust and is destroyed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_POWER.description:
This staff has 20 cargas and can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with it. While holding it, you gain a +2 bonus to Clase de Armadura, tiradas de salvación, and spell tiradas de ataque.

Spells. While holding the staff , you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your CD de salvación de conjuros. The table indicates how many cargas you must expend to cast the spell.

Spell | Charge Cost
Cone of frío | 5
fuegoball (level 5 version) | 5
Globe of Invulnerability | 6
Hold Monster | 5
Levitate | 2
relámpago Bolt (level 5 version) | 5
Magic Missile | 1
Ray of Enfeeblement | 1
Wall of fuerza | 5

Regaining Charges. The staff regains 2d8 + 4 expended cargas diariamente al amanecer. If you expend the last carga, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño but loses all other properties. On a 20, the staff regains 1d8 + 2 cargas.

Retributive Strike. You can take a Magic action to break the staff over your knee or against a solid surface. The staff is destroyed and releases its magic in an explosion that fills a 30-foot Emanation originating from itself. You have a 50 percent chance to instantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoiding the explosion. If you fail to avoid the effect, you take fuerza daño equal to 16 times the number of cargas in the staff . Each other creature in the area makes a CD 17 Destreza tirada de salvación. On a failed save, a creature takes fuerza daño equal to 4 times the number of cargas in the staff . On a successful save, a creature takes half as much daño.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_STRIKI.name: Bastón de impacto

setters.keywords: enhancement, charges, recharges, dawn, force, damage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_STRIKI.description:
This staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +3 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with it.

The staff has 10 cargas. When you hit with a melee attack using it, you can expend up to 3 cargas. For each carga you expend, the target takes an extra 1d6 fuerza daño.

Regaining Charges. The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended cargas diariamente al amanecer. If you expend the last carga, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_SWARMI.name: Bastón de enjambre de insectos

setters.keywords: bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, wizard, charge, recharges, dawn, magic action, action, heavily obscured, giant insect, insect plague

attunement.addition: by a Bard, Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_SWARMI.description:
This staff has 10 cargas.

Insect Cloud. While holding the staff, you can take a Magic action and expend 1 carga to cause a swarm of harmless flying insects to fill a 30-foot Emanation originating from you. The insects remain for 10 minutes, making the area Heavily Obscured for creatures other than you. A strong wind (like that created by Gust of Wind ) disperses the swarm and ends the effect.

Spells. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your CD de salvación de conjuros and spell attack modifier. The table indicates how many cargas you must expend to cast the spell.

Spell | Charge Cost
Giant Insect | 4
Insect Plague | 5

Regaining Charges. The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended cargas diariamente al amanecer. If you expend the last carga, roll 1d20. On a 1, a swarm of insects consumes and destroys the staff, then disperses.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_THE_AD.name: Bastón de la víbora

setters.keywords: bonus action, attack action, piercing, poison, damage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_THE_AD.description:
Como acción adicional, you can turn the head of this staff into that of an animate, venomous snake for 1 minute or revert the staff to its inanimate form.

When you take the Attack action, you can make one of the tiradas de ataque using the animated snake head, which has a reach of 5 pies. Apply your bonificador por competencia and Sabiduría modifier to the tirada de ataque. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 perforante daño and 3d6 veneno daño.

The snake head can be attacked while it is animate. It has AC 15, HP 20, and inmunidad to veneno and psíquico daño. If the head drops to 0 puntos de golpe, the staff is destroyed. As long as it's not destroyed, the staff regains all lost puntos de golpe when it reverts to its inanimate form.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_THE_MA.name: Bastón de los magos

setters.keywords: enhancement, sorcerer, warlock, wizard, charges, recharge, dawn, spell attack bonus, magic resistance, advantage, saving throws, saves, reaction, arcane lock, conjure elemental, detect magic, dispel magic, enlarge/reduce, reduce, fireball, flaming sphere, ice storm, invisibility, knock, light, lightning bolt, mage hand, passwall, plane shift, protection from evil and good, telekinesis, wall of fire, web, magic action, action, emanation, force, damage, dexterity

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_THE_MA.description:
This staff has 50 cargas and can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with it. While you hold it, you gain a +2 bonus to spell tiradas de ataque.

Spell Absorption. While holding the staff , you have ventaja on tiradas de salvación against spells. In addition, you can take a Reaction when another creature casts a spell that targets only you. If you do, the staff absorbs the magic of the spell, canceling its effect and gaining a number of cargas equal to the absorbed spell's level. However, if doing so brings the staff's total number of cargas above 50, the staff explodes as if you activated its Retributive Strike (see below).

Spells. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your CD de salvación de conjuros. The table indicates how many cargas you must expend to cast the spell.

Spell | Charge Cost
Arcane Lock | 0
Conjure Elemental | 7
Detect Magic | 0
Dispel Magic | 3
Enlarge/Reduce | 0
fuegoball (level 7 version) | 7
Flaming Sphere | 2
Ice Storm | 4
Invisibility | 2
Knock | 2
Light | 0
relámpago Bolt (level 7 version) | 7
Mage Hand | 0
Passwall | 5
Plane Shift | 7
Protection from Evil and Good | 2
Telekinesis | 5
Wall of fuego | 4
Web | 2

Regaining Charges. The staff regains 4d6 + 2 expended cargas diariamente al amanecer. If you expend the last carga, roll 1d20. On a 20, the staff regains 1d12 + 1 cargas.

Retributive Strike. You can take a Magic action to break the staff over your knee or against a solid surface. The staff is destroyed and releases its magic in an explosion that fills a 30-foot Emanation originating from itself. You have a 50 percent chance to instantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoiding the explosion. If you fail to avoid the effect, you take fuerza daño equal to 16 times the number of cargas in the staff. Each other creature in the area makes a CD 17 Destreza tirada de salvación. On a failed save, a creature takes fuerza daño equal to 6 times the number of cargas in the staff. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much daño.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_THE_PY.name: Bastón de la pitón

setters.keywords: magic action, action, giant constrictor snake, companion, bonus action

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_THE_PY.description:
Como acción de Magia, you can throw this staff so that it lands in an unoccupied space within 10 pies of you, causing the staff to become a Giant Constrictor Snake in that space. The snake is under your control and shares your Initiative count, taking its turn immediately after yours.

On your turn, you can mentally command the snake (no action required) if it is within 60 pies of you and you don't have the Incapacitado condition. You decide what action the snake takes and where it moves during its turn, or you can issue it a general command, such as to attack your enemies or guard a location. Absent commands from you, the snake defends itself.

Como acción adicional, you can command the snake to revert to staff form in its current space, and you can't use the staff's property again durante 1 hora. If the snake is reduced to 0 puntos de golpe, it dies and reverts to its staff form; the staff then shatters and is destroyed. If the snake reverts to staff form before losing all its puntos de golpe, it regains all of them.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_THE_WO.name: Bastón de los bosques

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_THE_WO.description:
This staff has 6 cargas and can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with it. While holding it, you have a +2 bonus to spell tiradas de ataque.

Spells. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your CD de salvación de conjuros. The table indicates how many cargas you must expend to cast the spell.

Spell | Charge Cost
Animal Friendship | 1
Awaken | 5
Barkskin | 2
Locate Animals or Plants | 2
Pass without Trace | 2
Speak with Animals | 1
Speak with Plants | 3
Wall of Thorns | 6

Tree Form. You can take a Magic action to plant one end of the staff in earth in an unoccupied space and expend 1 carga to transform the staff into a healthy tree. The tree is 60 pies tall and has a 5-foot-diameter trunk, and its branches at the top spread out in a 20-foot radius. The tree appears ordinary but radiates a faint aura of Transmutation magic that can be discerned with the Detect Magic spell . While touching the tree and using a Magic action, you return the staff to its normal form. Any creature in the tree falls when the tree reverts to a staff.

Regaining Charges. The staff recupera 1d6 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. If you expend the last carga, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff loses its properties and becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_THUNDE.name: Bastón de truenos y relámpagos

setters.keywords: enhancement, lightning, damage, constitution, saving throw, save, stunned, condition, bonus action, magic action, action, line, dexterity, thunder, deafened

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_THUNDE.description:
This staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with it. It also has the following additional properties. Once one of these properties is used, it can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

relámpago. When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can cause the target to take an extra 2d6 relámpago daño (no action required).

trueno. When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can cause the staff to emit a crack of thunder audible out to 300 pies (no action required). The target you hit must succeed on a CD 17 Constitución tirada de salvación or have the Aturdido condition until the end of your next turn.

trueno and relámpago. Immediately after you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can take a Bonus Action to use the relámpago and trueno properties (see above) at the same time. Doing so doesn't expend the daily use of those properties, only the use of this one.

relámpago Strike. You can take a Magic action to cause a bolt of lightning to leap from the staff's tip in a Line that is 5 pies wide and 120 pies long. Each creature in that Line makes a CD 17 Destreza tirada de salvación, taking 9d6 relámpago daño on a failed save or half as much daño on a successful one.

truenoclap. You can take a Magic action to cause the staff to produce a thunderclap audible out to 600 pies. Every creature within a 60-foot Emanation originating from you makes a CD 17 Constitución tirada de salvación. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 trueno daño and has the Ensordecido condition durante 1 minuto. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much daño only.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_WITHER.name: Bastón de marchitamiento

setters.keywords: charges, recharge, dawn, necrotic, damage, constitution, saving throws, saves, disadvantage, strength, ability checks, skill checks, checks

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STAFF_OF_WITHER.description:

The staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff. On a hit, it deals daño as a normal Quarterstaff , and you can expend 1 carga to deal an extra 2d10 necrótico daño to the target and force it to make a CD 15 Constitución tirada de salvación. On a failed save, the target has desventaja for 1 hour on any prueba de característica or tirada de salvación that uses Fuerza or Constitución.

setters.keywords: charges, recharge, dawn, hold monster, hold person

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WAND_OF_BINDING.description:
This wand has 7 cargas.

Spells. While holding the wand, you can cast one of the spells (save CD 17) on the following table from it. The table indicates how many cargas you must expend to cast the spell.

Spell | Charge Cost
Hold Monster | 5
Hold Person | 2

Regaining Charges. The wand recupera 1d6 + 1 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. If you expend the wand's last carga, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WAND_OF_ENEMY_D.description:
This wand has 7 cargas. While holding it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 carga. For 1 minute, you know the direction of the nearest creature Hostile to you within 60 pies, but not its distance from you. The wand can sense the presence of Hostile creatures that are Invisible, ethereal, disguised, or hidden, as well as those in plain sight. The effect ends if you stop holding the wand.

Regaining Charges. The wand recupera 1d6 + 1 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. If you expend the wand's last carga, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WAND_OF_ORCUS.name: Varita de Orcus

setters.keywords: constitution, saving throw, save, zombies, mace, necrotic, damage, ac, armor class, animate dead, blight, circle of death, finger of death, power word kill, speak with dead, skeletons, sentience

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WAND_OF_ORCUS.description:
Crafted and wielded by Orcus, this ghastly wand slips from the demon lord's grasp from time to time. When it does, it magically appears wherever the demon lord senses an opportunity to achieve some fell goal.

The wand is topped with a skull that once belonged to a human hero slain by Orcus. The wand can magically change in size to better conform to the grip of its user. All Holy Water within 10 pies of the wand is destroyed.

Any creature besides Orcus that tries to attune to the wand makes a CD 17 Constitución tirada de salvación. On a successful save, the creature takes 10d6 necrótico daño. On a failed save, the creature dies and, if it is a Humanoid, turns into a Zombie .

Magic Weapon. You can wield the wand as a magic Mace that grants a +3 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with it. The wand deals an extra 2d12 necrótico daño on a hit.

Random Properties. The Wand of Orcus has the following random properties:

- 2 minor beneficial properties

- 1 major beneficial property

- 2 minor detrimental properties

- 1 major detrimental property

The detrimental properties of the Wand of Orcus are suppressed while the wand is attuned to Orcus.

Protection. You gain a +3 bonus to Clase de Armadura while holding the wand.

Spells. The wand has 7 cargas and regains 1d4 + 3 expended cargas diariamente al amanecer. While holding the wand, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it (save CD 18). The table indicates how many cargas you must expend to cast the spell.

Spell | Charge Cost
Animate Dead | 1
Blight | 2
Circle of Death | 3
Finger of Death | 3
Power Word Kill | 4
Speak with Dead | 1

While attuned to the wand, Orcus or a follower blessed by him can cast each of the wand's spells using 2 fewer cargas (minimum of 0).

Call Undead. While holding the wand, you can take a Magic action to conjure 15 Skeletons and 15 Zombies . These Undead magically rise up from the ground or otherwise form in unoccupied spaces within 300 pies of you and obey your commands until they are destroyed or hasta el próximo amanecer, when they collapse into inanimate piles of bones and rotting corpses. Once you use this property, you can't use it again hasta el próximo amanecer.

While holding the wand, Orcus can summon any kind of Undead, not just skeletons and zombies. These Undead don't perish at dawn the following day, remaining until Orcus dismisses them.

Sentience. The Wand of Orcus is a sentient Chaotic Evil item with an Inteligencia of 16, a Sabiduría of 12, and a Carisma of 16. It has hearing and Visión en la oscuridad out to 120 pies.

The wand communicates telepathically with its wielder and speaks Abyssal and Common.

Personality. The wand's purpose is to help satisfy Orcus's desire to slay everything in the multiverse. The wand is cruel, nihilistic, and bereft of humor.

To further Orcus's goals, the wand feigns devotion to its current user and makes grandiose promises that it has no intention of fulfilling, such as vowing to help its user overthrow Orcus.

Destroying the Wand. Destroying the Wand of Orcus requires that it be taken to the Positive Energy Plane by the ancient hero whose skull surmounts it. For this to happen, the long-lost hero must first be restored to life—no easy task, given the fact that Orcus has imprisoned the hero's soul and keeps it hidden and well guarded.

Bathing the wand in positive energy (such as that which permeates the Positive Plane) causes it to crack and explode, but unless the above conditions are met, the wand instantly re-forms on Orcus's layer of the Abyss.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WAND_OF_WONDER.name: Varita de las maravillas

setters.keywords: charges, recharge, dawn, darkness, faerie fire, fireball, slow, stinking cloud, gust of wind, lightly obscured, heavily obscured, lightning bolt, enlarge/reduce, reduce, rhinoceros, elephant, rat, emanation, constitution, saving throw, save, blinded, condition, invisibility, bludgeoning, damage, line, polymorph, black bear, giant wasp, frog, restrained, petrified

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WAND_OF_WONDER.description:
This wand has 7 cargas. While holding it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 carga while choosing a point within 120 pies of yourself. That location becomes the point of origin of a spell or other magical effect determined by rolling on the Wand of Wonder Effects table. Spells cast from the wand have a save CD of 15. If a spell's maximum range is normally less than 120 pies, it becomes 120 pies when cast from the wand. If an effect has multiple possible subjects, the DM determines randomly which among them are affected.

Regaining Charges. The wand recupera 1d6 + 1 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. If you expend the wand's last carga, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into dust and is destroyed.

WAND OF WONDER EFFECTS

1d100 | Effect
01-20 | You cast a spell originating from the chosen point. Roll 1d10 to determine the spell: on a 1-2 , Darkness ; on a 3-4 , Faerie fuego ; on a 5-6 , fuegoball ; on a 7-8 , Slow ; on a 9-10 , Stinking Cloud .
21-25 | Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you have the Aturdido condition until the start of your next turn, believing something awesome just happened.
26-30 | You cast Gust of Wind . The Line created by the spell extends from you to the chosen point of origin.
31-35 | Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you take 1d6 psíquico daño.
36-40 | Heavy rain falls for 1 minute in a 120-foot-high, 60-foot-radius Cylinder centered on the chosen point of origin. During that time, the area of effect is Lightly Obscured.
41-45 | A cloud of 600 oversized butterflies fills a 60-foot-high, 30-foot-radius Cylinder centered on the chosen point of origin. The butterflies remain for 10 minutes, during which time the area of effect is Heavily Obscured.
46-50 | You cast relámpago Bolt . The Line created by the spell extends from you to the chosen point of origin.
51-55 | The creature closest to the chosen point of origin is enlarged as if you had cast Enlarge/Reduce on it. If the target isn't you and can't be affected by that spell, you become the target instead.
56-60 | A magically formed creature appears in an unoccupied space as close to the chosen point of origin as possible. The creature isn't under your control, acts as it normally would, and disappears after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 puntos de golpe. Roll 1d4 to determine which creature appears. On a 1 , a Rhinoceros appears; on a 2 , an Elephant appears; and on a 3-4 , a Rat appears.
61-64 | Grass covers a 60-foot-radius circle of ground, with the center of that circle as close to the chosen point of origin as possible. Grass that's already there grows to ten times its normal size and remains overgrown durante 1 minuto.
65-68 | An object of the DM's choice disappears into the Ethereal Plane. The object must be neither worn nor carried, within 120 pies of the chosen point of origin, and no larger than 10 pies in any dimension. If there are no such objects in range, nothing happens.
69-72 | Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you shrink as if you had cast Enlarge/Reduce on yourself and remain in that state durante 1 minuto.
73-77 | Leaves grow from the creature nearest to the chosen point of origin. Unless they are picked off, the leaves turn brown and fall off after 24 hours.
78-82 | Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, a burst of colorful, shimmering light extends from you in a 30-foot Emanation. Each creature in the area must succeed on a CD 15 Constitución tirada de salvación or have the Cegado condition durante 1 minuto. A creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
83-87 | Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you cast Invisibility on yourself.
88-92 | Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, a stream of 1d4 × 10 gems, each worth 1 GP, shoots from the wand's tip in a Line 30 pies long and 5 pies wide toward the chosen point of origin. Each gem deals 1 contundente daño, and the total daño of the gems is divided equally among all creatures in the Line.
93-97 | You cast Polymorph , targeting the creature closest to the chosen point of origin. Roll 1d4 to determine the target's new form. On a 1 , the new form is a Black Bear ; on a 2 , the new form is a Giant Wasp ; on a 3-4 , the new form is a Frog .
98-00 | The creature closest to the chosen point of origin makes a CD 15 Constitución tirada de salvación. On a failed save, the creature has the Apresado condition and begins to turn to stone. While Apresado in this way, the creature repeats the save at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends. On a failed save, the creature has the Petrificado condition instead of the Apresado condition. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the Greater Restoration spell or similar magic.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ADAMANTINE_WEAP.description: This weapon is made of adamantine, one of the hardest substances in existence. Whenever this weapon or piece of ammunition hits an object, the hit is a golpe crítico.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_AXE_OF_THE_DWAR.name: Hacha de los señores enanos

setters.keywords: force, damage, darkvision, ASI, ability score improvement, constitution, tool, proficiency, brewer's supplies, mason's tools, smith's tools, immunity, poison, resistance, fire, magic action, action, earth elemental, teleport

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_AXE_OF_THE_DWAR.description:
A young dwarf prince set out to forge a weapon that would be regarded as a symbol of unity among his people. Venturing deep under the mountains, deeper than any dwarf had ever delved, the prince came to the blazing heart of a great volcano. With the aid of Moradin, a god of creation, he first crafted four mighty tools: the Starmetal Pick, the Earthheart Forge, the Anvil of Songs, and the Shaping Hammer. With these tools, he forged the Axe of the Dwarvish Lords.

Armed with the Artifact, the prince brought peace to the dwarf clans, ending grudges and answering slights. The clans became allies, and they threw back their enemies and enjoyed an era of prosperity. This young dwarf is remembered as the First King. When he became old, he passed the weapon, which had become his badge of office, to his heir. The rightful inheritors passed the axe on for many generations.

Later, in an era marked by treachery and wickedness, the axe was lost in a bloody civil war fomented by greed for its power and the status it bestowed. Centuries later, the dwarves still search for the axe, and many adventurers have made careers of chasing after rumors and plundering old vaults to find it.

Magic Weapon. The Axe of the Dwarvish Lords is a magic weapon that grants a +3 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with it.

When you attack a creature with the axe and roll a 20 on the d20 for the tirada de ataque, the axe deals an extra 20 cortante daño.

The axe has Thrown with a normal range of 20 pies and a long range of 60 pies. When you hit with a ranged attack using this weapon, it deals an extra 1d8 fuerza daño, or an extra 2d8 fuerza daño if the target is a creature of the Giant type. Immediately after hitting or missing, the weapon flies back to your hand.

Blessings of Moradin. While attuned to the axe, you gain the following benefits:

Visión en la oscuridad. You gain Visión en la oscuridad with a range of 60 pies. If you already have Visión en la oscuridad, its range increases by 60 pies.

Fortitude of Stone. Your Constitución increases by 2, to a maximum of 20.

Gifts of the Creator. You have proficiency with Brewer's Supplies, Mason's Tools, and Smith's Tools.

One with the Forge. You have inmunidad to veneno daño and resistencia to fuego daño.

Sunder. When you hit an object with the axe, the object takes the maximum amount of daño possible.

Conjure Earth Elemental. While holding the axe, you can take a Magic action to summon an Earth Elemental . It appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 pies of yourself, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 24 hours, when it dies, or when you dismiss it como acción adicional. You can't use this property again hasta el próximo amanecer.

Random Properties. The axe has the following randomly determined properties:

- 2 minor beneficial properties

- 1 major beneficial property

- 2 minor detrimental properties

Travel the Depths. You can take a Magic action to touch the axe to a fixed piece of dwarven stonework and cast Teleport from the axe. If your intended destination is underground, there is no chance of a mishap or arriving somewhere unexpected. You can't use this property again until 3 days have passed.

Destroying the Axe. The only way to destroy the axe is to melt it down in the Earthheart Forge, where it was created. It must remain in the burning forge for 50 years before it finally succumbs to the fire and is consumed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BERSERKER_AXE.name: Hacha berserker

setters.keywords: enhancement, hit point maximum, hp max, cursed, wisdom, saving throw, save

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BERSERKER_AXE.description:
You gain a +1 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon. In addition, while you are attuned to this weapon, your Hit Point maximum increases by 1 for each level you have attained.

Curse. This weapon is cursed, and becoming attuned to it extends the curse to you. As long as you remain cursed, you are unwilling to part with the weapon, keeping it within reach at all times. You also have desventaja on tiradas de ataque with weapons other than this one.

Whenever another creature daños you while the weapon is in your possession, you must succeed on a CD 15 Sabiduría tirada de salvación or go berserk. This berserk state ends when you start your turn and there are no creatures within 60 pies of you that you can see or hear.

While berserk, you regard the creature nearest to you that you can see or hear as your enemy. If there are multiple possible creatures, choose one at random. On each of your turns, you must move as close to the creature as possible and take the Attack action, targeting the creature. If you're unable to get close enough to the creature to attack it with the weapon, your turn ends after you've used up all your available movement. If the creature dies or can no longer be seen or heard by you, the next nearest creature that you can see or hear becomes your new target.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BLACKRAZOR.name: Filo Negro (Blackrazor)

setters.keywords: immunity, charmed, frightened, blindsight, temporary hit points, thp, haste, sentience,

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BLACKRAZOR.description:
Hidden in the dungeon of White Plume Mountain, Blackrazor shines like a piece of night sky filled with stars. Its black scabbard is decorated with pieces of cut obsidian.

You gain a +3 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon. If you hit an Undead with this weapon, you take 1d10 necrótico daño, and the target regains 1d10 puntos de golpe. If this necrótico daño reduces you to 0 puntos de golpe, Blackrazor devours your soul (see "Devour Soul" below).

While you hold this weapon, you have inmunidad to the Hechizado and Asustado conditions, and you have Vista ciega with a range of 30 pies.

Devour Soul. Whenever you use Blackrazor to reduce a creature to 0 puntos de golpe, the sword slays the creature and devours its soul unless it is a Construct or an Undead. A creature whose soul has been devoured by Blackrazor can be restored to life only by a Wish spell.

When Blackrazor devours a soul that isn't yours, you gain Temporary puntos de golpe equal to the slain creature's Hit Point maximum.

Haste. Blackrazor can cast Haste on you, after which it can't cast this spell again hasta el próximo amanecer. Blackrazor decides when to cast the spell, which takes effect at the start of your turn. The spell lasts for 1 minute (no Concentración required) or until Blackrazor decides to end it, which it can do at the end of any of your turns.

Sentience. Blackrazor is a sentient Chaotic Neutral weapon with an Inteligencia of 17, a Sabiduría of 10, and a Carisma of 19. It has hearing and Visión en la oscuridad out to 120 pies.

The weapon speaks Common and can communicate with its wielder telepathically. Its voice is deep and echoing. While you are attuned to it, Blackrazor also understands every language you know.

Personality. Blackrazor speaks with an imperious tone, as though accustomed to being obeyed.

The sword's purpose is to consume souls. It doesn't care whose souls it eats, including the wielder's. The sword believes that all matter and energy sprang from a void of negative energy and will one day return to it. Blackrazor is meant to hurry that process along.

Despite its nihilism, Blackrazor feels a strange kinship to Wave and Whelm , two other weapons locked away under White Plume Mountain. It wants the three weapons to be reunited and wielded together in combat, even though it violently disagrees with Whelm and finds Wave tedious.

Blackrazor's hunger for souls must be regularly fed. If the sword goes 3 days or more without consuming a soul, a conflict between it and its wielder occurs at the next sunset.

Destroying Blackrazor. Blackrazor can be destroyed by crushing it in the great gears of Mechanus. Primus, the creator of the modrons, also knows a series of musical tones that Blackrazor can't stand to hear, causing the sword to shatter.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DAGGER_OF_VENOM.name: Daga de veneno

setters.keywords: bonus action, constitution, saving throw, save, poison, damage, poisoned, condition

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DAGGER_OF_VENOM.description:
You gain a +1 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon.

You can take a Bonus Action to magically coat the blade with poison. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature. That creature must succeed on a CD 15 Constitución tirada de salvación or take 2d10 veneno daño and have the venenoed condition durante 1 minuto. The weapon can't be used this way again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DANCING_SWORD.name: Espada danzarina

type.addition: Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DANCING_SWORD.description:
You can take a Bonus Action to toss this magic weapon into the air. When you do so, the weapon begins to hover, flies up to 30 pies, and attacks one creature of your choice within 5 pies of itself. The weapon uses your tirada de ataque and adds your ability modifier to tiradas de daño.

While the weapon hovers, you can take a Bonus Action to cause it to fly up to 30 pies to another spot within 30 pies of you. As part of the same Bonus Action, you can cause the weapon to attack one creature within 5 pies of the weapon.

After the hovering weapon attacks for the fourth time, it flies back to you and tries to return to your hand. If you have no hand free, the weapon falls to the ground in your space. If the weapon has no unobstructed path to you, it moves as close to you as it can and then falls to the ground. It also ceases to hover if you grasp it or are more than 30 pies away from it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DEFENDER.name: Defensora
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DEFENDER.description:
You gain a +3 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon.

The first time you attack with the weapon on each of your turns, you can transfer some or all of the weapon's bonus to your Clase de Armadura. For example, you could reduce the bonus to your tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño to +1 and gain a +2 bonus to Clase de Armadura. The adjusted bonuses remain in effect until the start of your next turn, although you must hold the weapon to gain a bonus to AC from it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DRAGON_SLAYER.name: Matadragones
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DRAGON_SLAYER.description:
You gain a +1 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon.

The weapon deals an extra 3d6 daño of the weapon's type if the target is a Dragon.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ENERGY_BOW.name: Arco de energía

setters.keywords: enhancement, force, damage, bright light, dim light, strength, saving throw, save, restrained, condition, magic action, action, teleport

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ENERGY_BOW.description:
You gain a +1 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon, which has no string. Each time you pull your arm back in a firing motion, a magical arrow made of golden energy appears nocked and ready to fire. An arrow produced by this weapon deals fuerza daño instead of perforante daño on a hit, and it disappears after it hits or misses its target. Until it disappears, the arrow emits Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 pies.

This weapon has the following additional properties.

Arrow of Restraint. Whenever you use this weapon to make a ranged attack against a creature, you can try to restrain the target instead of dealing daño to it. If the arrow hits, the target must succeed on a CD 15 Fuerza tirada de salvación or have the Apresado condition durante 1 minuto. Como acción, a creature Apresado by an arrow can make a CD 20 Fuerza (Athletics) check to try to break the restraint, ending the effect on itself on a successful check.

Arrow of Transport. Como acción de Magia, you can fire one energy arrow from this weapon at a target you can see within 60 pies of yourself. The target can be either a willing Medium or smaller creature or an object that isn't being worn or carried, provided the object is small enough to fit inside a 5-foot Cube. The arrow teleports the target to an unoccupied space you can see within 10 pies of you.

Energy Ladder. Como acción de Magia, you can loose a flurry of energy arrows from this weapon at a wall up to 60 pies away from yourself. The arrows become glowing rungs that stick out of the wall, forming a magical ladder up to 60 pies long on the wall. This ladder lasts for 1 minute before disappearing.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ENSPELLED_WEAPO.name: Arma hechizada (Truco)

setters.keywords: spell, charges, recharge, conjuration, divination, evocation, necromancy, transmutation

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ENSPELLED_WEAPO.description:
Bound into this weapon is a cantrip. The cantrip is determined when the weapon is created and must belong to the Conjuration, Divination, Evocation, Necromancy, or Transmutation school of magic. The weapon has 6 cargas and recupera 1d6 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While holding the weapon, you can expend 1 carga to cast its spell.

The cantrip's tirada de salvación CD is 13, and its attack bonus is +5.

Bound into this weapon is a level 6 spell. The spell is determined when the weapon is created and must belong to the Conjuration, Divination, Evocation, Necromancy, or Transmutation school of magic. The weapon has 6 cargas and recupera 1d6 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While wielding the weapon, you can expend 1 carga to cast its spell.

The spell's tirada de salvación CD is 17, and its attack bonus is +9.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ENSPELLED_WEAPO.name: Arma hechizada (Nivel 7)

setters.keywords: spell, charges, recharge, conjuration, divination, evocation, necromancy, transmutation

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ENSPELLED_WEAPO.description:
