The weapon has 6 cargas and recupera 1d6 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While wielding the weapon, you can expend 1 carga to cast its spell.

The spell's tirada de salvación CD is 18, and its attack bonus is +10.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ENSPELLED_WEAPO.name: Arma hechizada (Nivel 8)

setters.keywords: spell, charges, recharge, conjuration, divination, evocation, necromancy, transmutation

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ENSPELLED_WEAPO.description:
Bound into this weapon is a level 8 spell. The spell is determined when the weapon is created and must belong to the Conjuration, Divination, Evocation, Necromancy, or Transmutation school of magic. The weapon has 6 cargas and recupera 1d6 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While wielding the weapon, you can expend 1 carga to cast its spell.

The spell's tirada de salvación CD is 18, and its attack bonus is +10.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_EXECUTIONERS_AX.name: Hacha del verdugo

setters.keywords: enhancement, slashing, damage, temporary hit points, thp

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_EXECUTIONERS_AX.description:
You gain a +1 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon.

Any Humanoid you hit with the weapon takes an extra 2d6 cortante daño, and you gain Temporary puntos de golpe equal to the extra daño dealt.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_FLAME_TONGUE.name: Lengua de fuego

setters.keywords: bonus action, bright light, dim light, fire, damage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_FLAME_TONGUE.description: Mientras empuñas magic weapon, you can take a Bonus Action and use a command word to cause flames to engulf the daño-dealing part of the weapon. These flames shed Bright Light in a 40-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 40 pies. While the weapon is ablaze, it deals an extra 2d6 fuego daño on a hit. The flames last until you take a Bonus Action to issue the command again or until you drop, stow, or sheathe the weapon.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_FROST_BRAND.name: Tizón de escarcha

setters.keywords: cold, damage, resistance, fire, bright light, dim light

type.addition: Glaive, Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_FROST_BRAND.description:
When you hit with an tirada de ataque using this magic weapon, the target takes an extra 1d6 frío daño. In addition, while you hold the weapon, you have resistencia to fuego daño.

In freezing temperatures, the weapon sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 pies.

When you draw this weapon, you can extinguish all nonmagical flames within 30 pies of yourself. Once used, this property can't be used again durante 1 hora.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GIANT_SLAYER.name: Matagigantes

setters.keywords: damage, strength, saving throw, save, prone, condition

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GIANT_SLAYER.description:
You gain a +1 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon.

When you hit a Giant with this weapon, the Giant takes an extra 2d6 daño of the weapon's type and must succeed on a CD 15 Fuerza tirada de salvación or have the Derribado condition.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HAMMER_OF_THUND.name: Martillo de rayos

setters.keywords: enhancement, charges, maul, constitution, saving throw, save, stunned, recharge, strength, ASI, ability score improvement

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HAMMER_OF_THUND.description:
You gain a +1 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon.

The weapon has 5 cargas. You can expend 1 carga and make a ranged attack with the weapon, hurling it as if it had Thrown with a normal range of 20 pies and a long range of 60 pies.

If the attack hits, the weapon unleashes a thunderclap audible out to 300 pies. The target and every creature within 30 pies of it other than you must succeed on a CD 17 Constitución tirada de salvación or have the Aturdido condition until the end of your next turn. Immediately after hitting or missing, the weapon flies back to your hand. The weapon recupera 1d4 + 1 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer.

Giant’s Bane. While you are attuned to the weapon and wearing either a Belt of Giant Fuerza or Gauntlets of Ogre Power to which you are also attuned, you gain the following benefits:

Giants' Bane. When you roll a 20 on the d20 for an tirada de ataque made with this weapon against a Giant, the creature must succeed on a CD 17 Constitución tirada de salvación or die.

Might of Giants. The Fuerza score bestowed by your Belt of Giant Fuerza or Gauntlets of Ogre Power increases by 4, to a maximum of 30.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HOLY_AVENGER.name: Vengadora sagrada

setters.keywords: paladin, enhancement, radiant, damage, emanation, aura, advantage, saving throws, saves

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HOLY_AVENGER.description:
You gain a +3 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon. When you hit a Fiend or an Undead with it, that creature takes an extra 2d10 radiante daño.

While you hold the drawn weapon, it creates a 10-foot Emanation originating from you. You and all creatures Friendly to you in the Emanation have ventaja on tiradas de salvación against spells and other magical effects. If you have 17 or more levels in the Paladin class, the size of the Emanation increases to 30 pies.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_JAVELIN_OF_LIGH.name: Jabalina de relámpago

setters.keywords: lightning, damage, line, dexterity, saving throw, save

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_JAVELIN_OF_LIGH.description:
Each time you make an tirada de ataque with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal relámpago daño instead of perforante daño.

relámpago Bolt. When you throw this weapon at a target no farther than 120 pies from you, you can forgo making a ranged tirada de ataque and instead turn the weapon into a bolt of lightning. This bolt forms a 5-foot-wide Line between you and the target. The target and each other creature in the Line (excluding you) makes a CD 13 Destreza tirada de salvación, taking 4d6 relámpago daño on a failed save or half as much daño on a successful one. Immediately after dealing this daño, the weapon reappears in your hand. This property can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_LUCK_BLADE.name: Hoja de la suerte

setters.keywords: glaive, greatsword, longsword, rapier, scimitar, sickle, shortsword, enhancement, d20 test, charges, wish

type.addition: Glaive, Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, Sickle, or Shortsword

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_LUCK_BLADE.description:
You gain a +1 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon. While the weapon is on your person, you also gain a +1 bonus to tiradas de salvación.

Luck. If the weapon is on your person, you can call on its luck (no action required) to reroll one failed D20 Test if you don't have the Incapacitado condition. You must use the second roll. Once used, this property can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

Wish. The weapon has 1d3 cargas. While holding it, you can expend 1 carga and cast Wish from it. Once used, this property can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer. The weapon loses this property if it has no cargas.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_LUTE_OF_THUNDER.name: Laúd del golpeteo atronador
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_LUTE_OF_THUNDER.description:
This reinforced lute can be wielded as a magic Club that deals an extra 2d8 trueno daño on a hit.

Sing and Swing. If you're a Bard, you can use your Carisma modifier instead of your Fuerza modifier when making a melee tirada de ataque with the lute, provided you sing or hum while making the attack.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MACE_OF_DISRUPT.name: Maza de disrupción

setters.keywords: radiant, damage, wisdom, saving throw, save, frightened, bright light, dim light

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MACE_OF_DISRUPT.description:
When you hit a Fiend or an Undead with this magic weapon, that creature takes an extra 2d6 radiante daño. If the target has 25 puntos de golpe or fewer after taking this daño, it must succeed on a CD 15 Sabiduría tirada de salvación or be destroyed. On a successful save, the creature has the Asustado condition until the end of your next turn.

Light. While you hold this weapon, it sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 pies.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MACE_OF_SMITING.name: Maza de castigo
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MACE_OF_SMITING.description:
You gain a +1 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon. The bonus increases to +3 when you use the weapon to attack a Construct.

When you roll a 20 on an tirada de ataque made with this weapon, the target takes an extra 7 contundente daño, or 14 contundente daño if it's a Construct. If a Construct has 25 puntos de golpe or fewer after taking this daño, it is destroyed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MACE_OF_TERROR.name: Maza de terror

setters.keywords: charges, recharge, magic action, action, wisdom, saving throw, save, frightened, condition

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MACE_OF_TERROR.description: This magic weapon has 3 cargas and recupera 1d3 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While holding the weapon, you can take a Magic action and expend 1 carga to release a wave of terror from it. Each creature of your choice within 30 pies of you must succeed on a CD 15 Sabiduría tirada de salvación or have the Asustado condition durante 1 minuto. While Asustado in this way, a creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If it has nowhere it can move, the creature can take the Dodge action. At the end of each of its turns, a creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MOONBLADE.name: Hoja lunar

setters.keywords: enhancement, force, damage, thrown, return, critical hit, critical range, bonus action, constitution, saving throw, save, blinded, condition, summoning, companion, shadow

type.addition: Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword

attunement.addition: by a Creature of the Weapon's Choice

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MOONBLADE.description:
Of all the magic items created by elves, one of the most prized and jealously guarded is a Moonblade. In ancient times, nearly all elven noble houses claimed one such weapon. Over the centuries, some of these weapons have faded from the world, their magic lost as family lines have become extinct. Others have vanished with their bearers during great quests. Thus, only a few of these weapons remain.

Every Moonblade longs for a bearer whose disposition and goals are compatible with its own. If you try to attune to a Moonblade that doesn't want you as its bearer, the weapon not only rejects you but also places a curse on you, causing you to make D20 Tests with desventaja for 24 hours or until the curse is ended by a Remove Curse spell or similar magic. If you're accepted by the weapon and try to attune to it, you become attuned to it instantly, and a new rune appears on it. You remain attuned to the weapon until you die or the weapon is destroyed. A Moonblade functions like a nonmagical weapon of its kind for anyone other than its chosen bearer.

A Moonblade has one rune on it for each bearer it has willingly served (typically 1d6 + 1). The first rune grants a +1 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon. Each rune beyond the first grants the Moonblade an additional property. The DM chooses each property or determines it randomly by rolling on the Moonblade Properties table.

Minor Property. In addition to its aforementioned properties, each Moonblade has a minor property determined by rolling on the Magic Item's Minor Property table.

Sentience. A Moonblade is a sentient weapon with an Inteligencia of 12, a Sabiduría of 10, and a Carisma of 12. It has hearing and Visión en la oscuridad out to 120 pies. Its alignment matches that of its creator.

The weapon communicates by transmitting emotions, sending a tingling sensation through the wielder's hand when it wants to communicate something it has sensed. It can communicate through visions or dreams when the wielder is either in a trance or asleep.

Personality. A Moonblade has a personality similar to that of its creator. Once a Moonblade has decided on an owner, it believes that only that person should wield it, even if the bearer's alignment differs from that of the weapon's or the bearer's goals later clash with the weapon's goals.

MOONBLADE PROPERTIES

d100 | Property
01-60 | Increase the weapon's bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño by 1, to a maximum of +3. Reroll if the Moonblade already has a +3 bonus.
61-75 | When you hit with an tirada de ataque using the Moonblade , you deal an extra 1d6 fuerza daño. Each time the weapon gains this property after the first, the extra daño increases by 1d6, to a maximum of 3d6. Reroll if the Moonblade already deals an extra 3d6 fuerza daño on a hit.
76-80 | The Moonblade gains Thrown with a normal range of 20 pies and a long range of 60 pies. Each time you throw the weapon, it flies back to your hand after the attack.
81-85 | The Moonblade scores a golpe crítico on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.
86-95 | You can take a Bonus Action to cause the Moonblade to flash brightly. Each other creature that is within 30 pies of you and not behind Total Cover must succeed on a CD 15 Constitución tirada de salvación or have the Cegado condition durante 1 minuto. A creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. You can't use this property again until you finish a descanso corto o largo.
96-99 | The Moonblade has the properties of a Ring of Spell Storing .
100 | You can take a Magic action to conjure a spectral entity that resembles a shadowy elf if you don't already have one serving you. The entity appears in an unoccupied space within 120 pies of you. It uses the Shadow stat block with these changes: it is a Fey, has a Neutral alignment, and doesn't create new shadows. You control this entity, deciding how it acts and moves. It remains until it drops to 0 puntos de golpe or you dismiss it como acción de Magia.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MOONTOUCHED_SWO.name: Espada tocada por la luna

type.addition: Glaive, Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MOONTOUCHED_SWO.description: In Darkness, the unsheathed blade of this weapon sheds moonlight, creating Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 15 pies.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_NINE_LIVES_STEA.name: Ladrona de nueve vidas

setters.keywords: critical hit, power word kill, constitution, saving throw, save

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_NINE_LIVES_STEA.description:
You gain a +2 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon.

Life Stealing. The weapon has 1d8 + 1 cargas. When you attack a creature that has fewer than 100 puntos de golpe with this weapon and roll a 20 on the d20 for the tirada de ataque, the creature must succeed on a CD 15 Constitución tirada de salvación or be slain instantly as the sword tears its life force from its body. Constructs and Undead succeed on the save automatically. The weapon loses 1 carga if the creature is slain. When the weapon has no cargas remaining, it loses this property.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_OATHBOW.name: Arco de juramento

setters.keywords: advantage, ignore cover, ignore disadvantage, piercing, damage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_OATHBOW.description:
When you nock an arrow on this bow, it whispers in Elvish, "Swift defeat to my enemies." When you use this weapon to make a ranged attack, you can utter or sign the following command words: "Swift death to you who have wronged me." The target of your attack becomes your sworn enemy until it dies or until dawn 7 days later. You can have only one such sworn enemy at a time. When your sworn enemy dies, you can choose a new one after the next dawn.

When you make a ranged tirada de ataque with this weapon against your sworn enemy, you have ventaja on the roll. In addition, your target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover, and you suffer no desventaja due to long range. If the attack hits, your sworn enemy takes an extra 3d6 perforante daño.

While your sworn enemy lives, you have desventaja on tiradas de ataque with all other weapons.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_QUARTERSTAFF_OF.name: Bastón del acróbata

setters.keywords: enhancement, light, dim light, bonus action, 10-foot pole, pole, advantage, dexterity, acrobatics, skill checks, ability checks, checks, reaction, armor class, ac, shield, cooldown, thrown

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_QUARTERSTAFF_OF.description:
Tienes un bonificador de +2 a las tiradas de ataque y daño realizadas con esta arma mágica.

Mientras empuñas weapon, you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 pies, either como acción adicional or after you roll Initiative, or you can extinguish the light como acción adicional.

Mientras empuñas weapon, you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod (for ease of storage) or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff; the weapon will elongate only as far as the surrounding space allows.

In certain forms, the weapon has the following additional properties.

Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only). Mientras empuñas weapon, you have ventaja on Destreza (Acrobatics) checks.

Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only). When you are hit by an attack while holding the weapon, you can take a Reaction to twirl the weapon around you, gaining a +5 bonus to your Clase de Armadura against the triggering attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you. You can't use this property again until you finish a descanso corto o largo.

Ranged Weapon (Quarterstaff Form Only). This weapon has Thrown with a normal range of 30 pies and a long range of 120 pies. Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SCIMITAR_OF_SPE.name: Cimitarra de velocidad
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SCIMITAR_OF_SPE.description: You gain a +2 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon. In addition, you can make one attack with it como acción adicional on each of your turns.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SILVERED_WEAPON.name: Arma plateada
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SILVERED_WEAPON.description: An alchemical process has bonded silver to this magic weapon. When you score a golpe crítico with it against a creature that is shape-shifted, the weapon deals one additional die of daño.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SUN_BLADE.name: Hoja solar

setters.keywords: enhancement, bonus action, longsword, finesse, radiant, damage, bright light, dim light, light, sunlight, magic action, action

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SUN_BLADE.description:
This item appears to be a sword hilt.

Blade of Radiance. While grasping the hilt, you can take a Bonus Action to cause a blade of pure radiance to spring into existence or make the blade disappear. While the blade exists, this magic weapon functions as a Longsword with Finesse. If you are proficient with Longswords or Shortswords, you are proficient with the Sun Blade.

You gain a +2 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this weapon, which deals radiante daño instead of cortante daño. When you hit an Undead with it, that target takes an extra 1d8 radiante daño.

Sunlight. The sword's luminous blade emits Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 15 pies. The light is sunlight. While the blade persists, you can take a Magic action to expand or reduce its radius of Bright Light and Dim Light by 5 pies each, to a maximum of 30 pies each or a minimum of 10 pies each.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SWORD_OF_ANSWER.name: Espada de respuesta

setters.keywords: enhancement, reaction, advantage, ignores immunity, ignores resistance

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SWORD_OF_ANSWER.description: You gain a +3 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this sword. In addition, while you hold the sword, you can take a Reaction to make one melee attack with it against any creature in your reach that deals daño to you. You have ventaja on the tirada de ataque, and any daño dealt with this special attack ignores any inmunidad or resistencia the target has to that daño.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SWORD_OF_KAS.name: Espada de Kas

setters.keywords: enhancement, critical hit, critical hit range, slashing, damage, minor beneficial properties, major beneficial properties, minor detrimental properties, major detrimental properties, call lightning, divine word, finger of death, initiative, attack action, ac, armor class, resistance, necrotic, sentience

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SWORD_OF_KAS.description:
Kas was a powerful warrior who served Vecna and whose loyalty was rewarded with this sword. As Kas's power grew, so did his hubris. The sword urged Kas to destroy Vecna and usurp his throne. Legend says Vecna's destruction came at Kas's hand, but Vecna also wrought his rebellious lieutenant's doom, leaving only Kas's sword behind.

Bloodthirst. The sword thirsts for blood. If the sword doesn't taste blood on its blade within 1 minute of being drawn from its scabbard, its wielder makes a CD 15 Carisma tirada de salvación. On a successful save, the wielder takes 3d6 psíquico daño. On a failed save, the wielder is dominated by the sword, as if by the Dominate Monster spell, and the sword demands blood. The spell effect ends when the sword's demand is met.

Magic Weapon. You gain a +3 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with the sword, which scores a golpe crítico on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20 and deals an extra 2d10 cortante daño to Undead.

Random Properties. The sword has the following random properties:

- 1 minor beneficial property

- 1 major beneficial property

- 1 minor detrimental property

- 1 major detrimental property

Spells. Spells. While the sword is on your person, you can cast the following spells (save CD 18) from it:

- Call relámpago

- Divine Word

- Finger of Death

Once you use the sword to cast a spell, you can't cast that spell again from it hasta el próximo amanecer.

Spirit of Kas. While the sword is on your person, you gain the following benefits:

Battle Hunger. You add 1d10 to your Initiative rolls.

Blade of Defense. When you take an action to attack with the sword, you can transfer some or all of its attack bonus to your Clase de Armadura instead. The adjusted bonuses remain in effect until the start of your next turn.

necrótico resistencia. You have resistencia to necrótico daño.

Sentience. The Sword of Kas is a sentient Chaotic Evil weapon with an Inteligencia of 15, a Sabiduría of 13, and a Carisma of 16. It has hearing and Visión en la oscuridad out to 120 pies.

The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and speaks Common.

Personality. The sword's purpose is to bring ruin to Vecna. Killing Vecna's worshipers, destroying the lich's works, and foiling his machinations all help to fulfill this goal.

The Sword of Kas also seeks to destroy anyone corrupted by the Eye and Hand of Vecna .

Destroying the Sword. A creature attuned to both the Eye of Vecna and the Hand of Vecna can use the Wish property of those combined Artifacts to unmake the Sword of Kas , provided the sword is within 30 pies of the spell's caster. Upon casting Wish , the creature makes a CD 18 Carisma tirada de salvación. On a failed save, nothing happens, and the Wish spell is wasted. On a successful save, the Sword of Kas is destroyed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SWORD_OF_LIFE_S.name: Espada robavidas

setters.keywords: critical hit, necrotic, damage, temporary hit points, thp

type.addition: Glaive, Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SWORD_OF_LIFE_S.description: When you attack a creature with this magic weapon and roll a 20 on the d20 for the tirada de ataque, that target takes an extra 15 necrótico daño if it isn't a Construct or an Undead, and you gain Temporary puntos de golpe equal to the amount of necrótico daño taken.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SWORD_OF_SHARPN.name: Espada de agudeza
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SWORD_OF_SHARPN.description:
When you attack an object with this magic weapon and hit, maximize your weapon daño dice against the target.

When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the d20 for the tirada de ataque, that target takes an extra 14 cortante daño and gains 1 Agotamiento level.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SWORD_OF_VENGEA.name: Espada de venganza

type.addition: Glaive, Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SWORD_OF_VENGEA.description:
You gain a +1 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon.

Curse. This weapon is cursed and possessed by a vengeful spirit. Becoming attuned to it extends the curse to you. As long as you remain cursed, you are unwilling to part with the weapon, keeping it on your person at all times. Mientras estás sintonizado con weapon, you have desventaja on tiradas de ataque made with weapons other than this one.

In addition, while the weapon is on your person, you must succeed on a CD 15 Sabiduría tirada de salvación whenever you take daño from another creature in combat. On a failed save, you must attack the creature that dañod you until you drop to 0 puntos de golpe or it does or until you can't reach the creature to make a melee attack against it.

You can break the curse in the usual ways. Alternatively, casting Banishment on the weapon forces the vengeful spirit to leave it. The weapon then becomes a +1 Weapon with no other properties.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SWORD_OF_WOUNDI.name: Espada de heridas

setters.keywords: glaive, greatsword, longsword, rapier, scimitar, shortsword, necrotic, damage, constitution, saving throw, save

type.addition: Glaive, Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SWORD_OF_WOUNDI.description: When you hit a creature with an attack using this magic weapon, the target takes an extra 2d6 necrótico daño and must succeed on a CD 15 Constitución tirada de salvación or be unable to regain puntos de golpe durante 1 hora. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SYLVAN_TALON.name: Garra silvana

setters.keywords: dagger, rapier, scimitar, shortsword, sickle, spear, fey, magic action, action, message, cooldown, dawn

type.addition: Dagger, Rapier, Scimitar, Shortsword, Sickle, or Spear

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SYLVAN_TALON.description:
While this weapon is on your person, you understand the nonwritten communication of all Fey, and they understand yours.

Secret Message. Como acción de Magia, you can use the weapon to cast Message. Once this property is used, it can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_THUNDEROUS_GREA.name: Garrote grande atronador

setters.keywords: strength, ability score set, ability score change, thunder, damage, magic action, action, cone, saving throw, save, prone, condition, bludgeoning, dexterity, constitution, anti-concentration, cooldown, dawn

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_THUNDEROUS_GREA.description:
While you are attuned to this magic weapon, your Fuerza is 20 unless your Fuerza is already equal to or greater than that score. The weapon deals an extra 1d8 trueno daño to any creature it hits and an extra 3d8 trueno daño to objects it hits that aren't being worn or carried.

The weapon has the following additional properties.

Clap of trueno. Como acción de Magia, you can strike the weapon against a hard surface to create a loud clap of thunder audible out to 300 pies. You also create a 30-foot Cone of thunderous energy. Each creature in the Cone must succeed on a CD 15 Fuerza tirada de salvación or have the Derribado condition. Nonmagical objects in the Cone that aren't being worn or carried take 3d8 trueno daño.

Earthquake. Como acción de Magia, you can strike the weapon against the ground to create an intense seismic disturbance in a 50-foot-radius circle centered on the point of impact. Structures in contact with the ground in that area take 50 contundente daño, and each creature on the ground in that area must succeed on a CD 20 Destreza tirada de salvación or have the Derribado condition. If that creature is also Concentrating, it must succeed on a CD 20 Constitución tirada de salvación or its Concentración is broken. In addition, you can cause a 30-foot-deep, 10-foot-wide fissure to open up on the ground anywhere in the area. Any creature on a spot where the fissure opens must make a CD 20 Destreza tirada de salvación, falling into the fissure on a failed save or moving with the fissure's edge on a successful one. Any structure on a spot where the fissure opens collapses into the fissure. Once you use this property, it can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TRIDENT_OF_FISH.name: Tridente de dominio de peces
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TRIDENT_OF_FISH.description: This magic weapon has 3 cargas, and it recupera 1d3 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While you carry it, you can expend 1 carga to cast Dominate Beast (save CD 15) from it on a Beast that has a Swim Speed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_VICIOUS_WEAPON.name: Arma sañuda
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_VICIOUS_WEAPON.description: This magic weapon deals an extra 2d6 daño to any creature it hits. This extra daño is of the same type as the weapon's normal daño.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_VORPAL_SWORD.name: Espada vorpal

setters.keywords: enhancement, ignores resistance, critical hit, slashing, damage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_VORPAL_SWORD.description:
You gain a +3 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon. In addition, the weapon ignores resistencia to cortante daño.

When you use this weapon to attack a creature that has at least one head and roll a 20 on the d20 for the tirada de ataque, you cut off one of the creature's heads. The creature dies if it can't survive without the lost head. A creature is immune to this effect if it has inmunidad to cortante daño, if it doesn't have or need a head, or if the DM decides that the creature is too big for its head to be cut off with this weapon. Such a creature instead takes an extra 30 cortante daño from the hit. If the creature has Legendary resistencia, it can expend one daily use of that trait to avoid losing its head, taking the extra daño instead.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WAVE.name: Ola (Wave)

setters.keywords: enhancement, critical hit, necrotic, damage, advantage, initiative, breathe underwater, underwather breathing, charges, recharge, dawn, dominate beast, globe of invulnerability, cooldown, sentience

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WAVE.description:
Held in the dungeon of White Plume Mountain, Wave is engraved with images of waves, shells, and sea creatures.

You gain a +3 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon. When you roll a 20 on the d20 for an tirada de ataque with this weapon, the target takes an extra 21 necrótico daño.

While holding Wave , you gain the following benefits:

Combat Ready. You have ventaja on Initiative rolls.

Underwater Adaptation. A bubble of air forms around your head while you are underwater, allowing you to breathe normally in that environment.

Aquatic Command. Wave has 3 cargas and recupera 1d3 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While you carry it, you can expend 1 carga to cast Dominate Beast (save CD 20) from it on a Beast that has a Swim Speed.

Globe of Invulnerability. While holding Wave , you can cast the level 9 version of Globe of Invulnerability from it. Once used, this property can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

Sentience. Wave is a sentient weapon of Neutral alignment, with an Inteligencia of 14, a Sabiduría of 10, and a Carisma of 18. It has hearing and Visión en la oscuridad out to 120 pies.

The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and speaks Aquan.

Personality. Wave zealously encourages mortals to worship sea gods and has a habit of humming sea chanteys. Conflict arises if the wielder fails to further the weapon's objectives in the world.

Destroying Wave. Wave can be destroyed only on the island of truenoforge, where it was forged. The weapon must be melted down by a storm giant or someone imbued with a storm giant's strength. Destroying Wave angers a god of the sea, who sends powerful agents to attack the island and punish the destroyers.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WEAPON_1.name: Arma +1
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WEAPON_1.description: You have a +1 bonus to attack and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WEAPON_2.name: Arma +2
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WEAPON_2.description: You have a +2 bonus to attack and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WEAPON_3.name: Arma +3
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WEAPON_3.description: You have a +3 bonus to attack and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WEAPON_OF_WARNI.name: Arma de advertencia
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WEAPON_OF_WARNI.description:
As long as this weapon is within your reach and you are attuned to it, you and allies within 30 pies of you gain the following benefits.

Alarm. The weapon magically awakens each subject who is sleeping naturally when combat begins. This benefit doesn't wake a subject from magically induced sleep.

Supernatural Readiness. Each subject has ventaja on its Initiative rolls.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WHELM.name: Abismo (Whelm)

setters.keywords: enhancement, thrown, force, damage, construct, elemental, giant, constitution, saving throw, save, stunned, condition, detect evil and good, locate object, cooldown, dawn, sentience

attunement.addition: by a Dwarf or a Creature Attuned to a Belt of Dwarvenkind

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WHELM.description:
Whelm is a powerful weapon forged by dwarves and lost in the dungeon of White Plume Mountain.

You gain a +3 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with this magic weapon.

Hurl. Whelm has Thrown with a normal range of 60 pies and a long range of 180 pies. When you hit with a ranged tirada de ataque using Whelm, the target takes an extra 1d8 fuerza daño, or an extra 4d8 fuerza daño if the target is a Construct, an Elemental, or a Giant. Immediately after hitting or missing, the weapon flies back to your hand.

Shock Wave. You can take a Magic action to strike the ground with Whelm and send a shock wave out from the point of impact. Each creature of your choice on the ground within 60 pies of that point must succeed on a CD 20 Constitución tirada de salvación or have the Aturdido condition durante 1 minuto. A creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once used, this property can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

Supernatural Awareness. While you are holding the weapon, it alerts you to the location of any secret or concealed doors within 30 pies of you. In addition, you can cast Detect Evil and Good or Locate Object from the weapon. Once you cast either spell, you can't cast it from the weapon again hasta el próximo amanecer.

Sentience. Whelm is a sentient, Lawful Neutral weapon with an Inteligencia of 15, a Sabiduría of 12, and a Carisma of 15. It has hearing and Visión en la oscuridad out to 120 pies.

The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and speaks Dwarvish, Giant, and Goblin.

Personality. Whelm has ties to the dwarf clan that created it, called the Dankil or the Mightyhammer clan. It longs to be returned to that clan. Whelm's purpose is to protect dwarves. Conflict arises if the wielder doesn't share this goal.

Destroying Whelm. Whelm can be dissolved in the acidic bile of a recently slain ancient black dragon. It can also be melted down in the forges of the Mightyhammer dwarf clan, but only by the rightful leader of that clan.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ALCHEMY_JUG.name: Jarra de alquimia

setters.keywords: magic action, action, acid, poison, beer, honey, mayonnaise, oil, vinegar, water, wine

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ALCHEMY_JUG.description:
This ceramic jug appears to be able to hold a gallon of liquid and weighs 12 pounds whether full or empty. The jug sloshes when it is shaken, even if the jug is empty.

You can take a Magic action and name one liquid from the Alchemy Jug Liquids table to cause the jug to produce the chosen liquid. Afterward, you can uncork the jug as a Utilize action and pour that liquid out, up to 2 gallons per minute. The maximum amount of liquid the jug can produce depends on the liquid you named.

Once the jug starts producing a liquid, it can’t produce a different one, or more of one that has reached its maximum, hasta el próximo amanecer.

Alchemy Jug Liquids

Liquid | Max. Amount
ácido | 8 ounces
Basic veneno | 4 ounces
Beer | 4 gallons
Honey | 1 gallon
Mayonnaise | 2 gallons
Oil | 1 quart
Vinegar | 2 gallon
Water, fresh | 8 gallon
Water, salt | 12 gallon
Wine | 1 gallon

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_AMULET_OF_HEALT.name: Amuleto de salud
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_AMULET_OF_HEALT.description: Your Constitución score is 19 while you wear this amulet. It has no effect on you if your Constitución is already 19 or higher without it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_AMULET_OF_PROOF.name: Amuleto a prueba de detección y localización
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_AMULET_OF_PROOF.name_en: Amulet of Proof Against Detection and Location
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_AMULET_OF_PROOF.description: Mientras llevas amulet, you can’t be targeted by Divination spells or perceived through magical scrying sensors unless you allow it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_AMULET_OF_THE_P.name: Amuleto de los planos

setters.keywords: magic action, action, intelligence, arcana, skill check, check, plane shift, teleport, random

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_AMULET_OF_THE_P.description:
Mientras llevas amulet, you can take a Magic action to name a location that you are familiar with on another plane of existence. Then make a CD 15 Inteligencia (Arcana) check. On a successful check, you cast Plane Shift . On a failed check, you and each creature and object within 15 pies of you travel to a random destination determined by rolling 1d100 and consulting the following table.

1d100 | Destination
01-60 | Random location on the plane you named
61-70 | Random location on an Inner Plane determined by rolling 1d6: on a 1, the Plane of Air; on a 2, the Plane of Earth; on a 3, the Plane of fuego; on a 4, the Plane of Water; on a 5, the Feywild; on a 6, the Shadowfell
71-80 | Random location on an Outer Plane determined by rolling 1d8: on a 1, Arborea; on a 2, Arcadia; on a 3, the Beastlands; on a 4, Bytopia; on a 5, Elysium; on a 6, Mechanus; on a 7, Mount Celestia; on an 8, Ysgard
81-90 | Random location on an Outer Plane determined by rolling 1d8: on a 1, the Abyss; on a 2, Acheron; on a 3, Carceri; on a 4, Gehenna; on a 5, Hades; on a 6, Limbo; on a 7, the Nine Hells; on an 8, Pandemonium
91-00 | Random location on the Astral Plane

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_APPARATUS_OF_KW.name: Aparato de Kwalish
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_APPARATUS_OF_KW.description:
This item first appears to be a sealed iron barrel weighing 500 pounds. The barrel has a hidden catch, which can be found with a successful CD 20 Inteligencia (Investigation) check. Releasing the catch unlocks a hatch at one end of the barrel, allowing two Medium or smaller creatures to crawl inside. Ten levers are set in a row at the far end, each in a neutral position, able to move up or down. When certain levers are used, the apparatus transforms to resemble a giant lobster.

The Apparatus of Kwalish is a Large object with the following statistics: AC 20; HP 200; Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft. (or 0 ft. for both if the legs aren't extended); inmunidad to veneno and psíquico daño.

To be used as a vehicle, the apparatus requires one pilot. While the apparatus’s hatch is closed, the compartment is airtight and watertight. The compartment holds enough air for 10 hours of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.

The apparatus floats on water. It can also go underwater to a depth of 900 pies. Below that, the vehicle takes 2d6 contundente daño each minute from pressure.

A creature in the compartment can take a Utilize action to move as many as two of the apparatus’s levers up or down. After each use, a lever goes back to its neutral position. Each lever, from left to right, functions as shown in the Apparatus of Kwalish Levers table.

Apparatus of Kwalish Levers

Lever | Up | Down
1 | Legs extend, allowing the apparatus to walk and swim. | Legs retract, reducing the apparatus’s Speed and Swim Speed to 0 and making it unable to benefit from bonuses to speed.
2 | Forward window shutter opens. | Forward window shutter closes.
3 | Side window shutters open (two per side). | Side window shutters close (two per side).
4 | Two claws extend from the front side of the apparatus. | The claws retract.
5 | Each extended claw makes the following melee attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) contundente daño. | Each extended claw makes the following melee attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: The target has the Agarrado condition (escape CD 15).
6 | The apparatus walks or swims forward provided its legs are extended. | The apparatus walks or swims backward provided its legs are extended.
7 | The apparatus turns 90 degrees counterclockwise provided its legs are extended. | The apparatus turns 90 degrees clockwise provided its legs are extended.
8 | Eyelike fixtures emit Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 pies. | The light turns off.
9 | The apparatus sinks up to 20 pies if it’s in liquid. | The apparatus rises up to 20 pies if it’s in liquid.
10 | The rear hatch unseals and opens. | The rear hatch closes and seals.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BABA_YAGAS_DANC.name: Escoba danzarina de Baba Yaga
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BABA_YAGAS_DANC.description:
The archfey Baba Yaga crafted many of these magic brooms. No two appear exactly alike. While holding the broom, you can take a Magic action to transform it into an Animated Broom under your control. The broom then moves into an unoccupied space as close to you as possible. The broom acts immediately after you on your Initiative count and remains animate until you take a Bonus Action and use a command word to render it inanimate.

On your turn, you can mentally command the animated broom if it is within 30 pies of you and you don’t have the Incapacitado condition (no action required). You decide what action the broom takes and where it moves during its next turn, or you can issue it a general command, such as to attack your enemies or guard a location.

If the broom is reduced to 0 puntos de golpe, it shatters and is destroyed. If the broom reverts to its inanimate form before losing all its puntos de golpe it regains all of them.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BAG_OF_BEANS.name: Bolsa de judías

setters.keywords: sphere, dexterity, saving throw, save, force, damage, toadstool, constitution, poison, temporary hit points, thp, water, beer, mayonnaise, tea, vinegar, wine, oil, treant, shrieker fungi, bulette, ASI, ability score improvement, mummy lord

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BAG_OF_BEANS.description:
This heavy cloth bag contains 3d4 dry beans when found. The bag weighs half a pound regardless of how many beans it contains and becomes a nonmagical item when it no longer contains any beans.

If you dump one or more beans out of the bag, they explode in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on them. All the dumped beans are destroyed in the explosion, and each creature in the Sphere, including you, makes a CD 15 Destreza tirada de salvación, taking 5d4 fuerza daño on a failed save or half as much daño on a successful one.

If you remove a bean from the bag, plant it in dirt or sand, and then water it, the bean disappears as it produces an effect 1 minute later from the ground where it was planted. The DM can choose an effect from the following table or determine it randomly.

1d100 | Effect
01 | 5d4 toadstools sprout. If a creature eats a toadstool, roll any die. On an odd roll, the eater must succeed on a CD 15 Constitución tirada de salvación or take 5d6 veneno daño and have the venenoed condition durante 1 hora. On an even roll, the eater gains 5d6 Temporary puntos de golpe durante 1 hora.
02-10 | A geyser erupts and spouts water, beer, mayonnaise, tea, vinegar, wine, or oil (DM’s choice) 30 pies into the air for 1d4 minutes.
11-20 | A Treant sprouts. Roll any die. On an odd roll, the treant is Chaotic Evil. On an even roll, the treant is Chaotic Good.
21-30 | An animate but immobile stone statue in your likeness rises and makes verbal threats against you. If you leave it and others come near, it describes you as the most heinous of villains and directs the newcomers to find and attack you. If you are on the same plane of existence as the statue, it knows where you are. The statue becomes inanimate after 24 hours.
31-40 | A campfire with green flames springs forth and burns for 24 hours or until it is extinguished.
41-50 | Three Shrieker Fungi sprout.
51-60 | 1d4 + 4 bright-pink toads crawl forth. Whenever a toad is touched, it transforms into a Large or smaller monster of the DM’s choice that acts in accordance with its alignment and nature. The monster remains for 1 minute, then disappears in a puff of bright-pink smoke.
61-70 | A hungry Bulette burrows up and attacks.
71-80 | A fruit tree grows. It has 1d10 + 20 fruit, 1d8 of which act as randomly determined potions. The tree vanishes after 1 hour. Picked fruit remains, retaining any magic for 30 days.
81-90 | A nest of 1d4 + 3 rainbow-colored eggs springs up. Any creature that eats an egg makes a CD 20 Constitución tirada de salvación. On a successful save, a creature permanently increases its lowest ability score by 1, randomly choosing among equally low scores. On a failed save, the creature takes 10d6 fuerza daño from an internal explosion.
91-95 | A pyramid with a 60-foot-square base bursts upward. Inside is a burial chamber containing a Mummy , a Mummy Lord , or some other Undead of the DM’s choice. Its sarcophagus contains treasure of the DM’s choice.
96-00 | A giant beanstalk sprouts, growing to a height of the DM’s choice. The top leads where the DM chooses, such as to a great view, a cloud giant’s castle, or another plane of existence.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BAG_OF_DEVOURIN.name: Bolsa devoradora
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BAG_OF_DEVOURIN.description:
This bag resembles a Bag of Holding but is a feeding orifice for a gigantic extradimensional creature. Turning the bag inside out closes the orifice.

The extradimensional creature attached to the bag can sense whatever is placed inside the bag. Animal or vegetable matter placed wholly in the bag is devoured and lost forever. When part of a living creature is placed in the bag, as happens when someone reaches inside it, there is a 50 percent chance that the creature is pulled inside the bag. A creature inside the bag can take an action to try to escape, doing so with a successful CD 15 Fuerza (Athletics) check. Another creature can take an action to reach into the bag to pull a creature out, doing so with a successful CD 20 Fuerza (Athletics) check, provided the puller isn’t pulled inside the bag first. Any creature that starts its turn inside the bag is devoured, its body destroyed.

Inanimate objects can be stored in the bag, which can hold a cubic pie of such material. However, once each day, the bag swallows any objects inside it and spits them out into another plane of existence. The DM determines the time and plane.

If the bag is pierced or torn, it is destroyed, and anything contained within it is transported to a random location on the Astral Plane.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BAG_OF_HOLDING.name: Bolsa de contención
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BAG_OF_HOLDING.description:
This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions—roughly 2 pies square and 4 pies deep on the inside. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic pies. The bag weighs 5 pounds, regardless of its contents. Retrieving an item from the bag requires a Utilize action.

If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it is destroyed, and its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane. If the bag is turned inside out, its contents spill forth unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. The bag holds enough air for 10 minutes of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.

Placing a Bag of Holding inside an extradimensional space created by a Heward’s Handy Haversack , Portable Hole , or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on the gate is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way and can’t be reopened.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BAG_OF_TRICKS_G.name: Bolsa de trucos (Gris)

setters.keywords: magic action, action, summoning, companions, weasel, giant rat, badger, boar, panther, giant badger, dire wolf, giant elk

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BAG_OF_TRICKS_G.description:
This bag made from gray cloth appears empty. Reaching inside the bag, however, reveals the presence of a small, fuzzy object.

You can take a Magic action to pull the fuzzy object from the bag and throw it up to 20 pies. When the object lands, it transforms into a creature you determine by rolling on the table below. See the Monster Manual (2025) for the creature’s stat block. The creature vanishes at the next dawn or when it is reduced to 0 puntos de golpe.

The creature is Friendly to you and your allies, and it acts immediately after you on your Initiative count. You can take a Bonus Action to command how the creature moves and what action it takes on its next turn, such as attacking an enemy. In the absence of such orders, the creature acts in a fashion appropriate to its nature.

Once three fuzzy objects have been pulled from the bag, the bag can’t be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

1d8 | Creature
1 | Weasel
2 | Giant Rat
3 | Badger
4 | Boar
5 | Panther
6 | Giant Badger
7 | Dire Wolf
8 | Giant Elk

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BEAD_OF_FORCE.name: Cuenta de fuerza

setters.keywords: magic action, action, throw, dexterity, saving throw, save, force, damage, globe of invulnerability, invulnerability

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BEAD_OF_FORCE.description:
This small black sphere measures 3/4 of an inch in diameter and weighs an ounce. Typically, 1d4 + 4 Beads of fuerza are found together.

You can take a Magic action to throw the bead up to 60 pies. The bead explodes in a 10-foot-radius Sphere on impact and is destroyed. Each creature in the Sphere must succeed on a CD 15 Destreza tirada de salvación or take 5d4 fuerza daño. A sphere of transparent force then encloses the area durante 1 minuto. Any creature that failed the save and is completely within the area is trapped inside this sphere. Creatures that succeeded on the save or are partially within the area are pushed away from the center of the sphere until they are no longer inside it. Only breathable air can pass through the sphere’s wall. No attack or other effect can pass through.

An enclosed creature can take a Utilize action to push against the sphere’s wall, moving the sphere up to half the creature’s Speed. The sphere can be picked up, and its magic causes it to weigh only 1 pound, regardless of the weight of creatures inside.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BEAD_OF_NOURISH.name: Cuenta de sustento
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BEAD_OF_NOURISH.description: This flavorless, gelatinous bead dissolves on your tongue and provides as much nourishment as 1 day of Rations.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BEAD_OF_REFRESH.name: Cuenta de refresco
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BEAD_OF_REFRESH.description: This flavorless, gelatinous bead dissolves in liquid, transforming up to a pint of the liquid into fresh, cold drinking water. The bead has no effect on magical liquids or harmful substances such as poison.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BELT_OF_DWARVEN.name: Cinturón de la raza enana

setters.keywords: dwarvish, advantage, charisma, persuasion, skill, ability, checks, constitution, ASI, ability score improvement, darkvision, resistance, poison, condition, poisoned

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BELT_OF_DWARVEN.description:
Mientras llevas belt, you gain the following benefits:

Dwarvish. You know Dwarvish.

Friend of Dwarvenkind. You have ventaja on Carisma (Persuasion) checks made to interact with dwarves and duergar.

Toughness. Your Constitución increases by 2, to a maximum of 20.

In addition, while attuned to the belt, you have a 50 percent chance each day at dawn of growing a full beard if you can grow one, or a thicker beard if you already have one.

If you aren’t a dwarf or duergar, you gain the following additional benefits while wearing the belt:

Visión en la oscuridad. You have Visión en la oscuridad with a range of 60 pies.

Resilience. You have resistencia to veneno daño. You also have ventaja on tiradas de salvación you make to avoid or end the venenoed condition.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BELT_OF_HILL_GI.name: Cinturón de fuerza de gigante de las colinas

setters.keywords: ability score set, ability score change

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BELT_OF_HILL_GI.description: Mientras llevas belt, your Fuerza score changes to 21. The item has no effect on you if your Fuerza without the belt is equal to or greater than the belt’s score.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BELT_OF_STONE_G.name: Cinturón de fuerza de gigante de piedra

setters.keywords: ability score set, ability score change

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BELT_OF_STONE_G.description: Mientras llevas belt, your Fuerza score changes to 23. The item has no effect on you if your Fuerza without the belt is equal to or greater than the belt’s score.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BELT_OF_FROST_G.name: Cinturón de fuerza de gigante de escarcha

setters.keywords: ability score set, ability score change

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BELT_OF_FROST_G.description: Mientras llevas belt, your Fuerza score changes to 23. The item has no effect on you if your Fuerza without the belt is equal to or greater than the belt’s score.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BELT_OF_FIRE_GI.name: Cinturón de fuerza de gigante de fuego

setters.keywords: ability score set, ability score change

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BELT_OF_FIRE_GI.description: Mientras llevas belt, your Fuerza score changes to 25. The item has no effect on you if your Fuerza without the belt is equal to or greater than the belt’s score.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BELT_OF_CLOUD_G.name: Cinturón de fuerza de gigante de las nubes

setters.keywords: ability score set, ability score change

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BELT_OF_CLOUD_G.description: Mientras llevas belt, your Fuerza score changes to 27. The item has no effect on you if your Fuerza without the belt is equal to or greater than the belt’s score.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BELT_OF_STORM_G.name: Cinturón de fuerza de gigante de las tormentas

setters.keywords: ability score set, ability score change

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BELT_OF_STORM_G.description: Mientras llevas belt, your Fuerza score changes to 29. The item has no effect on you if your Fuerza without the belt is equal to or greater than the belt’s score.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOOK_OF_EXALTED.name: Libro de los hechos exaltados

setters.keywords: immunity, charmed, frightened, resistance, psychic, wisdom, ASI, ability score improvement, bright light, dim light, bonus action, advantage, charisma, persuasion, skill check, ability check, check, minor beneficial properties, major beneficial properties

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOOK_OF_EXALTED.description:
The definitive treatise on all that is good in the multiverse, the Book of Exalted Deeds figures prominently in many religions. Rather than being a scripture devoted to a particular faith, the book’s authors filled the pages with their own visions of true virtue, providing guidance for defeating evil.

The Book of Exalted Deeds rarely lingers in one place. As soon as the book is read, it vanishes to some other corner of the multiverse where its moral guidance can bring hope to an endangered world. Although attempts have been made to copy the work, efforts to do so fail to capture its magical nature or translate the benefits it offers to those pure of heart and firm of purpose.

A heavy clasp, wrought to look like angel wings, keeps the book’s contents secure. Only a creature that is attuned to the book can release the clasp that holds it shut. Once the book is opened, the attuned creature must spend 80 hours reading and studying the book to digest its contents and gain its benefits.

Other creatures that peruse the book’s open pages can read the text but glean no deeper meaning and reap no benefits. A Fiend, an Undead, or a servant of a god from the Lower Planes that tries to read from the book takes 24d6 radiante daño. This daño ignores resistencia and inmunidad, and it can’t be reduced or avoided by any means. A creature reduced to 0 puntos de golpe by this daño disappears in a flash and is destroyed, leaving its possessions behind. The book then vanishes, and the creature’s Attunement to it ends.

Benefits granted by the Book of Exalted Deeds last only as long as you strive to do good. If you fail to perform at least one act of kindness or generosity within the span of 10 days, or if you willingly perform an evil act, you lose all the benefits granted by the book.

Celestial Calm. While attuned to the book, you have inmunidad to the Hechizado and Asustado conditions and resistencia to psíquico daño. These benefits become permanent after you spend the requisite amount of time reading and studying the book.

Divine Sabiduría. After you spend the requisite amount of time reading and studying the book, your Sabiduría increases by 2, to a maximum of 24. You can’t gain this benefit from the book more than once.

Enlightened Magic. After you spend the requisite amount of time reading and studying the book, any spell slot you expend to cast a spell counts as a spell slot of one level higher.

Halo. After you spend the requisite amount of time reading and studying the book, you gain a protective halo. This halo sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 pies. You can dismiss or manifest the halo como acción adicional. While present, the halo gives you ventaja on Carisma (Persuasion) checks. In addition, Fiends and Undead within the halo’s Bright Light make tiradas de ataque against you with desventaja.

Random Properties. The Book of Exalted Deeds has the following random properties:

- 2 minor beneficial properties

- 2 major beneficial properties

Destroying the Book. The Book of Exalted Deeds can’t be destroyed. However, drowning the book in the River Styx removes all writing and imagery from its pages and renders the book powerless for 1d100 years.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOOK_OF_VILE_DA.name: Libro de la oscuridad vil

setters.keywords: adjusted ability scores, ASI, ability score improvement, immunity, exhaustion, minor beneficial properties, major beneficial property, minor detrimental properties, major detrimental properties, spells, animate dead, circle of death, dominate monster, finger of death, intelligence, advantage, psychic, damage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOOK_OF_VILE_DA.description:
The contents of this foul manuscript are the meat and drink of the wicked. It contains knowledge so horrid that to even glimpse the scrawled pages invites doom.

Most believe the lich-god Vecna authored the Book of Vile Darkness. He recorded in its pages every horrid idea, every corrupt thought, and every example of foul magic he came across or devised.

Other practitioners of evil have added their own input to the book’s catalog of vile knowledge. Their additions are clear, for the writers of later works stitched whatever they were writing into the tome or, in some cases, made notations and additions to existing text. There are places where pages are missing, torn, or covered so completely with ink, blood, and scratches that the original text can’t be divined.

Nature can’t abide the book’s presence. Ordinary plants wither in its presence, common animals are unwilling to approach it, and the book gradually destroys whatever it touches. Even stone cracks and turns to powder if the book rests on it long enough.

Whenever a creature that isn’t a Fiend or an Undead attunes to the Book of Vile Darkness , that creature makes a CD 17 Carisma tirada de salvación. On a failed save, the creature is magically transformed into a Larva under the DM’s control. Only a Wish spell can reverse this vile transformation.

A creature attuned to the book must spend 80 hours reading and studying it to digest its contents and use its Adjusted Ability Scores, Tireless Form, Spells, Vile Lore, and Vile Speech properties.

The Book of Vile Darkness remains with you only as long as you strive to work evil in the world. If you fail to perform at least one evil act within the span of 10 days, or if you willingly perform a good act, the book disappears, your Attunement to it ends immediately, and you lose all benefits granted by it. If you die while attuned to the book, an entity of great evil claims your soul. You can’t be restored to life by any means while your soul remains imprisoned.

Adjusted Ability Scores. One ability score of your choice increases by 2, to a maximum of 24. Another ability score of your choice decreases by 2, to a minimum of 3. The book can’t adjust your ability scores again.

Tireless Form. While the book is on your person, you have inmunidad to the Agotamiento condition.

Random Properties. The Book of Vile Darkness has the following random properties:

- 3 minor beneficial properties

- 1 major beneficial property

- 3 minor detrimental properties

- 2 major detrimental properties

Spells. While holding the book, you can cast the following spells (save CD 18) from it:

- Animate Dead

- Circle of Death

- Dominate Monster

- Finger of Death

Once you use the book to cast a spell, you can’t cast that spell again from it hasta el próximo amanecer.

Vile Lore. You can reference the Book of Vile Darkness whenever you make an Inteligencia check to recall information about some aspect of evil, such as lore about demons. When you do so, you have ventaja on that check.

At the DM’s discretion, the book might reveal secrets no mortal should know, such as the true names of powerful Fiends, foul rites that allow one to transform into a death knight or lich, or long-lost spells crafted by beings so evil their names ought never to be spoken aloud.

Vile Speech. While the book is on your person, you can take a Magic action to recite words from its pages in a foul, dead language. Each time you do so, you take 1d12 psíquico daño, and each creature within 15 pies of you takes 3d6 psíquico daño unless the creature is a Fiend or an Undead.

Destroying the Book. The Book of Vile Darkness allows pages to be torn from it, but any evil lore contained on those pages finds its way back into the book eventually, usually when a new author adds pages to the tome.

If a solar tears the book in two, the book is destroyed for 1d100 years, after which it re-forms in some far corner of the multiverse.

A creature attuned to the book for 100 years can unearth a phrase hidden in the original text that, when translated to Celestial and spoken aloud, destroys both the speaker and the book in a flash of radiance. However, as long as evil exists in the multiverse, the book re-forms 1d10 × 100 years later.
