ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOOTS_OF_ELVENK.name: Botas élficas

setters.keywords: advantage, dexterity, stealth, skill checks, ability checks, check

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOOTS_OF_ELVENK.description: While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are moving across. You also have ventaja on Destreza (Stealth) checks.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOOTS_OF_FALSE_.name: Botas de huellas falsas
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOOTS_OF_FALSE_.description: While wearing these boots, you can have them leave tracks like those of any kind of Humanoid of your size.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOOTS_OF_LEVITA.name: Botas de levitación
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOOTS_OF_LEVITA.description: While you wear these boots, you can cast Levitate on yourself.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOOTS_OF_SPEED.name: Botas de velocidad

setters.keywords: bonus action, speed, disadvantage, opportunity attacks

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOOTS_OF_SPEED.description:
While you wear these boots, you can take a Bonus Action to click the boots’ heels together. If you do, the boots double your Speed, and any creature that makes an Opportunity Attack against you has desventaja on the tirada de ataque. If you click your heels together again, you end the effect.

When you’ve used the boots’ property for a total of 10 minutes, the magic ceases to function for you until you finish a descanso largo.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOOTS_OF_STRIDI.name: Botas de zancada y salto
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOOTS_OF_STRIDI.description:
While you wear these boots, your Speed becomes 30 pies unless your Speed is higher, and your Speed isn’t reduced by you carrying weight in excess of your carrying capacity or wearing Heavy Armor.

Once on each of your turns, you can jump up to 30 pies by spending only 10 pies of movement.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOOTS_OF_THE_WI.name: Botas de las tierras invernales
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOOTS_OF_THE_WI.description:
These furred boots are snug and feel warm. While wearing them, you gain the following benefits.

frío resistencia. You have resistencia to frío daño and can tolerate temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower without any additional protection.

Winter Strider. You ignore Difficult Terrain created by ice or snow.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOWL_OF_COMMAND.name: Cuenco de dominio de elementales de agua

setters.keywords: magic action, action, summoning, companion, water elemental, bonus action

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BOWL_OF_COMMAND.description:
While this bowl is filled with water and you are within 5 pies of it, you can take a Magic action to summon a Water Elemental. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the bowl as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it como acción adicional. The bowl can’t be used this way again hasta el próximo amanecer.

The bowl is about 1 pie in diameter and half as deep. It holds about 3 gallons.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BRACERS_OF_ARCH.name: Brazales de tiro con arco
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BRACERS_OF_ARCH.description: While wearing these bracers, you have proficiency with the Longbow and Shortbow, and you gain a +2 bonus to tiradas de daño made with such weapons.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BRACERS_OF_DEFE.name: Brazales de defensa
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BRACERS_OF_DEFE.description: While wearing these bracers, you gain a +2 bonus to Clase de Armadura if you are wearing no armor and using no Shield.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BRAZIER_OF_COMM.name: Brasero de dominio de elementales de fuego

setters.keywords: magic action, action, summoning, companion, fire elemental, bonus action

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BRAZIER_OF_COMM.description: While you are within 5 pies of this brazier, you can take a Magic action to summon a fuego Elemental. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it como acción adicional. The brazier can’t be used this way again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BROOCH_OF_SHIEL.name: Broche de escudo
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BROOCH_OF_SHIEL.description: Mientras llevas brooch, you have resistencia to fuerza daño, and you have inmunidad to daño from the Magic Missile spell.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BROOM_OF_FLYING.name: Escoba voladora
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_BROOM_OF_FLYING.description:
This wooden broom functions like a mundane broom until you stand astride it and take a Magic action to make it hover beneath you, at which time it can be ridden in the air. It has a Fly Speed of 50 pies. It can carry up to 400 pounds, but its Fly Speed becomes 30 pies while carrying over 200 pounds. The broom stops hovering when you land or when you’re no longer riding it.

Como acción de Magia, you can send the broom to travel alone to a destination within 1 mile of you if you name the location and are familiar with it. The broom comes back to you when you take a Magic action and use a command word if the broom is still within 1 mile of you.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CANDLE_OF_INVOC.name: Vela de invocación

setters.keywords: magic action, action, dim light, advantage, saving throws, saves, ability checks, skill checks, checks, attacks, d20 tests, gate

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CANDLE_OF_INVOC.description:
This candle’s magic is activated when the candle is lit, which requires a Magic action. After burning for 4 hours, the candle is destroyed. You can snuff it out early for use at a later time. Deduct the time it burned in increments of 1 minute from its total burn time.

While lit, the candle sheds Dim Light in a 30-foot radius. While you are within that light, you have ventaja on D20 Tests. In addition, a Cleric or Druid in the light can cast level 1 spells they have prepared without expending spell slots.

Alternatively, when you light the candle for the first time, you can cast Gate with it. Doing so destroys the candle. The portal created by the spell links to a particular Outer Plane chosen by the DM or determined by rolling on the following table.

1d100 | Outer Plane
01-05 | Abyss
06-10 | Acheron
11-17 | Arborea
18-25 | Arcadia
26-33 | Beastlands
34-41 | Bytopia
42-46 | Carceri
47-54 | Elysium
55-59 | Gehenna
60-64 | Hades
65-69 | Limbo
70-77 | Mechanus
78-85 | Mount Celestia
86-90 | Nine Hells
91-95 | Pandemonium
96-00 | Ysgard

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CANDLE_OF_THE_D.name: Vela de las profundidades
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CANDLE_OF_THE_D.description: The flame of this candle isn’t extinguished when immersed in water. It gives off light and heat like a normal candle.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CAPE_OF_THE_MOU.name: Capa del charlatán

setters.keywords: dimension door, magic action, action, teleport

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CAPE_OF_THE_MOU.description:
This cape smells faintly of brimstone. While wearing it, you can use it to cast Dimension Door como acción de Magia. This property can’t be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

When you teleport with that spell, you leave behind a cloud of smoke. The space you left is Lightly Obscured by that smoke until the end of your next turn.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CAP_OF_WATER_BR.name: Gorro de respiración acuática
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CAP_OF_WATER_BR.description: Mientras llevas cap underwater, you can take a Magic action to create a bubble of air around your head. This bubble allows you to breathe normally underwater. This bubble stays with you until the cap is removed or you are no longer underwater.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CARPET_OF_FLYIN.name: Alfombra voladora
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CARPET_OF_FLYIN.description:
You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a Magic action and using the carpet’s command word. It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 pies of it.

Four sizes of Carpet of Flying exist. The DM chooses the size of a given carpet or determines it randomly by rolling on the following table. A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but its Fly Speed is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity.

Applicable Carpet Sizes

1d100 | Size | Capacity | Fly Speed
01-20 | 3 ft. x 5 ft. | 200 lb. | 80 pies
21-55 | 4 ft. x 6 ft. | 400 lb. | 60 pies
56-80 | 5 ft. x 7 ft. | 600 lb. | 40 pies
81-00 | 6 ft. x 9 ft. | 800 lb. | 30 pies

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CAULDRON_OF_REB.name: Caldero del renacimiento

setters.keywords: spellcasting focus, focus, scrying, potion of healing, potion of greater healing, raise dead, magic action, action

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CAULDRON_OF_REB.description:
This Tiny pot bears relief scenes of heroes on its cast-iron sides.

You can use the cauldron as a canalizador mágico for your spells, and it functions as a suitable component for the Scrying spell.

Brew Potion. When you finish a descanso largo, you can use the cauldron to create a Potion of Greater Healing , which takes 1 minute. The potion lasts for 24 hours, then loses its magic if not consumed.

Raise Dead. Como acción de Magia, you can cause the cauldron to grow large enough for a Medium creature to crouch within. You can revert the cauldron to its normal size como acción de Magia, harmlessly shunting anything that can’t fit inside to the nearest unoccupied space.

If you place the corpse of a Humanoid into the cauldron and cover the corpse with 200 pounds of salt (which costs 10 GP) for at least 8 hours, the salt is consumed and the creature returns to life as if by Raise Dead at the next dawn. Once used, this property can’t be used again for 7 days.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CENSER_OF_CONTR.name: Incensario de control de elementales de aire

setters.keywords: magic action, action, summoning, companion, air elemental, bonus action

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CENSER_OF_CONTR.description: While gently swinging this censer, you can take a Magic action to summon an Air Elemental . The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the censer as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it como acción adicional. The censer can’t be used this way again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHARLATANS_DIE.name: Dado de charlatán
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHARLATANS_DIE.description: Whenever you roll this six-sided die, you can control which number it rolls.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHIME_OF_OPENIN.name: Campanilla de apertura
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CHIME_OF_OPENIN.description:
This hollow metal tube measures about 1 pie long and weighs 1 pound. Como acción de Magia, you can strike the chime to cast Knock . The spell’s customary knocking sound is replaced by the clear, ringing tone of the chime, which is audible out to 300 pies.

The chime can be used 10 times. After the tenth time, it cracks and becomes useless.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CIRCLET_OF_BLAS.name: Diadema de explosión

setters.keywords: magic action, action, scorching ray, fire, damage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CIRCLET_OF_BLAS.description: Mientras llevas circlet, you can cast Scorching Ray with it (+5 to hit). The circlet can’t cast this spell again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_ARACHN.name: Capa de la arácnida
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_ARACHN.description:
This fine garment is made of black silk interwoven with faint, silvery threads. While wearing it, you gain the following benefits.

veneno resistencia. You have resistencia to veneno daño.

Spider Climb. You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed and can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving your hands free.

Web. You can cast Web (save CD 13). The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area. Once used, this property can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_BILLOW.name: Capa ondeante
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_BILLOW.description: Mientras llevas cloak, you can take a Bonus Action to make it billow dramatically durante 1 minuto.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_DISPLA.name: Capa de desplazamiento
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_DISPLA.description: While you wear this cloak, it magically projects an illusion that makes you appear to be standing in a place near your actual location, causing any creature to have desventaja on tiradas de ataque against you. If you take daño, the property ceases to function until the start of your next turn. This property is suppressed while your Speed is 0.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_ELVENK.name: Capa élfica

setters.keywords: wisdom, perception, disadvantage, dexterity, stealth, advantage, skill checks, ability checks, checks

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_ELVENK.description: While you wear this cloak, Sabiduría (Perception) checks made to perceive you have desventaja, and you have ventaja on Destreza (Stealth) checks.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_INVISI.name: Capa de invisibilidad
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_INVISI.description: This cloak has 3 cargas and recupera 1d3 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While wearing the cloak, you can take a Magic action to pull its hood over your head and expend 1 carga to give yourself the Invisible condition durante 1 hora. The effect ends early if you pull the hood down (no action required) or cease wearing the hood.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_MANY_F.name: Capa de muchas modas
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_MANY_F.description: Mientras llevas cloak, you can take a Bonus Action to change the style, color, and apparent quality of the garment. The cloak’s weight doesn’t change. Regardless of its appearance, the cloak can’t be anything but a cloak. Although it can duplicate the appearance of other magic cloaks, it doesn’t gain their magical properties.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_PROTEC.name: Capa de protección
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_PROTEC.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Clase de Armadura and tiradas de salvación while you wear this cloak.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_THE_BA.name: Capa del murciélago

setters.keywords: advantage, dexterity, stealth, skill checks, ability checks, checks, fly, speed, polymorph, bat

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_THE_BA.description:
Mientras llevas cloak, you have ventaja on Destreza (Stealth) checks. In an area of Dim Light or Darkness, you can grip the edges of the cloak and use it to gain a Fly Speed of 40 pies. If you ever fail to grip the cloak’s edges while flying in this way, or if you are no longer in Dim Light or Darkness, you lose this Fly Speed.

While wearing the cloak in an area of Dim Light or Darkness, you can cast Polymorph on yourself, shape-shifting into a Bat. While in that form, you retain your Inteligencia, Sabiduría, and Carisma scores. The cloak can’t be used this way again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_THE_MA.name: Capa de la mantarraya
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOAK_OF_THE_MA.description: Mientras llevas cloak, you can breathe underwater, and you have a Swim Speed of 60 pies.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOCKWORK_AMULE.name: Amuleto de relojería
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOCKWORK_AMULE.description:
This copper amulet contains tiny interlocking gears and is powered by magic from Mechanus, a plane of clockwork predictability. Faint ticking and whirring noises emanate from within.

When you make an tirada de ataque while wearing the amulet, you can forgo rolling the d20 to get a 10 on the die. Once used, this property can’t be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOTHES_OF_MEND.name: Ropas de reparación
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CLOTHES_OF_MEND.description: This elegant outfit magically mends itself to counteract daily wear and tear. Pieces of the outfit that are destroyed can’t be repaired in this way.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CRYSTAL_BALL.name: Bola de cristal
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CRYSTAL_BALL.description: While touching it, you can cast the Scrying spell (save CD 17) with it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CRYSTAL_BALL_OF.name: Bola de cristal de lectura de mentes
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CRYSTAL_BALL_OF.description: While touching this crystal orb, you can cast Scrying (save CD 17) with it. In addition, you can cast Detect Thoughts (save CD 17) targeting creatures you can see within 30 pies of the spell’s sensor. You don’t need to concentrate on this Detect Thoughts spell to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if the Scrying spell ends.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CRYSTAL_BALL_OF.name: Bola de cristal de telepatía
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CRYSTAL_BALL_OF.description: While touching this crystal orb, you can cast Scrying (save CD 17) with it. In addition, you can communicate telepathically with creatures you can see within 30 pies of the spell’s sensor. You can also cast Suggestion (save CD 17) through the sensor on one of those creatures. You don’t need to concentrate on this Suggestion to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if Scrying ends. You can’t cast Suggestion in this way again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CRYSTAL_BALL_OF.name: Bola de cristal de visión verdadera
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CRYSTAL_BALL_OF.description: While touching this crystal orb, you can cast Scrying (save CD 17) with it. In addition, you have Visión verdadera with a range of 120 pies centered on the spell’s sensor.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CUBE_OF_FORCE.name: Cubo de fuerza
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CUBE_OF_FORCE.description:
This cube is about an inch across. Each face has a distinct marking on it. You can press one of those faces, expend the number of cargas required for it, and thereby cast the spell associated with it, as shown in the Cube of fuerza Faces table.

The cube starts with 10 cargas, and it recupera 1d6 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer.

Cube of fuerza Faces

Spell | Charge Cost
Mage Armor | 1
Shield | 1
Leomund’s Tiny Hut | 3
Mordenkainen’s Private Sanctum | 4
Otiluke’s Resilient Sphere | 4
Wall of fuerza | 5

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CUBE_OF_SUMMONI.name: Cubo de invocación

setters.keywords: magic action, action, companion, summon aberration, summon beast, summon construct, summon dragon, summon elemental, summon fly

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CUBE_OF_SUMMONI.description:
This Tiny cube looks like a jack-in-the-box. When you wind its crank como acción de Magia, a merry tune emits from the box, the lid pops open, a creature appears in the nearest unoccupied space, and the lid closes. The lid can’t otherwise be opened.

Roll on the Cube of Summoning table to determine which spell the cube casts to summon the creature. The spell is cast at level 5 (save CD 17, +9 attack bonus) and doesn’t require Concentración, but you otherwise function as the spell’s caster.

Once the cube summons a creature, the cube can’t do so again hasta el próximo amanecer.

Cube of Summoning

1d6 | Spell
1 | Summon Aberration
2 | Summon Beast
3 | Summon Construct
4 | Summon Dragon
5 | Summon Elemental
6 | Summon Fey

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CUBIC_GATE.name: Puerta cúbica
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_CUBIC_GATE.description:
This cube is 3 inches across and radiates palpable magical energy. The six sides of the cube are each keyed to a different plane of existence, one of which is the Material Plane. The other sides are linked to planes determined by the DM.

The cube has 3 cargas and recupera 1d3 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. Como acción de Magia, you can expend 1 of the cube’s cargas to cast one of the following spells using the cube.

Gate. Pressing one side of the cube, you cast Gate , opening a portal to the plane of existence keyed to that side.

Plane Shift. Pressing one side of the cube twice, you cast Plane Shift , transporting the targets to the plane of existence keyed to that side.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DAERNS_INSTANT_.name: Fortaleza instantánea de Daern
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DAERNS_INSTANT_.description:
Como acción de Magia, you can place this 1-inch adamantine statuette on the ground and, using a command word, cause it to grow rapidly into a square adamantine tower. Repeating the command word causes the tower to revert to statuette form, which works only if the tower is empty. Each creature in the area where the tower appears is pushed to an unoccupied space outside but next to the tower. Objects in the area that aren’t being worn or carried are also pushed clear of the tower.

The tower is 20 pies on a side and 30 pies high, with arrow slits on all sides and a battlement atop it. Its interior is divided into two floors, with a ladder, staircase, or ramp (your choice) connecting them. This ladder, staircase, or ramp ends at a trapdoor leading to the roof. When created, the tower has a single door at ground level on the side facing you. The door opens only at your command, which you can issue como acción adicional. It is immune to the Knock spell and similar magic.

Magic prevents the tower from being tipped over. The roof, the door, and the walls each have AC 20; HP 100; inmunidad to contundente, perforante, and cortante daño except that which is dealt by siege equipment; and resistencia to all other daño. Shrinking the tower back down to statuette form doesn’t repair daño to the tower. Only a Wish spell can repair the tower (this use of the spell counts as replicating a spell of level 8 or lower). Each casting of Wish causes the tower to regain all its puntos de golpe.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DARK_SHARD_AMUL.name: Amuleto de fragmento oscuro
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DARK_SHARD_AMUL.description:
This amulet is fashioned from a shard of resilient material originating from an otherworldly realm. While you are wearing it, you gain the following benefits.

canalizador mágico. You can use the amulet as a canalizador mágico for your Warlock spells.

Unknown Spell. Como acción de Magia, you can try to cast a cantrip that you don’t know. The cantrip must be on the Warlock spell list and have a casting time of an action, and you make a CD 10 Inteligencia (Arcana) check. On a successful check, you cast the spell. On a failed check, the spell fails, and the action used to cast it is wasted. In either case, you can’t use this property again until you finish a descanso largo.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DECANTER_OF_END.name: Decantador de agua inagotable

setters.keywords: magic action, action, strength, saving throw, save, bludgeoning, damage, prone, condition

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DECANTER_OF_END.description:
This stoppered flask sloshes when shaken, as if it contains water. The decanter weighs 2 pounds.

You can take a Magic action to remove the stopper and issue one of three command words, whereupon an amount of fresh water or salt water (your choice) pours out of the flask. The water stops pouring out at the start of your next turn. Choose from the following command words:

Splash. The decanter produces 1 gallon of water.

Fountain. The decanter produces 5 gallons of water.

Geyser. The decanter produces 30 gallons of water that gushes forth in a Line 30 pies long and 1 pie wide. If you’re holding the decanter, you can aim the geyser in one direction (no action required). One creature of your choice in the Line must succeed on a CD 13 Fuerza tirada de salvación or take 1d4 contundente daño and have the Derribado condition. Instead of a creature, you can target one object in the Line that isn’t being worn or carried and that weighs no more than 200 pounds. The object is knocked over by the geyser.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DECK_OF_ILLUSIO.name: Baraja de ilusiones
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DECK_OF_ILLUSIO.description:
This box contains a set of cards. A full deck has 34 cards: 32 depicting specific creatures and two with a mirrored surface. A deck found as treasure is usually missing 1d20 - 1 cards.

The magic of the deck functions only if its cards are drawn at random. You can take a Magic action to draw a card at random from the deck and throw it to the ground at a point within 30 pies of yourself. An illusion of a creature, determined by rolling on the Deck of Illusions table, forms over the thrown card and remains until dispelled. The illusory creature created by the card looks and behaves like a real creature of its kind, except that it can do no harm. While you are within 120 pies of the illusory creature and can see it, you can take a Magic action to move it anywhere within 30 pies of its card.

Any physical interaction with the illusory creature reveals it to be false, because objects pass through it. A creature that takes a Study action to visually inspect the illusory creature identifies it as an illusion with a successful CD 15 Inteligencia (Investigation) check. The illusion lasts until its card is moved or the illusion is dispelled (using a Dispel Magic spell or a similar effect). When the illusion ends, the image on its card disappears, and that card can’t be used again.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DECK_OF_MANY_TH.name: Baraja de muchas cosas
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DECK_OF_MANY_TH.description:
Usually found in a box or pouch, this deck contains a number of cards made of ivory or vellum. Most (75 percent) of these decks have thirteen cards, but some have twenty-two. Use the appropriate column of the Deck of Many Things table when randomly determining cards drawn from the deck.

Before you draw a card, you must declare how many cards you intend to draw and then draw them randomly. Any cards drawn in excess of this number have no effect. Otherwise, as soon as you draw a card from the deck, its magic takes effect. You must draw each card no more than 1 hour after the previous draw. If you fail to draw the chosen number, the remaining number of cards fly from the deck on their own and take effect all at once.

Once a card is drawn, it disappears. Unless the card is the Fool or Jester, the card reappears in the deck, making it possible to draw the same card twice. (Once the Fool or Jester has left the deck, reroll on the table if that card comes up again.)

Deck of Many Things

1d100 (13-Card Deck) | 1d100 (22-Card Deck) | Card
— | 01-05 | Balance
— | 06-10 | Comet
— | 11-14 | Donjon
01-08 | 15-18 | Euryale
— | 19-23 | Fates
09-16 | 24-27 | Flames
— | 28-31 | Fool
— | 32-36 | Gem
17-24 | 37-41 | Jester
25-32 | 42-46 | Key
33-40 | 47-51 | Knight
41-48 | 52-56 | Moon
— | 57-60 | Puzzle
49-56 | 61-64 | Rogue
57-64 | 65-68 | Ruin
— | 69-73 | Sage
65-72 | 74-77 | Skull
73-80 | 78-82 | Star
81-88 | 83-87 | Sun
— | 88-91 | Talons
89-96 | 92-96 | Throne
97-00 | 97-00 | Void

Each card’s effect is described below.

Balance. You can increase one of your ability scores by 2, to a maximum of 22, provided you also decrease another one of your ability scores by 2. You can’t decrease an ability that has a score of 5 or lower. Alternatively, you can choose not to adjust your ability scores, in which case this card has no effect.

Comet. The next time you enter combat against one or more Hostile creatures, you can select one of them as your foe when you roll Initiative. If you reduce your foe to 0 puntos de golpe during that combat, you have ventaja on Death Saving Throws for 1 year. If someone else reduces your chosen foe to 0 puntos de golpe or you don’t choose a foe, this card has no effect.

Donjon. You disappear and become entombed in a state of suspended animation in an extradimensional sphere. Everything you’re wearing and carrying disappears with you except for Artifacts, which stay behind in the space you occupied when you disappeared. You remain imprisoned until you are found and removed from the sphere. You can’t be located by any Divination magic, but a Wish spell can reveal the location of your prison. You draw no more cards.

Euryale. The card’s medusa-like visage curses you. You take a -2 penalty to tiradas de salvación while cursed in this way. Only a god or the magic of the Fates card can end this curse.

Fates. Reality’s fabric unravels and spins anew, allowing you to avoid or erase one event as if it never happened. You can use the card’s magic as soon as you draw the card or at any other time before you die.

Flames. A powerful devil becomes your enemy. The devil seeks your ruin and torments you, savoring your suffering before attempting to slay you. This enmity lasts until either you or the devil dies.

A Question of Emnity

Two of the cards in the Deck of Many Things can earn a character the enmity of another being. With the Flames card, the enmity is overt. The character should experience the devil's malevolent efforts on multiple occasions. Seeking out the fiend shouldn't be a simple task, and the adventurer should clash with the devil's allies and followers a few times before being able to confront the devil.

In the case of the Rogue card, the enmity is secret and should come from someone thought to be a friend or an ally. As Dungeon Master, you should wait for a dramatically appropriate moment to reveal this enmity, leaving the adventurer guessing who is likely to become a betrayer.

Fool. You have desventaja on D20 Tests for the next 72 hours. Draw another card; this draw doesn’t count as one of your declared draws.

Gem. Twenty-five pieces of jewelry worth 2,000 GP each or fifty gems worth 1,000 GP each appear at your pies.

Jester. You have ventaja on D20 Tests for the next 72 hours, or you can draw two additional cards beyond your declared draws.

Key. A Rare or rarer magic weapon with which you are proficient appears on your person. The DM chooses the weapon.

Knight. You gain the service of a Knight , who magically appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 pies of yourself. The knight has the same alignment as you and serves you loyally until death, believing the two of you have been drawn together by fate. Work with your DM to create a name and backstory for this NPC. The DM can use a different stat block to represent the knight, as desired.

Moon. You gain the ability to cast Wish 1d3 times.

Puzzle. Puzzle. Permanently reduce your Inteligencia or Sabiduría by 1d4 + 1 (to a minimum score of 1). You can draw one additional card beyond your declared draws.

Rogue. An NPC of the DM’s choice becomes Hostile toward you. You don’t know the identity of this NPC until they or someone else reveals it. Nothing less than a Wish spell or divine intervention can end the NPC’s hostility toward you.

Ruin. All forms of wealth that you carry or own, other than magic items, are lost to you. Portable property vanishes. Businesses, buildings, and land you own are lost in a way that alters reality the least. If you have a Bastion (see the Dungeon Master’s Guide (2024) , chapter 8), it is destroyed by some calamity beyond your control. Any documentation that proves you should own something lost to this card also disappears.

Sage. At any time you choose within one year of drawing this card, you can ask a question in meditation and mentally receive a truthful answer to that question.

Skull. An Avatar of Death appears in an unoccupied space as close to you as possible. The avatar targets only you with its attacks, appearing as a ghostly skeleton clad in a tattered black robe and carrying a spectral scythe. The avatar disappears when it drops to 0 puntos de golpe or you die. If an ally of yours deals daño to the avatar, that ally summons another Avatar of Death. The new avatar appears in an unoccupied space as close to that ally as possible and targets only that ally with its attacks. You and your allies can each summon only one avatar as a consequence of this draw. A creature slain by an avatar can’t be restored to life.

Star. Increase one of your ability scores by 2, to a maximum of 24.

Sun. A magic item (chosen by the DM) appears on your person. In addition, you gain 10 Temporary puntos de golpe diariamente al amanecer until you die.

Talons. Every magic item you wear or carry disintegrates. Artifacts in your possession vanish instead.

Throne. You gain proficiency and Expertise in your choice of History, Insight, Intimidation, or Persuasion. In addition, you gain rightful ownership of a small keep somewhere in the world. However, the keep is currently home to one or more monsters, which must be cleared out before you can claim the keep as yours.

The Void. Your soul is drawn from your body and contained in an object in a place of the DM’s choice. One or more powerful beings guard the place. While your soul is trapped in this way, your body is inert, ceases aging, and requires no food, air, or water. A Wish spell can’t return your soul to your body, but the spell reveals the location of the object that holds your soul. You draw no more cards.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DEMONOMICON_OF_.name: Demonomicón de Iggwilv

setters.keywords: intelligence, wisdom, survival, ability checks, skill checks, checks, magic action, action, magic circle, charisma, saving throw, save, maximum damage, max damage, minor beneficial properties, minor detrimental properties, major detrimental properties, spells, magic jar, planar ally, planar binding, plane shift, summon fiend, tasha's hideous laughter, tasha’s hideous laughter

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DEMONOMICON_OF_.description:
This treatise, composed by Iggwilv the archmage, documents the Abyss’s layers and inhabitants and is widely regarded as the most thorough and blasphemous tome of demonology in the multiverse. The tome recounts both the oldest and most current profanities of the Abyss and demons. Demons have attempted to censor the text, and while sections have been ripped from the book’s spine, the general chapters remain, ever revealing demonic secrets. Caged behind lines of script roils a secret piece of the Abyss itself, which keeps the book up-to-date, no matter how many pages are removed, and it longs to be more than mere reference material.

Abyssal Lore. You can reference the Demonomicon whenever you make an Inteligencia check to discern information about demons or a Sabiduría (Survival) check related to the Abyss. When you do so, you gain ventaja on the check.

Containment. The first ten pages of the Demonomicon are blank. As a Magic action while holding the book, you can target a Fiend that you can see that is trapped within the area of a Magic Circle spell. The Fiend must succeed on a CD 20 Carisma tirada de salvación with desventaja or become trapped within one of the Demonomicon’s blank pages, which fills with writing detailing the trapped creature’s widely known name and depravities. Once used, this action can’t be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

When you finish a descanso largo, if you and the Demonomicon are on the same plane of existence, one trapped creature within the book can attempt to possess you. You make a CD 20 Carisma tirada de salvación. On a failed save, you are possessed by the creature, which controls you like a puppet. Como acción de Magia, the possessing creature can release you and appear in the closest unoccupied space to you. On a successful save, the Fiend can’t try to possess you again for 7 days (but another Fiend trapped in the book can certainly try).

When the tome is discovered, it has 1d4 Fiends occupying its pages—typically an assortment of demons.

Ensnarement. While carrying the book, whenever you cast Magic Circle naming only Fiends or cast Planar Binding targeting a Fiend, the spell is cast at level 9, regardless of what level spell slot you used, if any. Additionally, the Fiend has desventaja on its tirada de salvación against the spell.

Fiendish Scourging. While carrying the book, when you make a tirada de daño for a spell you cast against a Fiend, you use the maximum possible result instead of rolling.

Random Properties. The Artifact has the following random properties:

- 2 minor beneficial properties

- 1 minor detrimental property

- 1 major detrimental property

Spells. The book has 8 cargas and regains 1d8 expended cargas diariamente al amanecer. While holding the book, you can take a Magic action to cast one of the spells (save CD 20) on the following table. The table indicates how many cargas you must expend to cast the spell.

Spell | Charge Cost
Magic Circle | 1
Magic Jar | 3
Planar Ally | 3
Planar Binding | 2
Plane Shift (to the Abyss only) | 3
Summon Fiend | 3
Tasha’s Hideous Laughter | 0

Destroying the Demonomicon. To destroy the book, six different demon lords must each tear out a sixth of the book’s pages. If this occurs, the pages reappear after 24 hours. Before all those hours pass, anyone who opens the book’s remaining binding is transported to a nascent layer of the Abyss that lies hidden within the book. At the heart of this deadly, semisentient domain lies a long-lost Artifact, Fraz-Urb’luu’s Staff . If the staff is dragged from the pocket plane, the tome is reduced to a mundane and out-of-date copy of the Tome of Zyx , the work that served as the foundation of the Demonomicon of Iggwilv . The Tome of Zyx can be destroyed like any ordinary book. Once the staff emerges, the demon lord Fraz-Urb’luu knows instantly.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DIMENSIONAL_SHA.name: Grilletes dimensionales
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DIMENSIONAL_SHA.description:
You can take a Utilize action to place these shackles on a creature that has the Incapacitado condition. The shackles adjust to fit a creature of Small to Large size. The shackles prevent a creature bound by them from using any method of extradimensional movement, including teleportation or travel to a different plane of existence. They don't prevent the creature from passing through an interdimensional portal.

You and any creature you designate when you use the shackles can take a Utilize action to remove them. Once every 30 days, the bound creature can make a CD 30 Fuerza (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the creature breaks free and destroys the shackles.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DREAD_HELM.name: Yelmo pavoroso
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DREAD_HELM.description: While you're wearing this fearsome steel helm, your eyes glow red and the rest of your face is hidden in shadow.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DRIFTGLOBE.name: Globo flotante
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DRIFTGLOBE.description:
This small sphere of thick glass weighs 1 pound. If you are within 60 pies of it, you can command it to emanate light equivalent to that of the Light or Daylight spell (your choice). Once used, the Daylight effect can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

You can issue another command como acción de Magia to make the illuminated globe rise into the air and float no more than 5 pies off the ground. The globe hovers in this way until you or another creature grasps it. If you move more than 60 pies from the hovering globe, it follows you until it is within 60 pies of you. It takes the shortest route to do so. If prevented from moving, the globe sinks gently to the ground and becomes inactive, and its light winks out.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DUST_OF_DISAPPE.name: Polvo de desaparición

setters.keywords: utilize action, action, emanation, invisible, condition, invisibility

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DUST_OF_DISAPPE.description: This powder resembles fine sand. There is enough of it for one use. When you take a Utilize action to throw the dust into the air, you and each creature and object within a 10-foot Emanation originating from you have the Invisible condition for 2d4 minutes. The duration is the same for all subjects, and the dust is consumed when its magic takes effect. Immediately after an affected creature makes an tirada de ataque, deals daño, or casts a spell, the Invisible condition ends for that creature.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DUST_OF_DRYNESS.name: Polvo de sequedad

setters.keywords: utilize action, action, cube, constitution, saving throw, save, necrotic, damage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DUST_OF_DRYNESS.description:
This small packet contains 1d6 + 4 pinches of dust. As a Utilize action, you can sprinkle a pinch of the dust over water, turning up to a 15-foot Cube of water into one marble-sized pellet, which floats or rests near where the dust was sprinkled. The pellet's weight is negligible. A creature can take a Utilize action to smash the pellet against a hard surface, causing the pellet to shatter and release the water the dust absorbed. Doing so destroys the pellet and ends its magic.

As a Utilize action, you can sprinkle a pinch of the dust on an Elemental within 5 pies of yourself that is composed mostly of water (such as a Water Elemental or a Water Weird). Such a creature exposed to a pinch of the dust makes a CD 13 Constitución tirada de salvación, taking 10d6 necrótico daño on a failed save or half as much daño on a successful one.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DUST_OF_SNEEZIN.name: Polvo de estornudos y asfixia

setters.keywords: utilize action, action, emanation, constitution, saving throw, save, incapacitated, condition

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_DUST_OF_SNEEZIN.description:
Found in a small container, this powder resembles Dust of Disappearance , and Identify reveals it to be such. There is enough of it for one use.

As a Utilize action, you can throw the dust into the air, forcing yourself and every creature in a 30- pie Emanation originating from you to make a CD 15 Constitución tirada de salvación. Constructs, Elementals, Oozes, Plants, and Undead succeed on the save automatically.

On a failed save, a creature begins sneezing uncontrollably; it has the Incapacitado condition and is suffocating. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The effect also ends on any creature targeted by a Lesser Restoration spell.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_EAR_HORN_OF_HEA.name: Trompetilla de audición
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_EAR_HORN_OF_HEA.description: While held up to your ear, this horn suppresses the effects of the Ensordecido condition on you.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_EFREETI_BOTTLE.name: Botella de efrit
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_EFREETI_BOTTLE.description:
When you take a Magic action to remove the stopper of this painted brass bottle, a cloud of thick smoke flows out of it. At the end of your turn, the smoke disappears with a flash of harmless fire, and an Efreeti appears in an unoccupied space within 30 pies of you.

The first time the bottle is opened, the DM rolls on the following table to determine what happens.

1d10 | Effect
1 | The efreeti attacks you. After fighting for 5 rounds, the efreeti disappears, and the bottle loses its magic.
2-9 | The efreeti understands your languages and obeys your commands for 1 hour, after which it returns to the bottle, and a new stopper contains it. The stopper can't be removed durante 24 horas. The next two times the bottle is opened, the same effect occurs. If the bottle is opened a fourth time, the efreeti escapes and disappears, and the bottle loses its magic.
10 | The efreeti understands your languages and can cast Wish once for you. It disappears when it grants the wish or after 1 hour, and the bottle loses its magic.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ELEMENTAL_GEM_B.name: Gema elemental (Zafiro azul)

setters.keywords: utilize action, action, summoning, companion, air elemental, bonus action

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ELEMENTAL_GEM_B.description: This gem contains a mote of elemental energy. When you take a Utilize action to break the gem, an Air Elemental is summoned, and the gem ceases to be magical. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the broken gem as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it como acción adicional.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ERSATZ_EYE.description: This magical eye replaces a real one that was lost or removed. You can insert or remove the Ersatz Eye como acción de Magia, and it can't be removed against your will while you are alive.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_EVERSMOKING_BOT.name: Botella humeante

setters.keywords: magic action, action, emanation, heavily obscured

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_EVERSMOKING_BOT.description:
Como acción de Magia, you can open or close this bottle.

Opening the bottle causes thick smoke to billow out, forming a cloud that fills a 60-foot Emanation originating from the bottle. The area within the smoke is Heavily Obscured.

Each minute the bottle remains open, the size of the Emanation increases by 10 pies until it reaches its maximum size of 120 pies.

Closing the bottle causes the cloud to become fixed in place until it disperses after 10 minutes. A strong wind (such as that created by the Gust of Wind spell) disperses the cloud after 1 minute.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_EYE_AND_HAND_OF.name: Ojo y Mano de Vecna

setters.keywords: minor beneficial properties, major beneficial properties, minor detrimental properties, alignment, neutral evil, truesight, spellcasting, charges, recharge, clairvoyance, crown of madness, disintegrate, dominate monster, eyebite, x-ray vision, magic action, action, strength, cold, damage, finger of death, sleep, slow, teleport, initiative, constitution, saving throw, save, necrotic, immunity, poison, poisoned, condition, regeneration, healing, wish

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_EYE_AND_HAND_OF.description:
Vecna was a mighty wizard who, through magic and conquest, forged a terrible empire. For all his power, however, Vecna feared death and took steps to prevent his demise by becoming a lich.

A treacherous lieutenant named Kas brought Vecna's rule to an end in a terrible battle. Of Vecna, all that remained were one hand and one eye, grisly Artifacts that still seek to work Vecna's will in the world.

The Eye of Vecna and the Hand of Vecna are separate Artifacts that might be found together or separately. The eye looks like a bloodshot organ torn free from the socket. The hand is a shriveled left extremity.

Random Properties of the Eye and Hand. The Eye of Vecna and the Hand of Vecna each have the following random properties:

- 1 minor beneficial property

- 1 major beneficial property

- 1 minor detrimental property

Attuning to the Eye. To attune to the eye, you must press it into your empty socket. The eye grafts itself to your head and remains there until you die. If the eye is ever removed, you die.

Properties of the Eye. While you are attuned to the eye, your alignment is Neutral Evil, and you gain the following benefits:

Visión verdadera. You have Visión verdadera out to 240 pies.

Spellcasting. The eye has 8 cargas and regains 1d4 + 4 expended cargas diariamente al amanecer. You can cast a spell on the Eye of Vecna Spells table from the eye (save CD 18). The table indicates how many cargas you must expend to cast the spell. Each time you cast a spell from the eye, there is a 5 percent chance that Vecna tears your soul from your body, devours it, and then takes control of the body like a puppet. If that happens, you become an NPC under the DM's control.

Eye of Vecna Spells

Spell | Charge Cost
Clairvoyance | 2
Crown of Madness | 1
Disintegrate | 4
Dominate Monster | 5
Eyebite | 4

X-ray Vision. You can take a Magic action to gain X-ray vision with a range of 30 pies durante 1 minuto. To you, solid objects within that radius appear transparent and don't prevent light from passing through themselves. The vision can penetrate 1 pie of stone, 1 inch of common metal, or up to 3 pies of wood or dirt. Thicker substances block the vision, as does a thin sheet of lead.

Attuning to the Hand. To attune to the hand, you must press it against the stump where your left hand was. The hand grafts itself to your arm and becomes a functioning appendage. If the hand is ever removed, you die.

Properties of the Hand. When you are attuned to the hand, your alignment is Neutral Evil, and you gain the following benefits:

Great Fuerza. Your Fuerza becomes 20 unless it is already 20 or higher.

Icy Touch. Any melee spell attack you make with the hand and any melee attack made with a weapon held by it deals an extra 2d8 frío daño on a hit.

Spellcasting. The hand has 8 cargas and regains 1d4 + 4 expended cargas diariamente al amanecer. You can cast a spell on the Hand of Vecna Spells table from the hand (save CD 18). The table indicates how many cargas you must expend to cast the spell. Each time you cast a spell from it, the hand casts Suggestion on you (save CD 18; no Concentración required), demanding that you commit an evil act. The hand might have a specific act in mind or leave it up to you.

Hand of Vecna Spells

Spell | Charge Cost
Finger of Death | 5
Sleep | 1
Slow | 2
Teleport | 3

Properties of the Eye and Hand. While attuned to both the hand and eye, you gain the following additional benefits:

Danger Sense. You have ventaja on Initiative rolls.

necrótico Reduction. Como acción de Magia, you can target one creature you can see within 5 pies of yourself. The target makes a CD 18 Constitución tirada de salvación, taking 7d6 necrótico daño on a failed save or half as much daño on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 puntos de golpe by this daño is transformed into green slime (see Dungeon Master’s Guide (2024) , page 76) that covers the ground in its space, each 5-foot square of slime representing a separate patch. Nonmagical objects worn or carried by the target that are made of metal or organic material are destroyed by the slime.

veneno inmunidad. You have inmunidad to veneno daño and the venenoed condition.

Regeneration. If you start your turn with at least 1 Hit Point, you regain 1d10 puntos de golpe.

Wish. You can cast Wish . Once used, this property can't be used again until 30 days have passed.

Destroying the Eye and Hand. If the Eye of Vecna and the Hand of Vecna are both attached to the same creature and that creature is slain by the Sword of Kas , both the eye and the hand burst into flame, turn to ash, and are destroyed. Any other attempt to destroy the eye or hand seems to work, but the Artifact reappears in one of Vecna's many hidden vaults, where it waits to be rediscovered.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_EYES_OF_CHARMIN.description: These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. They have 3 cargas. While wearing them, you can expend 1 or more cargas to cast Charm Person (save CD 13). For 1 carga, you cast the level 1 version of the spell. You increase the spell's level by one for each additional carga you expend. The lenses regain all expended cargas diariamente al amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_EYES_OF_MINUTE_.description: These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. setters.keywords: advantage, wisdom, perception, ability checks, skill checks, checks

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_FIGURINE_OF_WON.name: Figurilla de poder maravilloso (Grifo de bronce)

setters.keywords: magic action, action, summoning, companion, griffon, recharge, cooldown

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_FIGURINE_OF_WON.description:
A Figurine of Wondrous Power is a statuette small enough to fit in a pocket. If you take a Magic action to throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 pies of yourself, the figurine becomes a living creature specified in the figurine's description below. If the space where the creature would appear is occupied by other creatures or objects, or if there isn't enough space for the creature, the figurine doesn't become a creature.

The creature is Friendly to you and your allies. It understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions.

The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form. It reverts to a figurine early if its creature form drops to 0 puntos de golpe or if you take a Magic action while touching the creature to make it revert to figurine form. When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can't be used again until a certain amount of time has passed, as specified below.

Bronze Griffon (Rare). This bronze statuette is of a griffon rampant. It can become a Griffon for up to 6 hours. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 5 days have passed.

Goat of Terror. This figurine can become a Giant Goat for up to 3 hours. The goat can't attack, but you can (harmlessly) remove its horns and use them as weapons. Once it succeeds on the save, a creature is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours. Once the figurine has been used, it can't be used again until 15 days have passed.

While it has cargas, you can use it as often as you wish. When it runs out of cargas, it reverts to a figurine and can't be used again until 7 days have passed, when it regains all expended cargas.

Goat of Travail. This figurine can become a Giant Goat for up to 3 hours. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 30 days have passed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_FIGURINE_OF_WON.description:
A Figurine of Wondrous Power is a statuette small enough to fit in a pocket. If you take a Magic action to throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 pies of yourself, the figurine becomes a living creature specified in the figurine's description below. If the space where the creature would appear is occupied by other creatures or objects, or if there isn't enough space for the creature, the figurine doesn't become a creature.

The creature is Friendly to you and your allies. It understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions.

The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form. It reverts to a figurine early if its creature form drops to 0 puntos de golpe or if you take a Magic action while touching the creature to make it revert to figurine form. When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can't be used again until a certain amount of time has passed, as specified below.

Onyx Dog (Rare). This onyx statuette of a dog can become a Mastiff for up to 6 hours. The mastiff has an Inteligencia of 8 and can speak Common. It also has Vista ciega with a range of 60 pies. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_FIGURINE_OF_WON.name: Figurilla de poder maravilloso (Búho de serpentina)

setters.keywords: magic action, action, summoning, companion, giant owl, recharge, cooldown, telepathy, telepathic communication

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_FIGURINE_OF_WON.name: Figurilla de poder maravilloso (Cuervo de plata)

setters.keywords: magic action, action, summoning, companion, raven, recharge, cooldown, animal messenger

Serpentine Owl (Rare). This silver statuette of a raven can become a Raven for up to 12 hours. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 2 days have passed. While in raven form, the figurine grants you the ability to cast Animal Messenger on it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_FOLDING_BOAT.name: Bote plegable
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_FOLDING_BOAT.description:
This object appears as a wooden box that measures 12 inches long, 6 inches wide, and 6 inches deep. It weighs 4 pounds and floats. It can be opened to store items inside. This item also has three command words, each requiring a Magic action to use:

First Command Word. The box unfolds into a Rowboat.

Second Command Word. The box unfolds into a Keelboat.

Third Command Word. The Folding Boat folds back into a box if no creatures are aboard. Any objects in the vessel that can't fit inside the box remain outside the box as it folds. Any objects in the vessel that can fit inside the box do so.

When the box becomes a vessel, its weight becomes that of a normal vessel its size, and anything that was stored in the box remains in the boat.

Statistics for the Rowboat and Keelboat appear in the Player's Handbook (page 230). If either vessel is reduced to 0 puntos de golpe, the Folding Boat is destroyed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GAUNTLETS_OF_OG.name: Guanteletes de fuerza de ogro
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GAUNTLETS_OF_OG.description: Your Fuerza score is 19 while you wear these gauntlets. They have no effect on you if your Fuerza is 19 or higher without them.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GEM_OF_BRIGHTNE.name: Gema de brillo

setters.keywords: charges, magic action, action, bright light, dim light, bonus action, constitution, saving throw, save, blinded, condition, cone

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GEM_OF_BRIGHTNE.description:
This prism has 50 cargas. While you are holding it, you can take a Magic action and use one of three command words to cause one of the following effects:

First Command Word. The gem sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 pies. This effect doesn't expend a carga. It lasts until you take a Bonus Action to repeat the command word or until you use another function of the gem.

Second Command Word. You expend 1 carga and cause the gem to fire a brilliant beam of light at one creature you can see within 60 pies of yourself. The creature must succeed on a CD 15 Constitución tirada de salvación or have the Cegado condition durante 1 minuto. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Third Command Word. You expend 5 cargas and cause the gem to flare with intense light in a 30-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone makes a tirada de salvación as if struck by the beam created with the second command word.

When all of the gem's cargas are expended, the gem becomes a nonmagical jewel worth 50 GP.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GEM_OF_SEEING.name: Gema de visión

setters.keywords: charges, magic action, action, vision, truesight, recharge

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GEM_OF_SEEING.description:
This gem has 3 cargas. Como acción de Magia, you can expend 1 carga. For the next 10 minutes, you have Visión verdadera out to 120 pies when you peer through the gem.

The gem recupera 1d3 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GLOVES_OF_MISSI.name: Guantes atrapaproyectiles
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GLOVES_OF_MISSI.description: If you're hit by an tirada de ataque made with a Ranged or Thrown weapon while wearing these gloves, you can take a Reaction to reduce the daño by 1d10 plus your Destreza modifier if you have a free hand. If you reduce the daño to 0, you can catch the ammunition or weapon if it is small enough for you to hold in that hand.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GLOVES_OF_SWIMM.name: Guantes de natación y escalada

setters.keywords: climbing speed, swimming speed, strength, athletics, ability checks, skill checks, checks

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GLOVES_OF_SWIMM.description: While wearing these gloves, climbing and swimming don't cost you extra movement, and you gain a +5 bonus to Fuerza (Athletics) checks made to climb or swim.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GLOVES_OF_THIEV.name: Guantes de latrocinio

setters.keywords: dexterity, sleight of hand, ability checks, skill checks, checks

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GLOVES_OF_THIEV.description: These gloves are imperceptible while worn. While wearing them, you gain a +5 bonus to Destreza (Sleight of Hand) checks and Destreza checks.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GOGGLES_OF_NIGH.name: Gafas de la noche
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_GOGGLES_OF_NIGH.description: While wearing these dark lenses, you have Visión en la oscuridad out to 60 pies. If you already have Visión en la oscuridad, wearing the goggles increases its range by 60 pies.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HAG_EYE.name: Ojo de saga

setters.keywords: charges, darkvision, see invisibility, recharge, magic action, action

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HAG_EYE.description:
A Hag Eye has 3 cargas. While wearing or holding this item, you can expend 1 carga to cast Visión en la oscuridad (targeting yourself only) or See Invisibility . The Hag Eye recupera todas las cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer.

Coven Sensor. The Hag Eye is usually entrusted to a hag's minion for safekeeping and transport. Como acción de Magia, a hag who belongs to the coven that created the Hag Eye can see what the Hag Eye sees if the hag and the Hag Eye are on the same plane of existence. This effect lasts as long as the hag maintains Concentración. Multiple hags in the coven can see through the Hag Eye simultaneously.

Creating a Hag Eye. Only a hag coven can craft this item, which is made from a real eye coated in varnish and often fitted to a pendant or another wearable item. A hag coven can have only one Hag Eye at a time, and creating a new one requires all three members of the coven to perform a special rite. This rite takes 1 hour, and the hags can't perform it if one or more of them has the Incapacitado condition. If the hags take any other actions during this rite, the rite fails and ends.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HAT_OF_DISGUISE.name: Sombrero de disfraz
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HAT_OF_DISGUISE.description: Mientras llevas hat, you can cast the Disguise Self spell. The spell ends if the hat is removed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HAT_OF_MANY_SPE.name: Sombrero de muchos conjuros

setters.keywords: spellcasting focus, focus, wizard, spells, enlarge/reduce, faerie fire, fireball, gust of wind, invisibility, lightning bolt, phantasmal force, polymorph, stinking cloud, summoning, vial of acid, flask of alchemist's fire, crowbar, torch, dagger, rope with a grappling hook, bag of caltrops, gem, camel, constrictor snake, elephant, mule, swarm of bats, portal, planar travel

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HAT_OF_MANY_SPE.description:
This pointed hat has the following properties.

canalizador mágico. While holding the hat, you can use it as a canalizador mágico for your Wizard spells. Any spell you cast using the hat gains a special Somatic component: you must reach into the hat and "pull" the spell out of it.

Unknown Spell. While holding the hat, you can try to cast a level 1+ spell you don't know. The spell must be on the Wizard spell list, it must be of a level you can cast, and it can't have Material components costing more than 1,000 GP. Once you decide on the spell, you must expend a spell slot of the spell's level. Then, to determine whether you cast the spell, make an Inteligencia (Arcana) check (CD 10 plus the spell's level). On a successful check, you cast the spell using its normal casting time, and you can't use this property again until you finish a descanso corto o largo. On a failed check, you fail to cast the spell and a random effect occurs instead, determined by rolling on the following table.

Any spell you cast from the hat uses your CD de salvación de conjuros and spell attack bonus.

1d100 | Effect
01-50 | You cast a random spell determined by rolling 1d10: on a 1 , Enlarge/Reduce (enlarge effect); on a 2 , Enlarge/Reduce (reduce effect); on a 3 , Faerie fuego ; on a 4 , fuegoball ; on a 5 , Gust of Wind ; on a 6 , Invisibility (cast on yourself); on a 7 , relámpago Bolt ; on an 8 , Phantasmal fuerza ; on a 9 , Polymorph ; on a 10 , Stinking Cloud .
51-55 | You have the Aturdido condition until the end of your next turn, believing something awesome just happened.
56-60 | A harmless swarm of butterflies fills a 10-foot Cube within 30 pies of yourself. The swarm disperses after 1 minute.
61-65 | You pull a nonmagical object out of the hat. Roll 1d4 to determine the object: on a 1 , a vial of ácido; on a 2 , a flask of Alchemist's fuego; on a 3 , a Crowbar; on a 4 , a lit Torch.
66-70 | You suffer a bout of "magic sickness" and have the venenoed condition durante 1 hora.
71-75 | You have the Petrificado condition until the end of your next turn.
76-80 | You pull a nonmagical object out of the hat. Roll 1d4 to determine the object: on a 1 , a Dagger; on a 2 , a Rope with a Grappling Hook tied to one end; on a 3 , a bag of Caltrops; on a 4 , a gem worth 50 GP.
81-85 | A creature appears in an unoccupied space as close to you as possible. The creature isn't under your control and acts as it normally would, and it disappears after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 puntos de golpe. Roll 1d4 to determine the creature: on a 1 , a Camel ; on a 2 , a Constrictor Snake ; on a 3 , an Elephant ; on a 4 , a Mule .
86-90 | A Hostile Swarm of Bats flies out of the hat, occupies your space, and attacks you.
91-95 | A vertical, 10-foot-diameter, two-way portal to another plane of existence opens in an unoccupied space within 30 pies of you and remains open until the end of your next turn. The DM determines where it leads.
96-00 | You pull a magic item out of the hat. Roll 1d6 to determine the item's rarity: on a 1-3 , Common; on a 4-5 , Uncommon; on a 6 , Rare. The DM chooses the item, which disappears after 1 hour if it's not consumed or destroyed before then.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HAT_OF_VERMIN.name: Sombrero de alimañas

setters.keywords: charges, recharge, magic action, action, summoning, bat, frog, rat

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HAT_OF_VERMIN.description: This hat has 3 cargas. While holding the hat, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 carga and summon your choice of a Bat , a Frog , or a Rat . The summoned creature magically appears in the hat and tries to get away from you as quickly as possible. The creature is Indifferent toward you and other creatures, and it isn't under your control. It behaves as an ordinary creature of its kind and disappears after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 puntos de golpe. The hat recupera todas las cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HAT_OF_WIZARDRY.name: Sombrero de magia

setters.keywords: spellcasting focus, focus, magic action, action, cantrip, cooldown

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HAT_OF_WIZARDRY.description:
This cone-shaped hat is adorned with moons and stars. While you are wearing it, you gain the following benefits.

canalizador mágico. You can use the hat as a canalizador mágico for your Wizard spells.

Unknown Spell. Como acción de Magia, you can try to cast a cantrip that you don't know. The cantrip must be on the Wizard spell list and have a casting time of an action, and you make a CD 10 Inteligencia (Arcana) check. On a successful check, you cast the spell. On a failed check, the spell fails, and the action used to cast the spell is wasted. In either case, you can't use this property again until you finish a descanso largo.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HEADBAND_OF_INT.name: Diadema de intelecto
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HEADBAND_OF_INT.description: Your Inteligencia score is 19 while you wear this headband. It has no effect on you if your Inteligencia is 19 or higher without it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HELM_OF_BRILLIA.name: Yelmo de brillantez

setters.keywords: emanation, dim light, radiant, damage, magic action, action, bright light, fire, bonus action, resistance, spells, daylight, fireball, prismatic spray, wall of fire

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HELM_OF_BRILLIA.description:
This helm is set with 1d10 diamonds, 2d10 rubies, 3d10 fire opals, and 4d10 opals. Any gem pried from the helm crumbles to dust. When all the gems are removed or destroyed, the helm loses its magic.

You gain the following benefits while wearing the helm.

Diamond Light. As long as it has at least one diamond, the helm emits a 30-foot Emanation. When at least one Undead is within that area, the Emanation is filled with Dim Light. Any Undead that starts its turn in that area takes 1d6 radiante daño.

fuego Opal Flames. As long as the helm has at least one fire opal, you can take a Magic action to cause one weapon you are holding to burst into flames. The flames emit Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 pies. The flames are harmless to you and the weapon. When you hit with an attack using the blazing weapon, the target takes an extra 1d6 fuego daño. The flames last until you take a Bonus Action to extinguish them or until you drop or stow the weapon.

Ruby resistencia. As long as the helm has at least one ruby, you have resistencia to fuego daño.

Spells. You can cast one of the following spells (save CD 18), using one of the helm's gems of the specified type as a component: Daylight (opal), fuegoball (fire opal), Prismatic Spray (diamond), or Wall of fuego (ruby). The gem is destroyed when the spell is cast and disappears from the helm.

Taking fuego Damage. Roll 1d20 if you are wearing the helm and take fuego daño as a result of failing a tirada de salvación against a spell. On a roll of 1, the helm emits beams of light from its remaining gems and is then destroyed. Each creature within a 60-foot Emanation originating from you must succeed on a CD 17 Destreza tirada de salvación or be struck by a beam, taking radiante daño equal to the number of gems in the helm.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HELM_OF_COMPREH.name: Yelmo de comprensión de idiomas
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HELM_OF_COMPREH.description: Mientras llevas helm, you can cast Comprehend Languages from it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HELM_OF_TELEPAT.name: Yelmo de telepatía

setters.keywords: telepathic communication, detect thoughts, suggestion, cooldown

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HELM_OF_TELEPAT.description: Mientras llevas helm, you have telepathy with a range of 30 pies, and you can cast Detect Thoughts or Suggestion (save CD 13) from the helm. Once either spell is cast from the helm, that spell can't be cast from it again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HELM_OF_TELEPOR.name: Yelmo de teletransporte
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HELM_OF_TELEPOR.description: This helm has 3 cargas. While wearing it, you can expend 1 carga to cast Teleport from it. The helm recupera 1d3 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HEWARDS_HANDY_H.name: Mochila práctica de Heward

setters.keywords: utilize action, action, bonus action, portal, astral plane, planar travel

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HEWARDS_HANDY_H.description:
This backpack has a central pouch and two side pouches, each of which is an extradimensional space. Each side pouch can hold up to 200 pounds of material, not exceeding a volume of 25 cubic pies. The central pouch can hold up to 500 pounds of material, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic pies. The haversack always weighs 5 pounds, regardless of its contents.

Retrieving an item from the haversack requires a Utilize action or a Bonus Action (your choice). When you reach into the haversack for a specific item, the item is always magically on top.

If any of its pouches is overloaded, pierced, or torn, the haversack ruptures and is destroyed. If the haversack is destroyed, its contents are lost forever, although an Artifact always turns up again somewhere. If the haversack is turned inside out, its contents spill forth unharmed, and the haversack must be put right before it can be used again.

Each pouch of the haversack holds enough air for 10 minutes of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.

Placing the haversack inside an extradimensional space created by a Bag of Holding , Portable Hole , or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within 10 pies of the gate and not behind Total Cover is sucked through it and deposited in a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way only and can't be reopened.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HEWARDS_HANDY_S.name: Bolsa de especias práctica de Heward
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HEWARDS_HANDY_S.description: This belt pouch appears empty and has 10 cargas. While holding the pouch, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 carga, name any nonmagical food seasoning (such as salt, pepper, saffron, or cilantro), and remove a pinch of the desired seasoning from the pouch. A pinch is enough to season a single meal. The pouch regains 1d6 + 4 expended cargas diariamente al amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HORN_OF_BLASTIN.name: Cuerno de explosión

setters.keywords: magic action, action, cone, constitution, saving throw, save, thunder, damage, deafened, condition

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HORN_OF_BLASTIN.description:
You can take a Magic action to blow the horn, which emits a thunderous blast in a 30-foot Cone that is audible out to 600 pies. Each creature in the Cone makes a CD 15 Constitución tirada de salvación. On a failed save, a creature takes 5d8 trueno daño and has the Ensordecido condition durante 1 minuto. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much daño only. Glass or crystal objects in the Cone that aren't being worn or carried take 10d8 trueno daño.

Each use of the horn's magic has a 20 percent chance of causing the horn to explode. The explosion deals 10d6 fuerza daño to the user and destroys the horn.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HORN_OF_SILENT_.name: Cuerno de alarma silenciosa
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HORN_OF_SILENT_.description: This horn has 4 cargas and regains 1d4 expended cargas diariamente al amanecer. Como acción de Magia, you can blow the horn while expending 1 carga. One creature of your choice hears the horn's blare, provided that creature is within 600 pies of the horn. No other creature hears the horn.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HORN_OF_VALHALL.name: Cuerno del Valhalla (Plata)

setters.keywords: magic action, action, summoning, companions, berserker, cooldown

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HORN_OF_VALHALL.description:
You can take a Magic action to blow this horn. In response, warrior spirits from the plane of Ysgard appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 pies of you. Each spirit uses the Berserker stat block and returns to Ysgard after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 puntos de golpe. The spirits look like living, breathing warriors, and they have inmunidad to the Hechizado and Asustado conditions. Once you use the horn, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.

A silver horn summons 2 Berserkers . They are Friendly to you and your allies and follow your commands.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HORN_OF_VALHALL.name: Cuerno del Valhalla (Latón)

setters.keywords: magic action, action, summoning, companions, berserker, cooldown

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HORN_OF_VALHALL.description:
You can take a Magic action to blow this horn. In response, warrior spirits from the plane of Ysgard appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 pies of you. Each spirit uses the Berserker stat block and returns to Ysgard after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 puntos de golpe. The spirits look like living, breathing warriors, and they have inmunidad to the Hechizado and Asustado conditions. Once you use the horn, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.

A brass horn summons 3 Berserkers .

If you blow the horn without having Proficiency with all Simple weapons, the summoned Berserkers attack you. If you meet the requirement, they are Friendly to you and your allies and follow your commands.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HORN_OF_VALHALL.name: Cuerno del Valhalla (Bronce)

setters.keywords: magic action, action, summoning, companions, berserker, cooldown

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HORN_OF_VALHALL.description:
You can take a Magic action to blow this horn. In response, warrior spirits from the plane of Ysgard appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 pies of you. Each spirit uses the Berserker stat block and returns to Ysgard after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 puntos de golpe. The spirits look like living, breathing warriors, and they have inmunidad to the Hechizado and Asustado conditions. Once you use the horn, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.

A bronze horn summons 4 Berserkers .

If you blow the horn without having training with all Medium armor, the summoned Berserkers attack you. If you meet the requirement, they are Friendly to you and your allies and follow your commands.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HORN_OF_VALHALL.name: Cuerno del Valhalla (Hierro)

setters.keywords: magic action, action, summoning, companions, berserker, cooldown

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HORN_OF_VALHALL.description:
You can take a Magic action to blow this horn. In response, warrior spirits from the plane of Ysgard appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 pies of you. Each spirit uses the Berserker stat block and returns to Ysgard after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 puntos de golpe. The spirits look like living, breathing warriors, and they have inmunidad to the Hechizado and Asustado conditions. Once you use the horn, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.

An iron horn summons 5 Berserkers

If you blow the horn without having Proficiency with all Martial weapons, the summoned Berserkers attack you. If you meet the requirement, they are Friendly to you and your allies and follow your commands.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HORSESHOES_OF_A.name: Herraduras de céfiro

setters.keywords: magic action, action, mount, difficult terrain, exhaustion

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HORSESHOES_OF_A.description:
These horseshoes come in a set of four. Como acción de Magia, you can touch one of the horseshoes to the hoof of a horse or similar creature, whereupon the horseshoe affixes itself to the hoof. Removing a horseshoe also takes a Magic action.

While all four shoes are affixed to the hooves of a horse or similar creature, they allow the creature to move normally while floating 4 inches above a surface. This effect means the creature can cross or stand above nonsolid or unstable surfaces, such as water or lava. The creature leaves no tracks and ignores Difficult Terrain. In addition, the creature can travel for up to 12 hours a day without gaining Agotamiento levels from extended travel.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HORSESHOES_OF_S.name: Herraduras de velocidad
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_HORSESHOES_OF_S.description:
These horseshoes come in a set of four. Como acción de Magia, you can touch one of the horseshoes to the hoof of a horse or similar creature, whereupon the horseshoe affixes itself to the hoof. Removing a horseshoe also takes a Magic action.

While all four horseshoes are attached to the same creature, its Speed is increased by 30 pies.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_INSTRUMENT_OF_I.description: While you are playing this musical instrument, you can take a Magic action to create harmless, illusory visual effects within a 5-foot Emanation originating from the instrument. ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_INSTRUMENT_OF_S.description: This musical instrument has 3 cargas and recupera todas las cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While you are playing it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 carga and write a magical message on a nonmagical object or surface that you can see within 30 pies of yourself. The message can be up to six words long and is written in a language you know. If you are a Bard, you can scribe an additional seven words and make the message glow faintly, allowing it to be seen in nonmagical Darkness. Casting the Dispel Magic spell on the message erases it. Otherwise, the message fades away after 24 hours.
