ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_IOUN_STONE_ABSO.name: Piedra de Ioun (Absorción)

setters.keywords: magic action, action, utilize action, reaction, counterspell, antimagic

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_IOUN_STONE_ABSO.description:
Roughly marble sized, Ioun Stones are named after Ioun, a god of knowledge and prophecy revered on some worlds. Many types of Ioun Stones exist, each type a distinct combination of shape and color.

When you take a Magic action to toss an Ioun Stone into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of 1d3 pies, conferring its benefit to you while doing so. You can have up to three Ioun Stones orbiting your head at the same time.

Each Ioun Stone orbiting your head is considered to be an object you are wearing. The orbiting stone avoids contact with other creatures and objects, adjusting its orbit to avoid collisions and thwarting all attempts by other creatures to attack or snatch it.

As a Utilize action, you can seize and stow any number of Ioun Stones orbiting your head. If your Attunement to an Ioun Stone ends while it's orbiting your head, the stone falls as though you had dropped it.

Absorption. While this pale lavender ellipsoid orbits your head, you can take a Reaction to cancel a spell of level 4 or lower cast by a creature you can see. A canceled spell has no effect, and any resources used to cast it are wasted. Once the stone has canceled 20 levels of spells, it burns out, turns dull gray, and loses its magic.

Reserve. This vibrant purple prism stores spells cast into it, holding them until you use them. The stone can store up to 4 levels of spells at a time. When found, it contains 1d4 levels of stored spells chosen by the DM.

Any creature can cast a spell of level 1 through 4 into the stone by touching it as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect, other than to be stored in the stone. If the stone can't hold the spell, the spell is expended without effect. The level of the slot used to cast the spell determines how much space it uses.

While this stone orbits your head, you can cast any spell stored in it. The spell uses the slot level, CD de salvación de conjuros, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster but is otherwise treated as if you cast the spell. setters.keywords: magic action, action, ranged attack, restrained, condition, bonus action

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_IRON_BANDS_OF_B.description:
This rusty iron sphere measures 3 inches in diameter and weighs 1 pound. You can take a Magic action to throw the sphere at a Huge or smaller creature you can see within 60 pies of yourself. As the sphere moves through the air, it opens into a tangle of metal bands.

Make a ranged tirada de ataque with an attack bonus equal to your Destreza modifier plus your bonificador por competencia. On a hit, the target has the Apresado condition until you take a Bonus Action to issue a command that releases it. Doing so or missing with the attack causes the bands to contract and become a sphere once more.

A creature that can touch the bands, including the one Apresado, can take an action to make a CD 20 Fuerza (Athletics) check to break the iron bands. On a successful check, the item is destroyed, and the Apresado creature is freed. On a failed check, any further attempts made by that creature automatically fail until 24 hours have elapsed.

Once the bands are used, they can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_IRON_FLASK.name: Frasco de hierro

setters.keywords: magic action, action, wisdom, saving throw, save, companion, dominate

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_IRON_FLASK.description:
Mientras empuñas brass-stoppered iron flask, you can take a Magic action to target a creature that you can see within 60 pies of yourself. If the flask is empty and the target is native to a plane of existence other than the one you're on, the target must succeed on a CD 17 Sabiduría tirada de salvación or be trapped in the flask. If the target has been trapped by the flask before, it has ventaja on the save. Once trapped, a creature remains in the flask until released. The flask can hold only one creature at a time. A creature trapped in the flask doesn't age and doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink.

You can take a Magic action to remove the flask's stopper and release the creature in the flask. The creature then obeys your commands for 1 hour, understanding those commands even if it doesn't know the language in which the commands are given. If you issue no commands or give the creature a command that is likely to result in its death or imprisonment, it defends itself but otherwise takes no actions. At the end of the duration, the creature acts in accordance with its normal disposition and alignment.

An Identify spell reveals if the flask contains a creature, but the only way to determine the type of creature is to open the flask. A newly discovered Iron Flask might already contain a creature chosen by the DM or determined randomly by rolling on the following table (see the Monster Manual (2024) for the creature's stat block).

1d100 | Contents
01-50 | No creature
51 | Arcanaloth
52-54 | Bone Devil
55-56 | Cambion
57-58 | Dao
59 | Deva

00 | Xorn

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_KEOGHTOMS_OINTM.name: Ungüento de Keoghtom
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_KEOGHTOMS_OINTM.description:
This glass jar, 3 inches in diameter, contains 1d4 + 1 doses of a thick mixture that smells faintly of aloe. The jar and its contents weigh 1/2 pound.

As a Utilize action, you can swallow one dose of the ointment or apply it to a creature within 5 pies of yourself. The creature that receives it regains 2d8 + 2 puntos de golpe and ceases to have the venenoed condition.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_LANTERN_OF_REVE.name: Linterna reveladora

setters.keywords: bright light, dim light, light, see invisibility, utilize action, action

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_LANTERN_OF_REVE.description: While lit, this hooded lantern burns for 6 hours on 1 pint of oil, shedding Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 pies. Invisible creatures and objects are visible as long as they are in the lantern's Bright Light. You can take a Utilize action to lower the hood, reducing the lantern's light to Dim Light in a 5-foot radius.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_LOCK_OF_TRICKER.name: Cerradura engañosa
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_LOCK_OF_TRICKER.description: This lock appears to be an ordinary Lock (of the type described in Player's Handbook (2024) , page 226) and comes with a single key. The tumblers in this lock magically adjust to thwart burglars. Destreza checks made to pick the lock have desventaja.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MANTLE_OF_SPELL.name: Manto de resistencia a conjuros
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MANTLE_OF_SPELL.description: You have ventaja on tiradas de salvación against spells while you wear this cloak.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MANUAL_OF_BODIL.name: Manual de salud corporal
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MANUAL_OF_BODIL.description: This book contains health and diet tips, and its words are cargad with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Constitución score increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MANUAL_OF_GAINF.name: Manual de ejercicio provechoso
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MANUAL_OF_GAINF.description: This book describes fitness exercises, and its words are cargad with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Fuerza score increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MANUAL_OF_CLAY_.name: Manual de gólems de arcilla
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MANUAL_OF_CLAY_.description:
This tome contains information and incantations necessary to make a Clay Golem . To decipher and use the manual, you must be a spellcaster with at least two 5th-level spell slots. A creature that can't use a Manual of Golems and attempts to read it takes 6d6 psychic daño.

To create a Clay Golem , you must spend 30 days, working without interruption with the manual at hand and resting no more than 8 hours per day. You must also pay 65,000 GP to purchase supplies.

Once you finish creating the golem, the book is consumed in eldritch flames. The golem becomes animate when the ashes of the manual are sprinkled on it. It is under your control, and it understands and obeys your spoken commands.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MANUAL_OF_FLESH.name: Manual de gólems de carne
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MANUAL_OF_FLESH.description:
This tome contains information and incantations necessary to make a Flesh Golem . To decipher and use the manual, you must be a spellcaster with at least two 5th-level spell slots. A creature that can't use a Manual of Golems and attempts to read it takes 6d6 psychic daño.

To create a Flesh Golem , you must spend 60 days, working without interruption with the manual at hand and resting no more than 8 hours per day. You must also pay 50,000 GP to purchase supplies.

Once you finish creating the golem, the book is consumed in eldritch flames. The golem becomes animate when the ashes of the manual are sprinkled on it. It is under your control, and it understands and obeys your spoken commands.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MANUAL_OF_IRON_.name: Manual de gólems de hierro
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MANUAL_OF_IRON_.description:
This tome contains information and incantations necessary to make an Iron Golem . To decipher and use the manual, you must be a spellcaster with at least two 5th-level spell slots. A creature that can't use a Manual of Golems and attempts to read it takes 6d6 psychic daño.

To create an Iron Golem , you must spend 120 days, working without interruption with the manual at hand and resting no more than 8 hours per day. You must also pay 100,000 GP to purchase supplies.

Once you finish creating the golem, the book is consumed in eldritch flames. The golem becomes animate when the ashes of the manual are sprinkled on it. It is under your control, and it understands and obeys your spoken commands.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MANUAL_OF_STONE.name: Manual de gólems de piedra
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MANUAL_OF_STONE.description:
This tome contains information and incantations necessary to make a Stone Golem . To decipher and use the manual, you must be a spellcaster with at least two 5th-level spell slots. A creature that can't use a Manual of Golems and attempts to read it takes 6d6 psychic daño.

To create a Stone Golem , you must spend 90 days, working without interruption with the manual at hand and resting no more than 8 hours per day. You must also pay 80,000 GP to purchase supplies.

Once you finish creating the golem, the book is consumed in eldritch flames. The golem becomes animate when the ashes of the manual are sprinkled on it. It is under your control, and it understands and obeys your spoken commands.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MANUAL_OF_QUICK.name: Manual de rapidez de acción
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MANUAL_OF_QUICK.description: This book contains coordination and balance exercises, and its words are cargad with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Destreza score increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MEDALLION_OF_TH.name: Medallón de los pensamientos
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MEDALLION_OF_TH.description: The medallion has 5 cargas. While wearing it, you can expend 1 carga to cast Detect Thoughts (save CD 13) from it. The medallion regains 1d4 expended cargas diariamente al amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MIRROR_OF_LIFE_.name: Espejo atrapavidas

setters.keywords: magic action, action, charisma, saving throw, save, extradimensional, astral plane

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MIRROR_OF_LIFE_.description:
When this 4-foot-tall, 2-foot-wide mirror is viewed indirectly, its surface shows faint images of creatures. The mirror weighs 50 pounds, and it has AC 11, HP 10, inmunidad to veneno and psíquico daño, and vulnerabilidad to contundente daño. It shatters and is destroyed when reduced to 0 puntos de golpe.

If the mirror is hanging on a vertical surface and you are within 5 pies of it, you can take a Magic action and use a command word to activate it. It remains activated until you take a Magic action and repeat the command word to deactivate it.

Any creature other than you that sees its reflection in the activated mirror while within 30 pies of the mirror must succeed on a CD 15 Carisma tirada de salvación or be trapped, along with anything it is wearing or carrying, in one of the mirror's twelve extradimensional cells. A creature that knows the mirror's nature makes the save with ventaja, and Constructs succeed on the save automatically.

An extradimensional cell is an infinite expanse filled with thick fog that reduces visibility to 10 pies. Creatures trapped in the mirror's cells don't age, and they don't need to eat, drink, or sleep. A creature trapped within a cell can escape using magic that permits planar travel. Otherwise, the creature is confined to the cell until freed.

If the mirror traps a creature but its twelve extradimensional cells are already occupied, the mirror frees one trapped creature at random to accommodate the new prisoner. A freed creature appears in an unoccupied space within sight of the mirror but facing away from it. If the mirror is shattered, all creatures it contains are freed and appear in unoccupied spaces near it.

While within 5 pies of the mirror, you can take a Magic action to name one creature trapped in it or call out a particular cell by number. The creature named or contained in the named cell appears as an image on the mirror's surface. You and the creature can then communicate.

In a similar way, you can take a Magic action and use a second command word to free one creature trapped in the mirror. The freed creature appears, along with its possessions, in the unoccupied space nearest to the mirror and facing away from it.

Placing the mirror inside an extradimensional space created by a Bag of Holding , Portable Hole , or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within 10 pies of the gate and not behind Total Cover is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way only and can't be reopened.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MYSTERY_KEY.name: Llave misteriosa
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_MYSTERY_KEY.description: A question mark is worked into the head of this key. The key has a 5 percent chance of unlocking any lock into which it's inserted. Once it unlocks something, the key disappears.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_NATURES_MANTLE.name: Manto de la naturaleza

setters.keywords: spellcasting focus, focus, hide, bonus action

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_NATURES_MANTLE.description:
This cloak shifts color and texture to blend with the terrain surrounding you. While wearing the cloak, you can use it as a canalizador mágico for your Druid and Ranger spells.

While you are in an area that is Lightly Obscured, you can Hide como acción adicional even if you are being directly observed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_NECKLACE_OF_ADA.name: Collar de adaptación

setters.keywords: advantage, saving throw, saves, poisoned, condition

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_NECKLACE_OF_ADA.description: Mientras llevas necklace, you can breathe normally in any environment, and you have ventaja on tiradas de salvación made to avoid or end the venenoed condition.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_NECKLACE_OF_FIR.name: Collar de bolas de fuego
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_NECKLACE_OF_FIR.description:
This necklace has 1d6 + 3 beads hanging from it. You can take a Magic action to detach a bead and throw it up to 60 pies away. When it reaches the end of its trajectory, the bead detonates as a level 3 fuegoball (save CD 15).

You can hurl multiple beads, or even the whole necklace, at one time. When you do so, increase the daño of the fuegoball by 1d6 for each bead after the first (maximum 12d6).

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_NECKLACE_OF_PRA.name: Collar de cuentas de oración

attunement.addition: by a Cleric, Druid, or Paladin

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_NECKLACE_OF_PRA.description:
This necklace has 1d4 + 2 magic beads made from aquamarine, black pearl, or topaz. It also has many nonmagical beads made from stones such as amber, bloodstone, citrine, coral, jade, pearl, or quartz. If a magic bead is removed from the necklace, that bead loses its magic.

Six types of magic beads exist. The DM decides the type of each bead on the necklace or determines it randomly by rolling on the table below. A necklace can have more than one bead of the same type. To use one, you must be wearing the necklace. Each bead contains a spell that you can cast from it como acción adicional (using your CD de salvación de conjuros if a save is necessary). Once a magic bead's spell is cast, that bead can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

1d20 | Bead | Spell
1-6 | Bead of Blessing | Bless
7-12 | Bead of Curing | Cure Wounds (level 2 version)
13-16 | Bead of Favor | Greater Restoration
17-18 | Bead of Smiting | Shining Smite
19 | Bead of Summons | Guardian of Faith
20 | Bead of Wind Walking | Wind Walk

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_NOLZURS_MARVELO.name: Pigmentos maravillosos de Nolzur
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_NOLZURS_MARVELO.description:
This fine wooden box contains 1d4 pots of pigment and a brush (weighing 1 pound in total). Using the brush and expending 1 pot of pigment, you can paint any number of three-dimensional objects and terrain features (such as walls, doors, trees, flowers, weapons, webs, and pits), provided these elements are all confined to a 20-foot Cube. The effort takes 10 minutes (regardless of the number of elements you create), during which time you must remain in the Cube, and requires Concentración. If your Concentración is broken or you leave the Cube before the work is done, all the painted elements vanish, and the pot of pigment is wasted.

When the work is done, all the painted objects and terrain features become real. Thus, painting a door on a wall creates an actual door, which can be opened to whatever is beyond. Painting a pit creates a real pit, the entire depth of which must lie within the 20-foot Cube.

No object created by a pot of pigment can have a value greater than 25 GP, and the total value of all objects created by a pot of pigment can't exceed 500 GP. If you paint objects of greater value (such as a large pile of gold), they look authentic, but close inspection reveals they're made from paste, cookies, or some other worthless material.

If you paint a form of energy such as fire or lightning, the energy dissipates as soon as you complete the painting, doing no harm.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ORB_OF_DIRECTIO.name: Orbe de dirección

setters.keywords: arcane focus, spellcasting focus, focus, magic action, action, compass

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ORB_OF_DIRECTIO.description:
This orb can be used as an Arcane Focus.

Mientras empuñas orb, you can take a Magic action to determine which way is magnetic north. Nothing happens if the orb is used in a location that has no magnetic north.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ORB_OF_DRAGONKI.name: Orbe de los dragones

setters.keywords: magic action, minor beneficial properties, minor detrimental properties, major detrimental properties, spells, charges, recharges, cure wounds, daylight, death ward, detect magic, scrying

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ORB_OF_DRAGONKI.description:
Long ago, in the Dragonlance setting, elves and humans waged a terrible war against chromatic dragons. When the world seemed doomed, the wizards of the Towers of High Sorcery came together and forged five Orbs of Dragonkind to help defeat the dragons. One orb was taken to each of the five towers, and there they were used to speed the war toward a victorious end. The wizards used the orbs to lure dragons to them, then destroyed the dragons with powerful magic.

As the Towers of High Sorcery fell in later ages, the orbs were destroyed or faded into legend, and only three are thought to survive. Their magic has been warped over the centuries. Their primary purpose of calling dragons still functions, but they also allow some measure of control over dragons.

Each orb contains the essence of an evil dragon, a presence that resents any attempt to coax magic from it. Those who try to wield an orb's magic but lack sufficient force of personality might find themselves under the orb's control.

An orb is an etched crystal globe about 10 inches in diameter. When used, it grows to about 20 inches in diameter, and mist swirls inside it.

While attuned to an orb, you can take a Magic action to peer into the orb's depths. You must then make a CD 15 Carisma tirada de salvación. On a successful save, you control the orb for as long as you remain attuned to it. On a failed save, the orb imposes the Hechizado condition on you for as long as you remain attuned to it.

While you are Hechizado by the orb, you can't voluntarily end your Attunement to it, and the orb casts Suggestion on you at will (save CD 18), urging you to work toward the evil ends it desires. The dragon essence within the orb might want many things: the annihilation of a particular society or organization, freedom from the orb, to spread suffering in the world, to advance the worship of Tiamat, or something else the DM decides.

Random Properties. An Orb of Dragonkind has the following random properties:

- 2 minor beneficial properties

- 1 minor detrimental property

- 1 major detrimental property

Spells. The orb has 7 cargas and regains 1d4 + 3 expended cargas diariamente al amanecer. If you control the orb, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it. The table indicates how many cargas you must expend to cast the spell.

Spell | Charge Cost
Cure Wounds (level 9 version) | 4
Daylight | 1
Death Ward | 2
Detect Magic | 0
Scrying (save CD 18) | 3

Call Dragons. While you control the orb, you can take a Magic action to cause the orb to issue a telepathic call that extends in all directions for 40 miles. Chromatic dragons in range feel compelled to come to the orb as soon as possible by the most direct route. Dragon deities such as Tiamat are unaffected by this call. Chromatic dragons drawn to the orb might be Hostile toward you for compelling them against their will. Once you have used this property, it can't be used again durante 1 hora.

Destroying an Orb. An Orb of Dragonkind has AC 20 and is destroyed if it takes daño from a +3 Weapon or a Disintegrate spell. Nothing else can harm it.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ORB_OF_TIME.name: Orbe del tiempo

setters.keywords: arcane focus, spellcasting focus, focus, magic action, clock

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ORB_OF_TIME.description:
This orb can be used as an Arcane Focus.

While holding the orb, you can take a Magic action to determine whether it is morning, afternoon, evening, or nighttime. This property functions only on the Material Plane.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PEARL_OF_POWER.name: Perla de poder

setters.keywords: magic action, action, arcane recovery, spell slot recovery, cooldown

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PEARL_OF_POWER.description: While this pearl is on your person, you can take a Magic action to regain one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower. Once you use the pearl, it can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PERFUME_OF_BEWI.name: Perfume de hechizo

setters.keywords: magic action, action, advantage, charisma, deception, persuasion

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PERFUME_OF_BEWI.description: This tiny vial contains magic perfume, enough for one use. You can take a Magic action to apply the perfume to yourself, and its effect lasts 1 hour. For the duration, you have ventaja on all Carisma (Deception and Persuasion) checks made to influence a creature within 5 pies of yourself.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PERIAPT_OF_HEAL.name: Periapto de salud

setters.keywords: magic action, action, healing, advantage, saving throws, saves, poisoned

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PERIAPT_OF_HEAL.description:
Mientras llevas pendant, you can take a Magic action to regain 2d4 + 2 puntos de golpe. Once used, this property can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

In addition, you have ventaja on tiradas de salvación to avoid or end the venenoed condition while you wear this pendant.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PERIAPT_OF_PROO.name: Periapto a prueba de veneno
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PERIAPT_OF_PROO.description: This delicate silver chain has a brilliant-cut black gem pendant. While you wear it, you have inmunidad to the venenoed condition and veneno daño.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PERIAPT_OF_WOUN.name: Periapto de cierre de heridas

setters.keywords: death saving throws, death saves, automatic success, auto-success, hit point die, hit die, hit dice, healing

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PERIAPT_OF_WOUN.description:
Mientras llevas pendant, you gain the following benefits.

Life Preservation. Whenever you make a Death Saving Throw, you can change a roll of 9 or lower to a 10, turning a failed save into a successful one.

Natural Healing Boost. Whenever you roll a Hit Point Die to regain puntos de golpe, double the number of puntos de golpe it restores.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PIPE_OF_SMOKE_M.name: Pipa de monstruos de humo
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PIPE_OF_SMOKE_M.description: While smoking this pipe, you can take a Magic action to exhale a puff of smoke that takes the form of a creature, such as a dragon, a flumph, or a slaad. The form must be small enough to fit in a 1-foot cube and loses its shape after a few seconds, becoming an ordinary puff of smoke.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PIPES_OF_HAUNTI.name: Flautas inquietantes

setters.keywords: charges, recharge, magic action, action, wisdom, saving throw, save, frightened, musical instrument

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PIPES_OF_HAUNTI.description: These pipes have 3 cargas and regain 1d3 expended cargas diariamente al amanecer. You can take a Magic action to play them and expend 1 carga to create an eerie, spellbinding tune. Each creature of your choice within 30 pies of you must succeed on a CD 15 Sabiduría tirada de salvación or have the Asustado condition durante 1 minuto. A creature that fails the save repeats it at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on its save is immune to the effect of these pipes durante 24 horas.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PIPES_OF_THE_SE.name: Flautas de las alcantarillas

setters.keywords: charges, recharge, magic action, action, bonus action, summoning, wisdom, saving throw, save, musical instrument

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PIPES_OF_THE_SE.description:
While these pipes are on your person, ordinary rats and giant rats are Indifferent toward you and won't attack you unless you threaten or harm them.

The pipes have 3 cargas and regain 1d3 expended cargas diariamente al amanecer. If you play the pipes como acción de Magia, you can take a Bonus Action to expend 1 to 3 cargas, calling forth one Swarm of Rats with each expended carga if enough rats are within half a mile of you to be called in this fashion (as determined by the DM). If there aren't enough rats to form a swarm, the carga is wasted. Called swarms move toward the music by the shortest available route but aren't under your control otherwise.

Whenever a Swarm of Rats that isn't under another creature's control comes within 30 pies of you while you are playing the pipes, the swarm makes a CD 15 Sabiduría tirada de salvación. On a successful save, the swarm behaves as it normally would and can't be swayed by the pipes' music for the next 24 hours. On a failed save, the swarm is swayed by the pipes' music and becomes Friendly to you and your allies for as long as you continue to play the pipes each round como acción de Magia. A Friendly swarm obeys your commands. If you issue no commands to a Friendly swarm, it defends itself but otherwise takes no actions. If a Friendly swarm starts its turn more than 30 pies away from you, your control over that swarm ends, and the swarm behaves as it normally would and can't be swayed by the pipes' music for the next 24 hours.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POLE_OF_ANGLING.name: Pértiga de pesca
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POLE_OF_ANGLING.description: This item functions as a Pole. While holding it, you can take a Magic action to cause it to transform into a fishing pole with a hook, a line, and a reel, or have the fishing pole revert to a Pole.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POLE_OF_COLLAPS.name: Pértiga plegable
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POLE_OF_COLLAPS.description: This item functions as a Pole. While holding it, you can take a Magic action to collapse it into a 1-foot-long rod for ease of storage (the pole's weight doesn't change) or cause the 1-foot-long rod to revert to a Pole. The rod elongates only as far as the surrounding space allows.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PORTABLE_HOLE.name: Agujero portátil

setters.keywords: magic action, action, extradimensional, strength, athletics, ability check, skill check, check, astral plane

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PORTABLE_HOLE.description:
This fine black cloth, soft as silk, is folded up to the dimensions of a handkerchief. It unfolds into a circular sheet 6 pies in diameter.

You can take a Magic action to unfold a Portable Hole and place it on or against a solid surface, whereupon the Portable Hole creates an extradimensional hole 10 pies deep. The cylindrical space within the hole exists on a different plane of existence, so it can't be used to create open passages. Any creature inside an open Portable Hole can exit the hole by climbing out of it.

You can take a Magic action to close a Portable Hole by taking hold of the edges of the cloth and folding it up. Folding the cloth closes the hole, and any creatures or objects within remain in the extradimensional space. No matter what's in it, the hole weighs next to nothing.

If the hole is folded up, a creature within the hole's extradimensional space can take an action to make a CD 10 Fuerza (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the creature forces its way out and appears within 5 pies of the Portable Hole . A closed Portable Hole holds enough air for 1 hour of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.

Placing a Portable Hole inside an extradimensional space created by a Bag of Holding , Heward's Handy Haversack , or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within 10 pies of the gate and not behind Total Cover is sucked through it and deposited in a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way only and can't be reopened.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POT_OF_AWAKENIN.name: Maceta del despertar
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_POT_OF_AWAKENIN.description:
If you plant an ordinary shrub in this 10-pound clay pot and let it grow for 30 days, the shrub magically transforms into an Awakened Shrub at the end of that time. When the shrub awakens, its roots break the pot, destroying it.

The awakened shrub is Friendly toward you and obeys your commands. Absent commands from you, it does nothing.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PROSTHETIC_LIMB.name: Extremidad protésica
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_PROSTHETIC_LIMB.description: This magic item replaces a lost limb—a hand, an arm, a pie, a leg, or a similar body part. While the prosthetic is attached, it functions identically to the part it replaces. You can detach or reattach it como acción de Magia, and it can't be removed against your will while you are alive.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_QUAALS_FEATHER_.name: Ficha de pluma de Quaal (Ancla)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_QUAALS_FEATHER_.description:
This object looks like a feather.

You can take a Magic action to touch the token to a boat or ship. For the next 24 hours, the vessel can't be moved by any means. Touching the token to the vessel again ends the effect. When the effect ends, the token disappears.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_QUAALS_FEATHER_.name: Ficha de pluma de Quaal (Ave)

setters.keywords: magic action, action, companion, roc, fly speed, speed, flying

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_QUAALS_FEATHER_.description:
This object looks like a feather.

You can take a Magic action to toss the token 5 pies into the air. The token disappears and an enormous, multicolored bird takes its place. The bird has the statistics of a Roc , but it can't attack. It obeys your simple commands and can carry up to 500 pounds while flying at its maximum speed (16 miles per hour for a maximum of 144 miles per day, with a 1-hour rest for every 3 hours of flying) or 1,000 pounds at half that speed. The bird disappears after flying its maximum distance for a day or if it drops to 0 puntos de golpe. You can dismiss the bird como acción de Magia.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_QUAALS_FEATHER_.name: Ficha de pluma de Quaal (Abanico)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_QUAALS_FEATHER_.description:
This object looks like a feather.

If you are on a boat or ship, you can take a Magic action to toss the token up to 10 pies in the air. The token disappears, and a giant flapping fan takes its place. The fan floats and creates a strong wind. This wind can fill the sails of one ship, increasing its speed by 5 miles per hour durante 8 horas. You can dismiss the fan como acción de Magia.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_QUAALS_FEATHER_.name: Ficha de pluma de Quaal (Barco cisne)

setters.keywords: magic action, action, boat, vehicle, waterborne vehicle

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_QUAALS_FEATHER_.description:
This object looks like a feather.

You can take a Magic action to touch the token to a body of water at least 60 pies in diameter. The token disappears, and a 50-foot-long, 20-foot-wide boat shaped like a swan takes its place. The boat is self-propelled and moves across water at a speed of 6 miles per hour. You can take a Magic action while on the boat to command it to move or to turn up to 90 degrees. The boat remains for 24 hours and then disappears. You can dismiss the boat como acción de Magia.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_QUAALS_FEATHER_.name: Ficha de pluma de Quaal (Árbol)
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_QUAALS_FEATHER_.description:
This object looks like a feather.

You must be outdoors to use this token. You can take a Magic action to touch it to an unoccupied space on the ground. The token disappears, and in its place a nonmagical oak tree springs into existence. The tree is 60 pies tall and has a 5-foot-diameter trunk, and its branches at the top spread out in a 20-foot radius.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_QUAALS_FEATHER_.name: Ficha de pluma de Quaal (Látigo)

setters.keywords: magic action, action, bonus action, force, damage, spiritual weapon

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_QUAALS_FEATHER_.description:
This object looks like a feather.

You can take a Magic action to throw the token to a point within 10 pies of yourself. The token disappears, and a floating whip takes its place. You can then take a Bonus Action to make a melee spell attack against a creature within 10 pies of the whip, with an attack bonus of +9. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 + 5 fuerza daño.

Como acción adicional, you can direct the whip to fly up to 20 pies and repeat the attack against a creature within 10 pies of the whip. The whip disappears after 1 hour, when you take a Magic action to dismiss it, or when you die or have the Incapacitado condition.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_QUIVER_OF_EHLON.name: Carcaj de Ehlonna
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_QUIVER_OF_EHLON.description:
Each of the quiver's three compartments connects to an extradimensional space that allows the quiver to hold numerous items while never weighing more than 2 pounds. The shortest compartment can hold up to 60 Arrows, Bolts, or similar objects. The midsize compartment holds up to 18 Javelins or similar objects. The longest compartment holds up to 6 long objects, such as bows, Quarterstaff's, or Spears.

You can draw any item the quiver contains as if doing so from a regular quiver or scabbard.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RIVAL_COIN.name: Moneda rival

setters.keywords: charges, recharge, magic action, action, wisdom, saving throw, save, psychic, damage, disadvantage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RIVAL_COIN.description:
This gold coin has a creature embossed on each side. The two depicted creatures must be famous rivals or enemies of each other. For example, a Rival Coin might show Iggwilv on one side and Mordenkainen on the other, or Venger on one side and Tiamat on the other. One of these figures is on the "heads" side of the coin, the other on the "tails" side.

The coin has 1 carga and regains its expended carga diariamente al amanecer. You can take a Magic action to toss the coin, expending its carga. Roll any die to determine whether the coin comes up heads (on an even number) or tails (on an odd number). The roll also determines the effect:

Heads. Target one creature you can see within 60 pies of yourself. The target makes a CD 13 Sabiduría tirada de salvación. On a failed save, the target takes 2d4 psíquico daño and has desventaja on the next tirada de ataque it makes before the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much daño only.

Tails. You take 1d4 psíquico daño.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROBE_OF_EYES.name: Túnica de ojos

setters.keywords: advantage, wisdom, perception, ability checks, skill checks, checks, darkvision, truesight

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROBE_OF_EYES.description:
This robe is adorned with eyelike patterns. While you wear the robe, you gain the following benefits:

All-Around Vision. The robe gives you ventaja on Sabiduría (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

Special Senses. You have Visión en la oscuridad and Visión verdadera, both with a range of 120 pies.

Drawbacks A Light spell cast on the robe or a Daylight spell cast within 5 pies of the robe gives you the Cegado condition durante 1 minuto. At the end of each of your turns, you make a Constitución tirada de salvación (CD 11 for Light or CD 15 for Daylight ), ending the condition on yourself on a success.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROBE_OF_SCINTIL.name: Túnica de colores centelleantes

setters.keywords: charges, recharges, dawn, magic action, action, bright light, dim light, disadvantage, wisdom, saving throw, save, stunned, condition

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROBE_OF_SCINTIL.description: This robe has 3 cargas, and it recupera 1d3 cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. While you wear it, you can take a Magic action and expend 1 carga to cause the garment to display a shifting pattern of dazzling hues until the end of your next turn. During this time, the robe sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 pies, and creatures that can see you have desventaja on tiradas de ataque against you. Any creature in the Bright Light that can see you when the robe's power is activated must succeed on a CD 15 Sabiduría tirada de salvación or have the Aturdido condition until the effect ends.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROBE_OF_STARS.name: Túnica de estrellas

setters.keywords: saving throws, saves, strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom, charisma, magic action, action, magic missile, astral plane

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROBE_OF_STARS.description:
This black or dark-blue robe is embroidered with small white or silver stars. You gain a +1 bonus to tiradas de salvación while you wear it.

Six stars, located on the robe's upper-front portion, are particularly large. Mientras llevas robe, you can take a Magic action to remove one of the stars and expend it to cast the level 5 version of Magic Missile . Daily at dusk, 1d6 removed stars reappear on the robe.

While you wear the robe, you can take a Magic action to enter the Astral Plane along with everything you are wearing and carrying. You remain there until you take a Magic action to return to the plane you were on. You reappear in the last space you occupied or, if that space is occupied, the nearest unoccupied space.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROBE_OF_THE_ARC.name: Túnica del archimago

setters.keywords: sorcerer, warlock, wizard, ac, armor class, magic resistance, advantage, anti-magic, spellcasting, spell save dc, spell attack

attunement.addition: by a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROBE_OF_THE_ARC.description:
This elegant garment is made from exquisite cloth and adorned with runes.

You gain these benefits while wearing the robe.

Armor. If you aren't wearing armor, your base Clase de Armadura is 15 plus your Destreza modifier.

Magic resistencia. You have ventaja on tiradas de salvación against spells and other magical effects.

War Mage. Your CD de salvación de conjuros and spell attack bonus each increase by 2.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROBE_OF_USEFUL_.name: Túnica de objetos útiles

setters.keywords: magic action, action, bullseye lantern, dagger, mirror, pole, rope, sack, riding horse, potions of healing, rowboat, spell scroll, mastiffs, portable ram

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROBE_OF_USEFUL_.description:
This robe has cloth patches of various shapes and colors covering it. While wearing the robe, you can take a Magic action to detach one of the patches, causing it to become the object or creature it represents. Once the last patch is removed, the robe becomes an ordinary garment.

The robe has two of each of the following patches:

- Bullseye Lantern (filled and lit)

- Dagger

- Mirror

- Pole

- Rope (coiled)

- Sack

In addition, the robe has 4d4 other patches. The DM chooses the patches or determines them randomly by rolling on the following table.

1d100 | Patch
01-08 | Bag of 100 GP
09-15 | Silver coffer (1 pie long, 6 inches wide and deep) worth 500 GP
16-22 | Iron door (up to 10 pies wide and 10 pies high, barred on one side of your choice), which you can place in an opening you can reach; it conforms to fit the opening, attaching and hinging itself
23-30 | 10 gems worth 100 GP each
31-44 | Wooden ladder (24 pies long)
45-51 | Riding Horse with a Riding Saddle
52-59 | Open pit (a 10-foot Cube), which you can place on the ground within 10 pies of yourself
60-68 | 4 Potions of Healing
69-75 | Rowboat (12 pies long)
76-83 | Spell Scroll containing one spell of level 1, 2, or 3 (your choice)
84-90 | 2 Mastiffs
91-96 | Window (2 pies by 4 pies, up to 2 pies deep), which you can place on a vertical surface you can reach
97-00 | Portable Ram

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROPE_OF_CLIMBIN.name: Cuerda de escalada
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROPE_OF_CLIMBIN.description:
This 60-foot length of rope can hold up to 3,000 pounds. While holding one end of the rope, you can take a Magic action to command the other end of the rope to animate and move toward a destination you choose, up to the rope's length away from you. That end moves 10 pies on your turn when you first command it and 10 pies at the start of each of your subsequent turns until reaching its destination or until you tell it to stop. You can also tell the rope to fasten itself securely to an object or to unfasten itself, to knot or unknot itself, or to coil itself for carrying.

If you tell the rope to knot, large knots appear at 1-foot intervals along the rope. While knotted, the rope shortens to a 50-foot length and grants ventaja on pruebas de característica made to climb using the rope.

The rope has AC 20, HP 20, and inmunidad to veneno and psíquico daño. It regains 1 Hit Point every 5 minutes as long as it has at least 1 Hit Point. If the rope drops to 0 puntos de golpe, it is destroyed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROPE_OF_ENTANGL.name: Cuerda enredadora

setters.keywords: magic action, action, dexterity, saving throw, save, restrained, condition, bonus action

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROPE_OF_ENTANGL.description:
This rope is 30 pies long. While holding one end of the rope, you can take a Magic action to command the other end to dart forward and entangle one creature you can see within 20 pies of yourself. The target must succeed on a CD 15 Destreza tirada de salvación or have the Apresado condition. You can release the target by letting go of your end of the rope (causing the rope to coil up in the target's space) or by using a Bonus Action to repeat the command (causing the rope to coil up in your hand).

A target Apresado by the rope can take an action to make its choice of a CD 15 Fuerza (Athletics) or Destreza (Acrobatics) check. On a successful check, the target is no longer Apresado by the rope. If you're still holding onto the rope when a target escapes from it, you can take a Reaction to command the rope to coil up in your hand; otherwise, the rope coils up in the target's space.

The rope has AC 20, HP 20, and inmunidad to veneno and psíquico daño. It regains 1 Hit Point every 5 minutes as long as it has at least 1 Hit Point. If the rope drops to 0 puntos de golpe, it is destroyed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROPE_OF_MENDING.name: Cuerda de remiendo
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_ROPE_OF_MENDING.description: This 50-foot coil of rope can repair itself when cut into any number of smaller pieces. Como acción de Magia, you can cause all pieces of the rope that are in contact with each other and not otherwise in use to knit back together. A Rope of Mending is forever shortened if a section of it is lost or destroyed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RUBY_OF_THE_WAR.name: Rubí del mago de guerra

setters.keywords: simple, martial, weapon, spellcasting focus, focus, magic action, action

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_RUBY_OF_THE_WAR.description: Etched with eldritch runes, this 1-inch-diameter ruby allows you to use a Simple or Martial weapon as a canalizador mágico for your spells. For this property to work, you must attach the ruby to the weapon by pressing the ruby against it for at least 10 minutes. Thereafter, the ruby can't be removed unless you detach it como acción de Magia, the weapon is destroyed, or your Attunement to the ruby ends.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SADDLE_OF_THE_C.name: Silla de montar del caballero
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SADDLE_OF_THE_C.description:
This saddle confers the following benefits while you are seated in it and astride a mount.

Protected Mount. Attack rolls against the mount have desventaja.

Secure Rider. You can't be dismounted against your will. This property is suppressed while you have the Incapacitado condition.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SCARAB_OF_PROTE.name: Escarabajo de protección

setters.keywords: ac, armor class, charges, saving throws, reaction, spell resistance, magic resistance, advantage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SCARAB_OF_PROTE.description:
This beetle-shaped medallion provides three benefits while it is on your person.

Defense. You gain a +1 bonus to Clase de Armadura.

Preservation. The scarab has 12 cargas. If you fail a tirada de salvación against a Necromancy spell or a harmful effect originating from an Undead, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 carga and turn the failed save into a successful one. The scarab crumbles into powder and is destroyed when its last carga is expended.

Spell resistencia. You have ventaja on tiradas de salvación against spells.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SENDING_STONES.name: Piedras mensajeras
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SENDING_STONES.description:
Sending Stones come in pairs, with each stone carved to match the other so the pairing is easily recognized. While you touch one stone, you can cast Sending from it. The target is the bearer of the other stone. If no creature bears the other stone, you know that fact as soon as you use the stone, and you don't cast the spell.

Once Sending is cast using either stone, the stones can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer. If one of the stones in a pair is destroyed, the other one becomes nonmagical.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SLIPPERS_OF_SPI.name: Zapatillas de trepar cual arácnido
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SLIPPERS_OF_SPI.description: While you wear these light shoes, you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving your hands free. You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. However, the slippers don't allow you to move this way on a slippery surface, such as one covered by ice or oil.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SOVEREIGN_GLUE.name: Pegamento soberano
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SOVEREIGN_GLUE.description:
This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects. It must be stored in a jar or flask that has been coated inside with Oil of Slipperiness . When found, a container contains 1d6 + 1 ounces.

One ounce of the glue can cover a 1-foot square surface. Applying an ounce of Sovereign Glue takes a Utilize action, and the applied glue takes 1 minute to set. Once it has done so, the bond it creates can be broken only by the application of Universal Solvent or Oil of Etherealness , or with a Wish spell.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SPHERE_OF_ANNIH.name: Esfera de aniquilación

setters.keywords: force, damage, magic action, action, dexterity, saving throw, save

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SPHERE_OF_ANNIH.description:
This 2-foot-diameter black sphere is a hole in the multiverse, hovering in space and stabilized by a magical field surrounding it.

The sphere obliterates all matter it passes through and all matter that passes through it. Artifacts are the exception. Unless an Artifact is susceptible to daño from a Sphere of Annihilation , it passes through the sphere unscathed. Anything else that touches the sphere but isn't wholly engulfed and obliterated by it takes 8d10 fuerza daño.

Controlling the Sphere. A Sphere of Annihilation is stationary until someone takes control of it. If you are within 60 pies of a sphere, you can take a Magic action to make a CD 25 Inteligencia (Arcana) check. On a successful check, you control the sphere until the start of your next turn, and if it was under another creature's control, that creature loses control of the sphere. On a failed check, the sphere moves 10 pies toward you in a straight line.

While in control of the sphere, you can take a Bonus Action to cause it to move in one direction of your choice, up to a number of pies equal to 5 times your Inteligencia modifier (minimum 5 pies). Any creature whose space the sphere enters must succeed on a CD 19 Destreza tirada de salvación or be touched by it, taking 8d10 fuerza daño. A creature reduced to 0 puntos de golpe by this daño is obliterated, leaving its possessions behind but no other physical remains.

Sphere Interactions. If the sphere comes into contact with a planar portal (such as that created by the Gate spell) or an extradimensional space (such as that within a Portable Hole ), the DM determines randomly what happens using the following table.

1d100 | Result
01-50 | The sphere is destroyed.
51-85 | The sphere moves through the portal or into the extradimensional space.
86-00 | A spatial rift sends the sphere and each creature and object within 180 pies of the sphere to a random plane of existence.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SPIRIT_BOARD.name: Tablero de espíritus
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_SPIRIT_BOARD.description:
This ornate wooden board has the letters of the Common alphabet printed on one side, alongside the words "Yes" and "No" and symbols representing "Weal" and "Woe." The board comes with a heartshaped, wooden planchette. This planchette must be resting on the lettered side of the board for the board's magic to function.

This board has 3 cargas and regains 1 expended carga diariamente al amanecer. While touching the planchette, you can take 1 minute to cast one of the spells on the table below. The table indicates how many cargas you must expend to cast the spell. As you cast the spell, you call on the spirits of the dead to help guide the planchette across the board's surface, answering your questions by pointing to the letters or words on the board.

Spell | Charge Cost
Augury | 1
Commune | 3

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STONE_OF_CONTRO.name: Piedra de control de elementales de tierra

setters.keywords: magic action, action, summoning, companion, earth elemental, bonus action, cooldown, dawn

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STONE_OF_CONTRO.description: While touching this 5-pound stone to the ground, you can take a Magic action to summon an Earth Elemental . The elemental appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 pies of yourself, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it como acción adicional. The stone can't be used this way again hasta el próximo amanecer.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STONE_OF_GOOD_L.name: Piedra de la buena suerte

setters.keywords: luckstone, ability checks, skill checks, checks, saving throws, saves

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_STONE_OF_GOOD_L.description: While this polished agate is on your person, you gain a +1 bonus to pruebas de característica and tiradas de salvación.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TALISMAN_OF_PUR.name: Talismán del bien puro

setters.keywords: spellcasting focus, focus, holy symbol, charges, magic action, action, dexterity, saving throw, saves, psychic, damage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TALISMAN_OF_PUR.description:
This talisman is a mighty symbol of goodness. A Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 radiante daño and takes the daño again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.

Holy Symbol. You can use the talisman as a Holy Symbol. You gain a +2 bonus to spell tiradas de ataque while you wear or hold it.

Pure Rebuke. The talisman has 7 cargas. While wearing or holding the talisman, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 carga and target one creature you can see on the ground within 120 pies of yourself. A flaming fissure opens under the target, and the target makes a CD 20 Destreza tirada de salvación. If the target is a Fiend or an Undead, it has desventaja on the save. On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains. On a successful save, the target isn't cast into the fissure but takes 4d6 psíquico daño from the ordeal. In either case, the fissure then closes, leaving no trace of its existence. When you expend the last carga, the talisman disperses into motes of golden light and is destroyed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TALISMAN_OF_THE.name: Talismán de la esfera

setters.keywords: sphere of annihilation, magic action, action

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TALISMAN_OF_THE.description: While holding or wearing this talisman, you have ventaja on any Inteligencia (Arcana) check you make to control a Sphere of Annihilation . In addition, when you start your turn in control of a Sphere of Annihilation , you can take a Magic action to move it 10 pies plus a number of additional pies equal to 10 times your Inteligencia modifier. This movement doesn't have to be in a straight line.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TALISMAN_OF_ULT.name: Talismán del mal supremo

setters.keywords: spellcasting focus, focus, holy symbol, charges, magic action, action, dexterity, saving throw, saves, psychic, damage

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TALISMAN_OF_ULT.description:
This item symbolizes unrepentant evil. A creature that isn't a Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 necrótico daño and takes the daño again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.

Holy Symbol. You can use the talisman as a Holy Symbol. You gain a +2 bonus to spell tiradas de ataque while you wear or hold it.

Ultimate End. The talisman has 6 cargas. While wearing or holding the talisman, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 carga and target one creature you can see on the ground within 120 pies of yourself. A flaming fissure opens under the target, and the target makes a CD 20 Destreza tirada de salvación. If the target is a Celestial, it has desventaja on the save. On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains. On a successful save, the target isn't cast into the fissure but takes 4d6 psíquico daño from the ordeal. In either case, the fissure then closes, leaving no trace of its existence. When you expend the last carga, the talisman dissolves into foul-smelling slime and is destroyed.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TALKING_DOLL.name: Muñeco parlante
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TALKING_DOLL.description: While this doll is within 5 pies of you, you can spend a descanso corto telling it to say up to six phrases, none of which can be more than six words long, and set a condition under which the doll speaks each phrase. You can also replace old phrases with new ones. Whatever the condition, it must occur within 5 pies of the doll to make it speak. For example, whenever someone picks up the doll, it might say, "I want a piece of candy." The doll's phrases are lost when your Attunement to the doll ends.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TANKARD_OF_SOBR.name: Jarra de la sobriedad
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TANKARD_OF_SOBR.description: This tankard has a stern face sculpted into one side. You can drink ale, wine, or any other nonmagical alcoholic beverage poured into it without becoming inebriated. The tankard has no effect on magical liquids or harmful substances such as poison.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TOME_OF_CLEAR_T.name: Tomo del pensamiento claro
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TOME_OF_CLEAR_T.description: This book contains memory and logic exercises, and its words are cargad with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Inteligencia score increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TOME_OF_LEADERS.name: Tomo del liderazgo y la influencia
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TOME_OF_LEADERS.description: This book contains guidelines for influencing and charming others, and its words are cargad with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Carisma score increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TOME_OF_THE_STI.name: Tomo de la lengua silenciada

setters.keywords: wizard, spellbook, arcane focus, spellcasting focus, focus, bonus action, cooldown, dawn

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TOME_OF_THE_STI.description:
This book has a desiccated tongue pinned to its front cover. Five of these tomes exist, and it's unknown which one is the original. The tongue on the first Tome of the Stilled Tongue belonged to a treacherous former servant of the lich Vecna. The tongues pinned to the covers of the four copies came from other spellcasters who crossed Vecna. The first few pages of each tome are filled with indecipherable scrawls. The remaining pages are blank.

Mientras estás sintonizado con item, you can use it as a Spellbook and an Arcane Focus. In addition, while holding the tome, you can take a Bonus Action to cast a spell you have written in this tome, without expending a spell slot or using any Verbal or Somatic components. Once used, this property of the tome can't be used again hasta el próximo amanecer.

Only you can remove the tongue from the book's cover. If you do so, all spells written in the book are permanently erased.

Vecna watches anyone using this tome and can write cryptic messages in it. These messages typically fade away after they are read.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TOME_OF_UNDERST.name: Tomo del entendimiento
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_TOME_OF_UNDERST.description: This book contains intuition and insight exercises, and its words are cargad with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Sabiduría score increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_UNIVERSAL_SOLVE.name: Disolvente universal
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_UNIVERSAL_SOLVE.description:
This tube holds milky liquid with a strong alcohol smell. When found, a tube contains 1d6 + 1 ounces.

You can take a Utilize action to pour 1 or more ounces of solvent from the tube onto a surface within reach. Each ounce instantly dissolves up to 1 square pie of adhesive it touches, including Sovereign Glue .

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_VETERANS_CANE.name: Bastón de veterano
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_VETERANS_CANE.description: Como acción adicional, you can transform this walking cane into an ordinary Longsword or change the Longsword back into a walking cane. In either case, you must be holding the item.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WELL_OF_MANY_WO.name: Pozo de muchos mundos

setters.keywords: magic action, action, planar travel, portal

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WELL_OF_MANY_WO.description:
This fine black cloth, soft as silk, is folded up to the dimensions of a handkerchief. It unfolds into a circular sheet 6 pies in diameter.

You can take a Magic action to unfold the Well of Many Worlds and place it on a solid surface, whereupon it forms a two-way, 6-foot-diameter, circular portal to another world or plane of existence. Each time the item opens a portal, the DM decides where it leads. The portal remains open until a creature within 5 pies of it takes a Magic action to close it by taking hold of the edges of the cloth and folding it up.

Once the Well of Many Worlds has opened a portal, it can't do so again for 1d8 hours.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WIND_FAN.name: Abanico de viento
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WIND_FAN.description: Mientras empuñas fan, you can cast Gust of Wind (save CD 13) from it. Each subsequent time the fan is used before the next dawn, it has a cumulative 20 percent chance of not working; if the fan fails to work, it tears into useless, nonmagical tatters.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WINGED_BOOTS.name: Botas aladas

setters.keywords: charge, recharge, dawn, magic action, action, fly speed, flying speed, speed

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WINGED_BOOTS.description: These boots have 4 cargas and regain 1d4 expended cargas diariamente al amanecer. While wearing the boots, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 carga, gaining a Fly Speed of 30 pies durante 1 hora. If you are flying when the duration expires, you descend at a rate of 30 pies per round until you land.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WINGS_OF_FLYING.name: Alas de vuelo

setters.keywords: magic action, action, fly speed, flying speed, speed, cooldown

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WINGS_OF_FLYING.description: Mientras llevas cloak, you can take a Magic action to turn the cloak into a pair of wings on your back. The wings lasts for 1 hour or until you end the effect early como acción de Magia. The wings give you a Fly Speed of 60 pies. If you are aloft when the wings disappear, you fall. When the wings disappear, you can't use them again for 1d12 hours.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WRAPS_OF_UNARME.name: Vendas de poder desarmado +1
ID_WOTC_DMG24_MAGIC_ITEM_WRAPS_OF_UNARME.description: While wearing these wraps, you have a +1 bonus to tiradas de ataque and tiradas de daño made with your golpes sin armas. Those strikes deal your choice of fuerza daño or their normal daño type.

ID_INTERNAL_WEAPON_BOOMERANG.name: Bumerán
ID_INTERNAL_WEAPON_BOOMERANG.description: El bumerán es un arma a distancia, y cualquier criatura competente con la jabalina también es competente con esta arma. Cuando fallas un ataque a distancia con un bumerán, el arma regresa volando a la mano del lanzador.

ID_INTERNAL_ITEM_MULTICLASS_UNLOCKER.name: Desbloqueador de multiclase
ID_INTERNAL_ITEM_MULTICLASS_UNLOCKER.description: Una vez equipado, este objeto te permite ignorar los prerrequisitos de multiclase de todas las clases.

ID_INTERNAL_ITEM_WEAPON_MASTERY_FEATURE.name: Rasgo de Maestría con armas
ID_INTERNAL_ITEM_WEAPON_MASTERY_FEATURE.description: Puedes equipar este objeto para activarlo. Permanece oculto en el inventario de tu hoja de personaje. Otorga acceso al rasgo Maestría con armas.

ID_INTERNAL_ITEM_WEAPON_MASTERY_SELECTIO.name: Selección de Maestría con armas
ID_INTERNAL_ITEM_WEAPON_MASTERY_SELECTIO.description: Puedes equipar este objeto para activarlo. Permanece oculto en el inventario de tu hoja de personaje. Añade una selección adicional de Maestría con armas.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ITEM_STAR_MAP.name: Mapa estelar
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ITEM_STAR_MAP.description:
El mapa es un objeto Diminuto y puede servir como canalizador mágico para el druida del Círculo de las Estrellas y sus conjuros.

Si pierdes el mapa, puedes realizar una ceremonia de 1 hora para crear mágicamente un reemplazo. Esta ceremonia puede realizarse durante un descanso corto o largo, y destruye el mapa anterior.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ITEM_FEAT_UNLOCKER.name: Desbloqueador de dotes (2024)
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ITEM_FEAT_UNLOCKER.description:
Una vez equipado, este objeto te permite ignorar los prerrequisitos de todas las dotes del Manual del Jugador (2024), incluidos los requisitos de nivel.

Nota: Este objeto, combinado con el Desbloqueador de dotes del Manual del Jugador original, puede usarse para permitir la selección de dotes duplicadas.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_LIGHT_PADDED.name: Acolchada
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_LIGHT_PADDED.description:
1 minuto para ponerse o quitarse

La armadura acolchada consiste en capas acolchadas de tela y guata.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_LIGHT_LEATHER.name: Cuero
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_LIGHT_LEATHER.description:
1 minuto para ponerse o quitarse

El peto y las hombreras de esta armadura están hechos de cuero endurecido tras ser hervido en aceite. El resto de la armadura está hecho de materiales más suaves y flexibles.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_LIGHT_STUDDED_LEATHE.name: Cuero tachonado
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_LIGHT_STUDDED_LEATHE.description:
1 minuto para ponerse o quitarse

Hecha de cuero resistente pero flexible, la armadura de cuero tachonado está reforzada con remaches o púas muy juntos.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_MEDIUM_HIDE_ARMOR.name: Pieles
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_MEDIUM_HIDE_ARMOR.description:
5 minutos para ponerse y 1 minuto para quitarse

Esta tosca armadura consiste en pieles y pellejos gruesos. Suelen llevarla tribus bárbaras, humanoides malvados y otras gentes que carecen de acceso a las herramientas y materiales necesarios para crear una armadura mejor.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_MEDIUM_CHAIN_SHIRT.name: Camisa de mallas
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_MEDIUM_CHAIN_SHIRT.description:
5 minutos para ponerse y 1 minuto para quitarse

Hecha de anillas metálicas entrelazadas, una camisa de mallas se lleva entre capas de ropa o cuero. Esta armadura ofrece una protección modesta al torso del portador y permite que las capas exteriores amortigüen el sonido de las anillas al rozarse entre sí.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_MEDIUM_SCALE_MAIL.name: Cota de escamas
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_MEDIUM_SCALE_MAIL.description:
5 minutos para ponerse y 1 minuto para quitarse

Esta armadura consiste en una casaca y perneras (y quizá una falda aparte) de cuero cubiertas con piezas metálicas superpuestas, de forma muy similar a las escamas de un pez. El conjunto incluye guanteletes.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_MEDIUM_BREASTPLATE.name: Coraza
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_MEDIUM_BREASTPLATE.description:
5 minutos para ponerse y 1 minuto para quitarse

Esta armadura consiste en una pieza pectoral metálica ajustada que se lleva sobre cuero flexible. Aunque deja las piernas y los brazos relativamente desprotegidos, proporciona una buena protección para los órganos vitales del portador al tiempo que lo deja relativamente libre de estorbos.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_MEDIUM_HALF_PLATE.name: Semiplacas
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_MEDIUM_HALF_PLATE.description:
5 minutos para ponerse y 1 minuto para quitarse

La armadura de semiplacas consiste en placas metálicas moldeadas que cubren la mayor parte del cuerpo del portador. No incluye protección para las piernas más allá de unas simples grebas sujetas con correas de cuero.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_HEAVY_RING_MAIL.name: Cota de anillas
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_HEAVY_RING_MAIL.description: Esta armadura es una armadura de cuero con pesadas anillas cosidas en ella. Las anillas ayudan a reforzar la armadura contra los golpes de espadas y hachas. La cota de anillas es inferior a la cota de mallas, y normalmente solo la llevan quienes no pueden permitirse una armadura mejor.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_HEAVY_CHAIN_MAIL.name: Cota de mallas
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_HEAVY_CHAIN_MAIL.description:
10 minutos para ponerse y 5 minutos para quitarse

Hecha de anillas metálicas entrelazadas, la cota de mallas incluye una capa de tela acolchada que se lleva debajo para evitar rozaduras y amortiguar el impacto de los golpes. El conjunto incluye guanteletes.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_HEAVY_SPLINT.name: Armadura de bandas
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_HEAVY_SPLINT.description:
10 minutos para ponerse y 5 minutos para quitarse

Esta armadura está hecha de estrechas tiras verticales de metal remachadas sobre un soporte de cuero que se lleva sobre un acolchado de tela. Una cota de mallas flexible protege las articulaciones.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_HEAVY_PLATE.name: Armadura de placas
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_HEAVY_PLATE.description:
10 minutos para ponerse y 5 minutos para quitarse

La armadura de placas consiste en placas metálicas moldeadas y entrelazadas que cubren todo el cuerpo. Un conjunto de armadura de placas incluye guanteletes, botas pesadas de cuero, un yelmo con visor y gruesas capas de acolchado debajo de la armadura. Hebillas y correas distribuyen el peso por todo el cuerpo.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_SHIELD.name: Escudo
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ARMOR_SHIELD.description: Un escudo está hecho de madera o metal y se lleva en una mano. Empuñar un escudo aumenta tu Clase de Armadura en 2. Solo puedes beneficiarte de un escudo a la vez.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ITEM_ACID.name: Ácido
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ITEM_ACID.description: Cuando realizas la acción de Atacar, puedes sustituir uno de tus ataques por lanzar un vial de ácido. Elige como objetivo una criatura u objeto que puedas ver a 20 pies o menos de ti. El objetivo debe superar una tirada de salvación de Destreza (CD 8 más tu modificador por Destreza y tu bonificador por competencia) o sufrir 2d6 de daño por ácido.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ITEM_ALCHEMISTS_FIRE.name: Fuego de alquimista
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ITEM_ALCHEMISTS_FIRE.description: Cuando realizas la acción de Atacar, puedes sustituir uno de tus ataques por lanzar un frasco de fuego de alquimista. Elige como objetivo una criatura u objeto que puedas ver a 20 pies o menos de ti. El objetivo debe superar una tirada de salvación de Destreza (CD 8 más tu modificador por Destreza y tu bonificador por competencia) o sufrir 1d4 de daño por fuego y empezar a arder.

ID_WOTC_PHB24_ITEM_ARROW.name: Flecha
ID_WOTC_PHB24_ITEM_ARROW.description: Las armas con la propiedad Munición requieren munición para usarse. La descripción del arma especifica el tipo de munición que utiliza. La tabla de Munición indica los distintos tipos y la cantidad que obtienes al comprarlos. La tabla también indica el objeto que se usa normalmente para guardar cada tipo; el almacenamiento debe comprarse por separado.
